CH-MCQ-24.a: He should be offered a definitive surgical procedure, and scuba diving is permanently contraindicated unless definitive bilateral surgery is performed
CH-MCQ-24.p: PSP ครั้งที่ 2 = ผ่าตัด; ห้ามดำน้ำถาวร (Boyle's law) แต่บินได้หลังปอดขยายเต็ม ~1–2 สัปดาห์

CH-OLD-29.s: A 52-year-old woman is mechanically ventilated with pressure-controlled ventilation and PEEP for severe pneumonia. After subclavian catheterisation she develops subcutaneous emphysema and a chest radiograph shows a 10 percent right pneumothorax. What is the most appropriate management?

CH-RP-MCQ-13.s: A 21-year-old man has had mild right chest discomfort for 2 days. He is not breathless, SpO2 98% on room air, BP 118/70 mmHg. He has no lung disease and does not smoke. Chest radiograph shows a 3-cm apical-to-cupola right primary spontaneous pneumothorax without mediastinal shift. According to the BTS 2023 guideline, what is the most appropriate management?
CH-RP-MCQ-13.a: Conservative management with outpatient follow-up and clear advice to return if symptoms worsen
CH-RP-MCQ-13.p: Primary PTX อาการน้อย ไม่มี high-risk → conservative ได้ (BTS 2023)

CH-RP-MCQ-14.s: A chest radiograph shows complete opacification of the left hemithorax. Which finding most strongly suggests that the opacity is caused by a massive pleural effusion rather than collapse of the left lung?
CH-RP-MCQ-14.a: The trachea and mediastinum are shifted to the RIGHT
CH-RP-MCQ-14.p: ฝ้าทั้งข้าง: ดันออก = น้ำ · ดึงเข้า = ปอดแฟบ

CH-RP-MCQ-15.s: Thoracic ultrasound in a patient with pneumonia and a pleural effusion shows multiple septations with swirling echogenic particles. What does this indicate?
CH-RP-MCQ-15.a: The effusion is an exudate, likely a complicated parapneumonic effusion or empyema
CH-RP-MCQ-15.p: Septation บน US = exudate · ใน pneumonia คิดถึง empyema

CH-MCQ-21.s: A 62-year-old man with a large left pleural effusion is dyspnoeic at rest. The chest radiograph shows opacification of the whole left hemithorax with the trachea deviated to the right. Therapeutic thoracentesis is started. After 1.4 litres of straw-coloured fluid has been removed he develops persistent cough and vague chest tightness, but remains haemodynamically stable with SpO2 95% on room air. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
CH-MCQ-21.a: Stop the drainage now and arrange a chest radiograph
CH-MCQ-21.p: หยุดเจาะน้ำเมื่อ (1) ครบ 1–1.5 L (2) ไอ/เจ็บหน้าอก (3) pleural pressure < −20 cmH2O — อย่างใดอย่างหนึ่งมาก่อน

CH-OLD-30.s: A large pleural effusion is drained and 2 litres of fluid are removed in a single session. Shortly afterwards the patient develops cough, chest tightness and worsening hypoxaemia, with new unilateral infiltrates on the side that was drained. What is the most likely complication?

CH-OLD-31.s: During thoracentesis a patient becomes light-headed with cold extremities. Blood pressure is 80/60 mmHg and pulse rate 40/min. Breath sounds are equal on both sides. What is the most likely cause?

CH-OLD-27.s: A patient has a bilateral pleural effusion. Pleural fluid analysis shows a transudate by Light's criteria. Which of the following is the most likely cause?

CH-OLD-23.s: A 16-year-old man with 1 month of low-grade fever and cough has a chest radiograph showing right upper lobe infiltration with a right pleural effusion. Pleural fluid is yellow with WBC 900 cells/dL (neutrophils 10 percent, lymphocytes 90 percent), pleural fluid to serum LDH ratio 0.8 and pleural fluid to serum protein ratio 0.7. What is the most likely diagnosis?

CH-MCQ-20.s: A 28-year-old man has 6 weeks of low-grade fever, weight loss and right-sided pleuritic chest pain. Pleural fluid is an exudate with 92 percent lymphocytes, adenosine deaminase 78 U/L, negative AFB smear, negative Gram stain and cytology negative for malignant cells. Which is the most appropriate next step?
CH-MCQ-20.a: Start anti-tuberculous therapy, having sent pleural fluid and tissue for mycobacterial culture
CH-MCQ-20.p: TB pleuritis: ADA > 40 + lymphocyte เด่น + mesothelial cell < 1% = เริ่มยาได้เลยในพื้นที่ชุก — AFB smear ลบเป็นเรื่องปกติ (บวก < 10%) และ culture จากน้ำบวกแค่ 25–40% ต้องอาศัย pleural biopsy จึงจะไวถึง 80–90%

CH-OLD-25.s: Thoracentesis yields milky-white pleural fluid. Analysis shows WBC 1200 cells/microlitre with lymphocyte predominance and triglyceride 300 mg/dL. What is the most likely diagnosis?

CH-OLD-34.s: Which of the following is NOT a recognised cause of an amylase-rich pleural effusion?

CH-MCQ-19.s: A 58-year-old man with alcoholic cirrhosis and ascites develops a large right-sided pleural effusion. Pleural fluid analysis shows a transudate with a serum-to-pleural fluid albumin gradient of 1.8 g/dL, total nucleated cells 120/microlitre and a negative Gram stain. What is the diagnosis, and what is the most appropriate initial management?
CH-MCQ-19.a: Hepatic hydrothorax; sodium restriction with diuretics and treatment of the underlying liver disease
CH-MCQ-19.p: ในน้ำข้างปอดของผู้ป่วยตับแข็ง ถ้า **PMN > 250** ต้องคิดถึง **spontaneous bacterial empyema** ทันที และเจาะ **hemoculture + ส่งน้ำใส่ขวด culture ข้างเตียง** เพื่อเพิ่มโอกาสพบเชื้อ

CH-RP-MCQ-16.s: A 74-year-old man with heart failure has been on furosemide 80 mg/day for 5 days. Pleural fluid: protein 3.2 g/dL (serum 6.0), LDH 150 U/L (serum 240; upper limit of normal 250), albumin 1.4 g/dL (serum 2.9 g/dL). Serum NT-proBNP is 6,800 pg/mL. How should this effusion be interpreted?
CH-RP-MCQ-16.a: A transudate due to heart failure, misclassified by Light's criteria because of diuretic therapy
CH-RP-MCQ-16.p: ได้ diuretic + exudate หมิ่นเหม่ → albumin gradient > 1.2 = transudate

CH-OLD-24.s: A patient with fever and pleuritic chest pain has a pleural effusion. Analysis shows an exudate by Light's criteria with pleural fluid pH 7.10, glucose 35 mg/dL and LDH 1000 U/L. Gram stain shows no organisms. What is the diagnosis and the most appropriate management?
CH-OLD-24.a: Complicated parapneumonic effusion; insert an intercostal chest drain in addition to antibiotics

CH-MCQ-17.s: A 55-year-old man with pneumonia has a loculated right pleural collection. Thoracentesis yields frank pus; Gram stain shows gram-positive cocci. A chest drain is inserted but only 50 mL drains and the collection persists on ultrasound after 48 hours, with ongoing fever. Which is the most appropriate next step?
CH-MCQ-17.a: Intrapleural fibrinolytic with deoxyribonuclease, or surgical decortication by video-assisted thoracoscopy if that fails
CH-MCQ-17.p: เกณฑ์ใส่สายระบายในน้ำข้างปอดจากปอดอักเสบ: **หนองชัดเจน, Gram stain หรือ culture บวก, pH < 7.2, glucose < 60 หรือมี loculation** — ถ้าเข้าข้อใดข้อหนึ่งอย่ารอ

CH-OLD-26.s: A 65-year-old smoker has 2 months of progressive breathlessness. Chest radiograph shows a mass at the right upper lobe with a massive pleural effusion. Thoracentesis shows an exudate with WBC 10,000 cells/microlitre, 90 percent mononuclear cells, and markedly elevated LDH. What is the most likely cause of the effusion?
CH-OLD-26.a: Malignant pleural effusion from lung cancer

CH-MCQ-23.s: A 70-year-old woman with metastatic breast carcinoma has had three therapeutic thoracenteses in the past 6 weeks for a right pleural effusion; each time symptoms recur within 10–14 days. Cytology is positive for adenocarcinoma. After the last drainage the lung re-expanded fully on chest radiograph. Her performance status is ECOG 1 and she is expected to live more than 6 months. Which of the following is the most appropriate definitive management?
CH-MCQ-23.a: Chemical pleurodesis with talc, or an indwelling pleural catheter
CH-MCQ-23.p: MPE: ดูว่า lung re-expand ไหม — ขยายได้ → pleurodesis หรือ IPC; trapped lung → IPC เท่านั้น

CH-IMG-MCQ-01.s: A 72-year-old man in the ICU has a portable AP supine chest radiograph. The cardiothoracic ratio measures 0.58 and the superior mediastinum looks widened. A standing PA radiograph taken 3 weeks earlier, when he was well, showed a cardiothoracic ratio of 0.46. He is haemodynamically stable. What is the most appropriate interpretation?
CH-IMG-MCQ-01.a: The apparent enlargement is likely projectional; cardiac size should not be judged on an AP supine film
CH-IMG-MCQ-01.p: AP = แว่นขยาย · ตัดสินหัวใจโตจาก PA

CH-IMG-MCQ-02.s: A 30-year-old man has a chronic cough. On the PA radiograph a possible opacity at the right apex is partly hidden behind the clavicle and first rib. Which additional plain radiograph is most useful to clarify the apex?
CH-IMG-MCQ-02.p: Apex ถูก clavicle บัง → lordotic view

CH-IMG-MCQ-03.s: A PA chest radiograph shows the right hemidiaphragm at the level of the posterior seventh rib. The heart appears broad and both lung bases look hazy with crowded vessels. The patient is afebrile with clear lungs on auscultation. What is the best interpretation?
CH-IMG-MCQ-03.a: The film is taken in suboptimal inspiration and the basal haziness and heart size may be artefactual
CH-IMG-MCQ-03.p: นับซี่โครงก่อนเรียกหัวใจโต/ฐานปอดทึบ

CH-IMG-MCQ-04.s: On a PA chest radiograph, the lungs appear diffusely white, the thoracic vertebrae and disc spaces cannot be seen through the heart, and a nasogastric tube cannot be traced below the carina. What is the main technical problem?
CH-IMG-MCQ-04.p: มองไม่เห็นกระดูกสันหลังหลังหัวใจ = underexposed

CH-MCQ-25.s: A junior doctor reviews a portable AP chest radiograph taken in the emergency department. The medial ends of both clavicles are 1.5 cm from the spinous process on the right and 0.4 cm on the left; the right hemidiaphragm appears elevated and the right hilum looks prominent. Which of the following is the most appropriate interpretation?
CH-MCQ-25.a: The film is rotated, so hilar, mediastinal and diaphragmatic asymmetry cannot be reliably assessed
CH-MCQ-25.p: เช็ค RIPE ก่อนเสมอ — ฟิล์มหมุนทำให้ hilum/mediastinum/diaphragm ดูไม่สมมาตรเป็นเท็จ และ AP portable ห้ามวินิจฉัย cardiomegaly

CH-IMG-MCQ-05.s: Why is the right heart border normally seen as a sharp line on a PA chest radiograph?
CH-IMG-MCQ-05.a: Soft-tissue density of the right atrium lies directly against air-filled lung, creating an interface
CH-IMG-MCQ-05.p: ขอบ = รอยต่อ soft tissue กับลม

CH-IMG-MCQ-06.s: A 45-year-old asymptomatic woman has a 1 cm round nodule in the right upper zone. It is as white as the adjacent rib cortex and has not changed compared with a radiograph from 5 years ago. What does this density most likely indicate?
CH-IMG-MCQ-06.a: Diffuse calcification in a healed granuloma
CH-IMG-MCQ-06.p: ขาวเท่ากระดูก + คงที่ ≥ 2 ปี = calcified granuloma

CH-IMG-MCQ-07.s: A mechanically ventilated patient has a portable AP radiograph showing a vertical curvilinear line over the left lower chest. The line continues beyond the lateral chest wall into the soft tissues, lung markings are visible lateral to the line, and the line is an edge between grey and darker grey rather than a thin white line. What is the most appropriate action?
CH-IMG-MCQ-07.a: Recognise a skin fold and continue routine care
CH-IMG-MCQ-07.p: เส้นเลยนอกทรวงอก + ยังเห็นลายปอด = skin fold

CH-IMG-MCQ-08.s: A 55-year-old woman has a PA radiograph in which the left hemithorax is uniformly more lucent than the right. The pulmonary vessels on both sides are of similar size and number, the mediastinum is central and lung volumes are equal. Which is the most likely cause?
CH-IMG-MCQ-08.p: ดำกว่าแต่หลอดเลือดปกติ = ผนังอก (mastectomy)

CH-IMG-MCQ-09.s: Which combination of radiographic features best distinguishes lobar consolidation from lobar atelectasis?
CH-IMG-MCQ-09.a: Air bronchograms with preserved lobar volume and no fissural displacement
CH-IMG-MCQ-09.p: เติม (volume คงที่) vs ยุบ (volume ลด)

CH-IMG-MCQ-10.s: A 35-year-old man with advanced HIV infection has 2 weeks of dry cough and exertional desaturation. Chest radiograph shows bilateral hazy perihilar opacities through which the pulmonary vessels remain visible; there are no air bronchograms or effusions. What term best describes this opacity?
CH-IMG-MCQ-10.p: เห็นหลอดเลือดผ่าน = GGO · HIV + GGO → PJP

CH-IMG-MCQ-11.s: A 60-year-old woman has fever and productive cough. Her PA radiograph shows an ill-defined opacity in the left mid zone that obscures the left heart border; the left hemidiaphragm and the descending aorta remain sharply outlined. Which segment is most likely involved?
CH-IMG-MCQ-11.a: Lingula of the left upper lobe
CH-IMG-MCQ-11.p: Lt heart border หาย = lingula

CH-IMG-MCQ-12.s: On a lateral chest radiograph of a patient with pneumonia, the lower thoracic vertebrae appear whiter than the upper thoracic vertebrae, and the posterior part of the right hemidiaphragm is not visible while the anterior part is clearly seen. Where is the consolidation?
CH-IMG-MCQ-12.p: Lateral: โดมหลังหาย = lower lobe · spine sign

CH-OLD-39.s: A chest radiograph of a febrile coughing patient shows homogeneous opacification of the right lower zone containing air bronchograms, with the right heart border remaining clearly visible and no blunting of the costophrenic angle. What is the most likely diagnosis?
CH-OLD-39.a: Lobar pneumonia of the right lower lobe

CH-IMG-MCQ-13.s: A 40-year-old man with uncontrolled HIV infection has 3 weeks of fever, night sweats and weight loss. Chest radiograph shows innumerable uniform 1–2 mm nodules evenly distributed throughout both lungs. Which is the most likely diagnosis?
CH-IMG-MCQ-13.p: Miliary เท่ากันทั่วปอด + ไข้ = miliary TB

CH-IMG-MCQ-14.s: Which of the following conditions characteristically produces fibrosis or nodules predominantly in the UPPER zones on chest radiography?
CH-IMG-MCQ-14.p: ปอดบน: SCHARTS · ปอดล่าง: RASCO

CH-IMG-MCQ-15.s: Two hours after a patient with a mucus plug obstructing the left lower lobe bronchus was placed on 100% oxygen, the left lower lobe collapsed completely. Why does breathing high-concentration oxygen accelerate resorption atelectasis distal to an obstruction?
CH-IMG-MCQ-15.a: Oxygen is rapidly absorbed into capillary blood, and without nitrogen to splint the alveoli they empty quickly
CH-IMG-MCQ-15.p: Resorption atelectasis เร็วขึ้นเมื่อให้ O₂ — ไม่มี N₂ ค้ำ

CH-IMG-MCQ-16.s: A 66-year-old retired shipyard worker has an incidental 3.5 cm rounded subpleural opacity in the right lower lobe. CT shows it abuts an area of thickened pleura with an acute angle, bronchovascular bundles curve into its margin like a comet tail, and there is volume loss of the right lower lobe. What is the most likely diagnosis?
CH-IMG-MCQ-16.p: Rounded atelectasis = pleura หนา + ก้อนใต้ pleura + comet tail

CH-MCQ-31.s: A 68-year-old man presents with progressive dyspnoea. The chest radiograph shows complete opacification of the left hemithorax. The trachea and mediastinum are shifted towards the left, and the left ribs appear crowded. Which of the following is the most likely cause?
CH-MCQ-31.a: Complete collapse of the left lung from an endobronchial lesion
CH-MCQ-31.p: White-out: ดูทิศ trachea — ดึงเข้า = collapse (ส่องกล้อง), ดันออก = effusion (เจาะ/ใส่สาย), อยู่กลาง = consolidation

CH-IMG-MCQ-17.s: A 64-year-old man who smokes 50 pack-years has haemoptysis. PA radiograph shows opacification of the right upper zone whose inferior margin is concave laterally and convex medially, forming a reversed S shape; the right hilum is elevated and the trachea is deviated to the right. What is the most appropriate next step?
CH-IMG-MCQ-17.a: Contrast CT of the chest followed by bronchoscopy
CH-IMG-MCQ-17.p: Golden S = RUL collapse + hilar mass → CT + bronchoscopy

CH-IMG-MCQ-18.s: A frontal radiograph shows a triangular opacity behind the heart with its apex at the left hilum, loss of the medial left hemidiaphragm outline, a depressed left hilum, and a flattened left heart border. The left heart border itself remains visible. Which lobe has collapsed?
CH-IMG-MCQ-18.p: สามเหลี่ยมหลังหัวใจ + โดมซ้ายหาย + flat waist = LLL collapse

CH-IMG-MCQ-19.s: A 38-year-old non-smoker has an incidental 2 cm smooth, well-circumscribed nodule in the left lower lobe. CT shows coarse 'popcorn' calcification and small areas of fat attenuation within it. What is the most likely diagnosis?

CH-IMG-MCQ-20.s: A 59-year-old smoker has 4 months of severe right shoulder pain radiating down the inner arm, weakness of the intrinsic hand muscles, and right ptosis with miosis. Which radiographic area is most important to scrutinise?
CH-IMG-MCQ-20.p: Horner + ปวดไหล่แขน = Pancoast ที่ apex (hidden area)

CH-MCQ-26.s: A 58-year-old woman with a 30 pack-year smoking history has an incidental 9 mm solid nodule in the right upper lobe found on a chest radiograph taken before elective surgery. She is asymptomatic. Which of the following should be done first?
CH-MCQ-26.a: Obtain and review any previous chest imaging for comparison
CH-MCQ-26.p: SPN: ขอฟิล์มเก่าก่อนเสมอ — solid nodule นิ่ง ≥ 2 ปี = benign; แต่ subsolid/GGO ต้องตามนานกว่า 2 ปี

CH-MCQ-27.s: A 65-year-old man has a 4 cm spiculated right upper lobe mass. Contrast CT shows a 1.6 cm right paratracheal (station 4R) lymph node and a 1.2 cm subcarinal (station 7) node; there are no distant metastases on PET-CT, but both nodes are FDG-avid. He is otherwise fit and being considered for curative resection. Which of the following is the most appropriate next investigation?
CH-MCQ-27.a: Endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration of the mediastinal nodes
CH-MCQ-27.p: PET-positive mediastinal node ต้องพิสูจน์ด้วยเข็มเสมอ (EBUS-TBNA) — โดยเฉพาะพื้นที่ TB ระบาดที่ false positive สูง

CH-OLD-40.s: A 62-year-old man who has smoked 40 pack-years presents with facial and upper limb swelling, distended neck and chest wall veins that do not pulsate, and a right upper lobe mass on chest radiograph. What is the most likely diagnosis?
CH-OLD-40.a: Superior vena cava syndrome from bronchogenic carcinoma

CH-OLD-41.s: A 58-year-old heavy smoker is found to have a small cell lung carcinoma with mediastinal involvement. Which paraneoplastic syndrome is most characteristically associated with this tumour?
CH-OLD-41.a: Syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion

CH-OLD-42.s: Which of the following malignancies is LEAST associated with cigarette smoking?

CH-IMG-MCQ-21.s: A 67-year-old heavy smoker has a 5 cm right upper lobe mass with a central cavity. The cavity wall is 15 mm thick with an irregular, nodular inner margin, and a small air-fluid level is present. He is afebrile. Which histological type of lung cancer is most likely?
CH-IMG-MCQ-21.p: โพรงผนังหนาเป็นปุ่มในผู้สูบบุหรี่ = SCC

CH-IMG-MCQ-22.s: A patient with fever and foul-smelling sputum has a cavitary lesion with an air-fluid level in the right lower zone. On the PA view the air-fluid level is 6 cm long and on the lateral view it is also about 6 cm long; the lesion makes an acute angle with the chest wall. What is the most likely diagnosis?
CH-IMG-MCQ-22.p: Air-fluid level ยาวเท่ากันสอง view + มุมแหลม = lung abscess

CH-IMG-MCQ-23.s: A 3-year-old boy developed sudden coughing while eating peanuts. Inspiratory chest radiograph is nearly normal. On an expiratory film the right lung remains hyperlucent and large while the mediastinum shifts to the left. What is the mechanism of these findings?
CH-IMG-MCQ-23.a: Check-valve obstruction of the right main bronchus allowing air in on inspiration but not out on expiration
CH-IMG-MCQ-23.p: FB check valve → air trapping เห็นชัดในฟิล์มหายใจออก

CH-IMG-MCQ-24.s: On high-resolution CT of a patient with chronic productive cough, a bronchus seen in cross-section has an internal diameter clearly larger than that of the accompanying pulmonary artery, and peripheral bronchi fail to taper. What is the diagnosis?

CH-IMG-MCQ-25.s: A 38-year-old woman has 3 months of drooping eyelids and double vision that worsen towards evening. Chest radiograph shows a smooth lobulated mass projecting to the right of the upper heart that obscures the right heart border; on the lateral view the retrosternal clear space is opacified. What is the most likely mass?
CH-IMG-MCQ-25.p: ขอบหัวใจหาย + myasthenia = thymoma

CH-IMG-MCQ-26.s: A 28-year-old woman has painful red nodules on both shins, ankle swelling and low-grade fever for 2 weeks. Chest radiograph shows symmetrical bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy with right paratracheal widening and clear lung fields. What is the most likely diagnosis?
CH-IMG-MCQ-26.p: BHL สมมาตร + erythema nodosum = Löfgren (sarcoid)

CH-IMG-MCQ-27.s: Five days after hip surgery, a 70-year-old woman develops pleuritic chest pain and blood-streaked sputum. Chest radiograph shows a peripheral wedge-shaped opacity in the right lower zone whose base abuts the pleura and whose rounded apex points toward the hilum. What does this opacity most likely represent?
CH-IMG-MCQ-27.p: ลิ่มฐานที่ pleura ยอดชี้ hilum = Hampton hump (infarct)

CH-IMG-MCQ-28.s: In a patient with decompensated left heart failure, short horizontal lines 1–2 cm long are seen at the lateral lung bases, perpendicular to the pleura. What do these lines represent?
CH-IMG-MCQ-28.a: Thickened interlobular septa from interstitial oedema
CH-IMG-MCQ-28.p: Kerley B = interlobular septa บวม (interstitial edema)

CH-IMG-MCQ-29.s: A 50-year-old man's erect PA radiograph shows an apparently elevated right hemidiaphragm whose highest point lies far lateral to its normal position near the midclavicular line, with a sharp but shallow costophrenic angle. The lateral view shows blunting of the posterior costophrenic sulcus. What is the most likely finding?
CH-IMG-MCQ-29.p: โดมสูง + ยอดเลื่อนออกด้านข้าง = subpulmonic effusion

CH-IMG-MCQ-30.s: On an erect PA chest radiograph, approximately what minimum volume of pleural fluid is usually needed before the lateral costophrenic angle becomes blunted with a meniscus?
CH-IMG-MCQ-30.p: PA meniscus > 200 มล. · lateral > 50 มล.

CH-IMG-MCQ-31.s: A 24-year-old man is stabbed in the left chest. He is agitated, RR 36/min, BP 78/50 mmHg, HR 140/min, with distended neck veins, tracheal deviation to the right and absent breath sounds on the left. What is the most appropriate immediate action?
CH-IMG-MCQ-31.a: Immediate needle decompression of the left chest, followed by chest drain insertion
CH-IMG-MCQ-31.p: Tension = clinical → needle decompression ก่อนฟิล์ม

CH-IMG-MCQ-32.s: A ventilated ICU patient lying supine has a portable AP radiograph showing an unusually deep and lucent left costophrenic angle extending down the flank, a sharply outlined left hemidiaphragm and heart border, but no visible apical pleural line. What is the most likely diagnosis?
CH-IMG-MCQ-32.a: Anterior pneumothorax shown by the deep sulcus sign
CH-IMG-MCQ-32.p: Supine: ลมไปหน้า-ล่าง → deep sulcus sign

CH-IMG-MCQ-33.s: A 58-year-old asymptomatic man worked for 25 years making asbestos-cement roofing sheets. Routine chest radiograph shows bilateral calcified plaques on the diaphragmatic and posterolateral pleura with clear lung fields; spirometry is normal. He smokes 15 cigarettes a day. What is the most appropriate advice?
CH-IMG-MCQ-33.a: The plaques indicate past asbestos exposure and need no specific treatment; stop smoking because smoking and asbestos multiply lung cancer risk
CH-IMG-MCQ-33.p: Plaque = marker ของการสัมผัส · เลิกบุหรี่

CH-IMG-MCQ-34.s: A 55-year-old former underground coal miner with seropositive rheumatoid arthritis has multiple well-defined 1–3 cm nodules scattered in both lungs that appeared over a few months, on a background of small rounded upper-zone opacities. Some nodules have cavitated. What is the most likely diagnosis?
CH-IMG-MCQ-34.p: RA + ฝุ่น + ปุ่มหลายก้อน = Caplan

CH-MCQ-29.s: A 52-year-old man has worked for 20 years cutting and polishing engineered stone countertops. He has mild exertional dyspnoea. Chest radiograph shows multiple small rounded opacities predominantly in the upper zones with bilateral eggshell calcification of the hilar nodes. He is HIV-negative and has no cough or fever. Which of the following is the most appropriate additional management?
CH-MCQ-29.a: Screen for tuberculosis, including latent infection, and repeat screening periodically
CH-MCQ-29.p: Silicosis = macrophage เสียหน้าที่ → เสี่ยง TB 3–30 เท่า ต้องคัดกรอง TB ซ้ำเป็นระยะ และห้ามให้ steroid ลอย ๆ

CH-MCQ-30.s: Two retired miners are compared. Patient A worked at the coal face for 25 years; his chest radiograph shows small rounded opacities in the upper zones without hilar node calcification, and lung function is near normal. Patient B drilled through quartz-bearing rock for 20 years; his radiograph shows upper-zone nodules with bilateral eggshell hilar calcification. Which of the following statements best distinguishes the two conditions?
CH-MCQ-30.a: Eggshell calcification of hilar nodes and a markedly increased risk of tuberculosis favour silicosis rather than simple coal worker's pneumoconiosis
CH-MCQ-30.p: CWP กับ silicosis อยู่ upper zone ทั้งคู่ — ตัวแยกคือ eggshell calcification + ความเสี่ยง TB; asbestosis ต่างหากที่ lower zone

CH-OLD-35.s: A 55-year-old man who has worked in a stone-grinding and sandblasting factory for 25 years has progressive exertional dyspnoea. Chest radiograph shows multiple small upper-zone nodules with bilateral hilar lymph nodes that have peripheral rim calcification. What is the most likely diagnosis?

CH-OLD-36.s: A 60-year-old man worked for 30 years in a roofing-sheet factory. He has progressive dyspnoea and a dry cough. Chest radiograph shows irregular opacities with a fine reticular pattern in the lower zones, together with calcified pleural plaques on the diaphragmatic pleura. What is the most likely diagnosis?

CH-OLD-37.s: A 68-year-old man with a remote history of asbestos exposure presents with chest pain and a pleural effusion. Thoracentesis shows an exudate; cytology reports atypical mesothelial cells and is negative for malignant epithelial cells. What is the most likely diagnosis, and what is the principal risk factor?

CH-IMG-MCQ-35.s: A 45-year-old farmer develops fever, chills, dry cough and breathlessness about 6 hours after forking mouldy hay in a closed barn. The symptoms resolve over 2 days but recur each time he repeats the task. Chest examination reveals fine inspiratory crackles. Which mechanism best explains his illness?
CH-IMG-MCQ-35.a: Immune-mediated hypersensitivity pneumonitis to inhaled thermophilic actinomycete antigens
CH-IMG-MCQ-35.p: อาการ 4–8 ชม. หลังสัมผัส + ไข้ + crackles = acute HP

CH-IMG-MCQ-36.s: A 40-year-old cotton-mill worker reports chest tightness and cough that are worst on the first day back at work after the weekend and improve over the following working days. What is the most likely diagnosis?
CH-IMG-MCQ-36.p: Monday chest tightness = byssinosis (ตรงข้าม occupational asthma)

CH-MCQ-28.s: A 45-year-old woman has had 6 months of progressive exertional dyspnoea and dry cough. She keeps 20 pigeons in a loft at home. Examination shows fine inspiratory crackles and no clubbing. Spirometry shows FVC 62% predicted, FEV1/FVC 0.85 and DLCO 55% predicted. HRCT shows diffuse centrilobular ground-glass nodules with mosaic attenuation and air trapping on expiration. Serum precipitins to avian antigens are positive. Which of the following is the single most important component of management?
CH-MCQ-28.a: Complete and permanent removal of the patient from exposure to the birds
CH-MCQ-28.p: HP: ตัด antigen ถาวรคือหัวใจ — precipitins บวกบอกแค่ว่าสัมผัส ไม่ได้บอกว่าเป็นโรค

CH-OLD-38.s: A 35-year-old bakery worker has had wheezing and cough for 6 months. Symptoms begin a few hours after arriving at work, worsen through the working week and improve completely during weekends and holidays. Lung examination at the clinic is normal. What is the most likely diagnosis and the most important management?
CH-OLD-38.a: Occupational asthma; remove the patient from exposure to the causative agent

CH-THOR-MCQ-01.s: A medical student performs a diagnostic thoracentesis and infiltrates lidocaine only into the skin and subcutaneous tissue. The patient experiences sharp pain as the needle enters the pleural space. Which structure was inadequately anesthetized?
CH-THOR-MCQ-01.a: Parietal pleura, which is innervated by the intercostal nerves
CH-THOR-MCQ-01.p: ยาชาต้องถึง parietal pleura · visceral pleura ไม่เจ็บ

CH-THOR-MCQ-02.s: A 64-year-old smoker has progressive dyspnea and hemoptysis. Chest radiograph shows complete opacification of the left hemithorax with the trachea deviated to the LEFT. Which is the most appropriate next step?
CH-THOR-MCQ-02.a: Contrast CT chest followed by bronchoscopy to look for an endobronchial obstruction
CH-THOR-MCQ-02.p: Trachea ถูกดัน = น้ำมาก ระบายได้ · ถูกดึงเข้าหา = ปอดแฟบ หาสิ่งอุดก่อน

CH-THOR-MCQ-03.s: In which of the following patients is diagnostic thoracentesis LEAST necessary at presentation?
CH-THOR-MCQ-03.a: A 72-year-old with known HFrEF, small bilateral symmetrical effusions, afebrile, without chest pain, improving with diuretics
CH-THOR-MCQ-03.p: HF แบบทั่วไปไม่ต้องเจาะ · ผิดรูปแบบเมื่อไร เจาะเมื่อนั้น

CH-THOR-MCQ-04.s: A 55-year-old man has pneumonia. A lateral decubitus radiograph shows free-flowing pleural fluid layering to a thickness of 6 mm. He is clinically improving on antibiotics. What is the most appropriate management of the effusion?
CH-THOR-MCQ-04.a: Continue antibiotics and monitor; the effusion is too small to sample safely
CH-THOR-MCQ-04.p: > 10 mm ใน decubitus = หนาพอเจาะ

CH-THOR-MCQ-05.s: A 58-year-old with diabetes has a large left pleural effusion and fever; empyema is suspected. There is an area of cellulitis over the left posterior lower chest wall where the effusion appears largest. What is the most appropriate approach?
CH-THOR-MCQ-05.a: Use ultrasound to find an alternative puncture site over uninfected skin, such as the mid-axillary line
CH-THOR-MCQ-05.p: Relative contraindication = หาทางเลี่ยง ไม่ใช่ห้ามทำ

CH-THOR-MCQ-06.s: While consenting a patient for an ultrasound-guided thoracentesis, which complication should be explained as the most common clinically important complication?
CH-THOR-MCQ-06.p: Consent: pneumothorax พบบ่อยสุด · RPE เลือดออก ติดเชื้อ พบน้อยแต่ต้องบอก

CH-THOR-MCQ-07.s: Why is the patient positioned sitting upright and leaning slightly forward for a posterior thoracentesis?
CH-THOR-MCQ-07.a: Free fluid gravitates to the posterior costophrenic recess and the posterior intercostal spaces widen
CH-THOR-MCQ-07.p: นั่งโน้มตัว = น้ำลงหลัง + ช่องซี่โครงกว้าง

CH-THOR-MCQ-08.s: During a therapeutic thoracentesis, a student disconnects the 50-mL syringe from the catheter to empty it without turning the three-way stopcock. The patient suddenly coughs and becomes breathless, and breath sounds diminish. What is the mechanism of this complication?
CH-THOR-MCQ-08.a: Subatmospheric pleural pressure draws ambient air into the pleural space through the open catheter
CH-THOR-MCQ-08.p: ความดันในช่องอกลบ → ระบบเปิด = ดูดลมเข้า

CH-THOR-MCQ-09.s: Compared with a landmark (percussion-guided) approach, what is the main benefit of ultrasound guidance for thoracentesis?
CH-THOR-MCQ-09.a: Lower rates of pneumothorax and organ puncture, with fewer dry taps
CH-THOR-MCQ-09.p: US = ลด PTX + ลดแทงอวัยวะ + ลด dry tap

CH-THOR-MCQ-10.s: A pleural effusion is marked with ultrasound while the patient sits on the edge of the bed. The patient is then transferred supine to a procedure room 2 hours later and the needle is inserted at the marked spot, yielding blood-stained aspirate and right upper quadrant pain. Which principle was violated?
CH-THOR-MCQ-10.a: The puncture should be performed in the same position immediately after (or during) ultrasound marking
CH-THOR-MCQ-10.p: มาร์กท่าไหน เจาะท่านั้น ทันที

CH-THOR-MCQ-11.s: Why should the thoracentesis needle be inserted just above the superior border of the rib below the chosen intercostal space?
CH-THOR-MCQ-11.a: The intercostal vein, artery and nerve run in the costal groove along the inferior border of the rib above
CH-THOR-MCQ-11.p: VAN ใต้ขอบล่างซี่โครง → แทงเหนือขอบบนซี่โครงล่าง

CH-THOR-MCQ-12.s: An 82-year-old undergoes thoracentesis with the needle inserted 3 cm lateral to the spinous processes, just above a rib. One hour later he is hypotensive and the effusion appears larger on ultrasound. Which anatomical fact best explains this complication?
CH-THOR-MCQ-12.a: Near the spine the intercostal artery is tortuous and lies unprotected within the intercostal space, especially in the elderly
CH-THOR-MCQ-12.p: ใกล้กระดูกสันหลัง หลอดเลือดคดและไม่อยู่ในร่อง → ห้ามเจาะ

CH-THOR-MCQ-13.s: During therapeutic thoracentesis for a malignant effusion, 900 mL has been removed when the patient develops chest tightness and a persistent cough. Vital signs are stable. What is the most appropriate action?
CH-THOR-MCQ-13.p: อาการ > ตัวเลข: แน่นอก/ไอ = หยุด

CH-THOR-MCQ-14.s: A 35-year-old has had a large pleural effusion for 2 weeks. Two hours after 2.5 L is drained rapidly, he develops dyspnea, pink frothy sputum and crackles over the drained hemithorax. Which mechanism best explains this?
CH-THOR-MCQ-14.a: Increased capillary permeability from reperfusion injury of the re-expanded lung combined with a markedly negative pleural pressure
CH-THOR-MCQ-14.p: RPE = ข้างที่ระบาย + permeability ↑ + ความดันติดลบ

MOCK-142.s: During therapeutic thoracentesis, 2.2L pleural fluid evacuated rapidly. Patient develops cough, dyspnea, pink frothy sputum, unilateral crackles. Complication?

CH-THOR-MCQ-15.s: Thirty minutes after a diagnostic thoracentesis performed 4 cm from the spine, a 76-year-old has heart rate 118/min, blood pressure 92/60 mmHg and cool peripheries. Dullness has extended higher on the tapped side, and a repeat aspirate is frankly bloody. Breath sounds are reduced but the percussion note is not hyperresonant. What is the most likely diagnosis?
CH-THOR-MCQ-15.p: ชีพจรเร็ว + ทึบเพิ่ม = เลือด · ชีพจรช้า = vagal · โปร่ง = ลม

CH-THOR-MCQ-16.s: In which situation is a chest radiograph after thoracentesis MOST clearly indicated?
CH-THOR-MCQ-16.a: Air was aspirated during the procedure and the patient now has new dyspnea
CH-THOR-MCQ-16.p: CXR เมื่อมีอาการหรือมีเหตุสงสัย ไม่ใช่ทุกราย

CH-THOR-MCQ-17.s: Which is the correct way to collect and analyse pleural fluid for pH?
CH-THOR-MCQ-17.a: Draw fluid anaerobically into a heparinised blood gas syringe, expel air, cap it and analyse promptly in a blood gas analyser
CH-THOR-MCQ-17.p: pH = blood gas syringe · ไม่มีลม · ส่งทันที

CH-THOR-MCQ-18.s: A pleural fluid sample from a patient with pneumonia was sent for pH with a large air bubble left in the syringe. The reported pH is 7.34. What is the main concern with this result?
CH-THOR-MCQ-18.a: Loss of CO2 into the air bubble may have falsely raised the pH, so a complicated parapneumonic effusion could be missed
CH-THOR-MCQ-18.p: ฟองอากาศ = pH สูงปลอม = พลาด empyema

CH-THOR-MCQ-19.s: A patient with a resolving pneumonia has clear, straw-coloured pleural fluid: glucose 98 mg/dL, LDH 160 U/L, Gram stain negative, but pH 7.12. On review, the pH sample was drawn into the same syringe used to infiltrate lidocaine. What is the best next step?
CH-THOR-MCQ-19.a: Repeat the pH measurement on a properly collected sample before deciding on chest drainage
CH-THOR-MCQ-19.p: ผลขัดกัน → สงสัย preanalytic error ก่อน

CH-THOR-MCQ-20.s: A 78-year-old with chronic heart failure on furosemide 80 mg/day has a right pleural effusion. Pleural protein 3.6 g/dL (serum 6.4), pleural LDH 120 U/L (serum 260; upper limit of normal 250). Serum albumin 3.4 g/dL, pleural albumin 1.9 g/dL. How should this effusion be classified?
CH-THOR-MCQ-20.a: Transudate from heart failure; Light's criteria are falsely positive because of diuresis
CH-THOR-MCQ-20.p: ก้ำกึ่ง + ยาขับปัสสาวะ → albumin gradient > 1.2 = transudate

CH-THOR-MCQ-21.s: A patient with a malignant effusion has had two therapeutic thoracenteses in the past 3 weeks; a small pneumothorax occurred after the second. Fluid from a third tap shows 18% eosinophils. What is the most likely explanation for the eosinophilia?
CH-THOR-MCQ-21.a: Air and blood introduced into the pleural space by the previous procedures
CH-THOR-MCQ-21.p: Eosinophilic effusion: ถามก่อนว่าเคยเจาะ/มีลม/มีเลือดไหม

MOCK-138.s: Pleural fluid protein 4.2 g/dL (serum 6.8; ratio 0.62), pleural LDH 450 U/L (serum 500; ratio 0.90). Classification according to Light's criteria?

CH-THOR-MCQ-22.s: A 50-year-old treated for pulmonary tuberculosis 15 years ago has a chronic left pleural effusion with a thickened pleura. The fluid is milky. Triglyceride 42 mg/dL, cholesterol 320 mg/dL, and cholesterol crystals are seen. What is the diagnosis?
CH-THOR-MCQ-22.p: ขาวขุ่น: TG > 110 = chylo · cholesterol > 200 + TG ต่ำ = pseudo

CH-THOR-MCQ-23.s: After blunt chest trauma, a patient has a right effusion. Aspirated fluid is dark red. Pleural fluid haematocrit is 22% and blood haematocrit is 38%. What is the most appropriate interpretation and management?
CH-THOR-MCQ-23.a: Hemothorax (ratio about 0.58); insert a large-bore chest drain and assess ongoing bleeding
CH-THOR-MCQ-23.p: Hct น้ำ ≥ ครึ่งหนึ่งของเลือด = hemothorax → สายใหญ่

CH-THOR-MCQ-24.s: A 60-year-old woman with long-standing seropositive rheumatoid arthritis and subcutaneous nodules has a small unilateral exudative effusion. She is afebrile. Pleural glucose is 18 mg/dL (serum 110), pH 7.05, LDH 1,450 U/L, Gram stain and culture negative. What is the most likely cause?

MOCK-137.s: Pleural fluid analysis reveals milky white fluid, Total Protein 4.5 g/dL, Triglyceride level 340 mg/dL (> 110 mg/dL). Diagnosis?

CH-THOR-MCQ-25.s: A patient's pleural LDH is 83 U/L and serum LDH is 308 U/L. The laboratory's upper limit of normal for serum LDH is 250 U/L. Which statement correctly applies the third Light criterion?
CH-THOR-MCQ-25.a: Compare pleural LDH with two-thirds of the laboratory upper limit of normal (about 167 U/L): 83 is below this, so the criterion is not met
CH-THOR-MCQ-25.p: 2/3 ของ ULN ห้องแล็บ ไม่ใช่ของ LDH ผู้ป่วย

CH-THOR-MCQ-26.s: A 59-year-old with CKD stage 5, S3 gallop, generalized edema and bilateral pleural effusions has pleural fluid: yellow, WBC 133/µL, protein 1.7 g/dL (serum 6.9), LDH 83 U/L (serum 308), ADA 2.5 U/L, Gram stain and culture negative. What is the most appropriate management of the effusions?
CH-THOR-MCQ-26.a: Optimise fluid removal with diuretics and/or dialysis ultrafiltration and treat the heart failure
CH-THOR-MCQ-26.p: Transudate → รักษาสาเหตุ ไม่ใช่รักษาน้ำ

CH-COPD-MCQ-01.s: A 62-year-old Thai woman from a rural village has had progressive exertional breathlessness and morning cough for 3 years. She has never smoked; her husband smokes outdoors. For 35 years she has cooked over a wood and charcoal stove in a poorly ventilated kitchen. Post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC is 0.61. Which exposure is most likely to be the principal cause of her disease?
CH-COPD-MCQ-01.p: ผู้หญิงไม่สูบบุหรี่ + ครัวฟืน/ถ่าน = นึกถึง biomass COPD

CH-COPD-MCQ-02.s: A 72-year-old man smoked 15 hand-rolled cigarettes per day from the age of 30 until he stopped at the age of 70. How many pack-years has he smoked?
CH-COPD-MCQ-02.p: pack-year = (มวน/วัน ÷ 20) × ปี · ยาเส้นมวนเองนับเป็นมวนได้

CH-COPD-MCQ-03.s: Which mechanism best explains the reduced FEV1 in a patient with predominantly emphysematous COPD?
CH-COPD-MCQ-03.a: Loss of elastic recoil and of alveolar attachments, so small airways collapse early during forced expiration
CH-COPD-MCQ-03.p: Emphysema = recoil หาย + tethering หาย → dynamic airway collapse

CH-COPD-MCQ-04.s: A 67-year-old man with COPD (FEV1 48% predicted) says that his breathlessness becomes intolerable after climbing one flight of stairs, although he feels comfortable at rest. Which change during exercise best explains his symptom?
CH-COPD-MCQ-04.a: Progressive rise in end-expiratory lung volume because expiratory time shortens, reducing inspiratory capacity
CH-COPD-MCQ-04.p: เหนื่อยตอนออกแรงใน COPD = dynamic hyperinflation · ยาขยายหลอดลมและ pursed-lip ช่วยลดตรงนี้

CH-COPD-MCQ-05.s: During inspiration, the lower lateral rib margins of a patient with severe COPD move inward instead of outward. What is the mechanism of this sign?
CH-COPD-MCQ-05.a: A flattened diaphragm whose contraction pulls the lower ribs inward
CH-COPD-MCQ-05.p: Hoover sign = กะบังลมแบนจาก hyperinflation

CH-COPD-MCQ-06.s: A 66-year-old man with long-standing COPD (GOLD 3) attends clinic for routine follow-up. You notice new finger clubbing that was not present one year ago. He has lost 4 kg. What is the most appropriate next step?
CH-COPD-MCQ-06.a: Investigate for lung cancer with chest imaging
CH-COPD-MCQ-06.p: COPD + clubbing = หามะเร็งปอด/bronchiectasis

CH-COPD-MCQ-07.s: A 64-year-old ex-smoker with exertional dyspnea has post-bronchodilator spirometry: FEV1 1.50 L (52% predicted), FVC 2.90 L (80% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.52. How should this result be classified?
CH-COPD-MCQ-07.p: อ่าน ratio ก่อน แล้วจึงดู FEV1 %pred เพื่อแบ่งเกรด

CH-COPD-MCQ-08.s: A 58-year-old smoker with chronic cough and exertional breathlessness is seen at a district hospital that has only a peak flow meter. His peak expiratory flow is 62% of predicted. What is the most appropriate next step?
CH-COPD-MCQ-08.a: Arrange forced spirometry with a bronchodilator to confirm airflow obstruction
CH-COPD-MCQ-08.p: ไม่มี spirometry = ยังวินิจฉัย COPD ไม่ได้ · PEF ใช้คัดกรองเท่านั้น

CH-COPD-MCQ-09.s: Which chest radiograph finding is most consistent with lung hyperinflation in COPD?
CH-COPD-MCQ-09.a: Flattened hemidiaphragms with an enlarged retrosternal air space on the lateral film
CH-COPD-MCQ-09.p: CXR ใน COPD: กะบังลมแบน + retrosternal air space กว้าง

CH-OLD-48.s: A 65-year-old man with 4 months of breathlessness and greyish morning sputum has an increased anteroposterior chest diameter and normal breath sounds. Post-bronchodilator spirometry shows FEV1/FVC 68 percent with FEV1 75 percent predicted. What is the most likely diagnosis?

CH-COPD-MCQ-10.s: A 63-year-old man with newly confirmed COPD (post-bronchodilator FEV1 72% predicted) has an mMRC score of 1 and a CAT score of 8. Six months ago he was treated by his general practitioner with oral prednisolone and amoxicillin-clavulanate for a flare of cough and breathlessness; he was not admitted. According to GOLD 2026, which group is he in?
CH-COPD-MCQ-10.p: GOLD 2026: 1 moderate exacerbation ก็เป็น E

CH-COPD-MCQ-11.s: A 70-year-old woman with COPD has a CAT score of 18 and mMRC 2. Post-bronchodilator FEV1 is 38% predicted. She has had no exacerbations and no hospital admissions in the past two years. Which statement about her assessment is correct?
CH-COPD-MCQ-11.a: She is in group B; the spirometric grade (GOLD 3) is recorded but does not determine the group
CH-COPD-MCQ-11.p: จัดกลุ่ม = exacerbation + อาการ · เกรด spirometry บันทึกแยก

CH-COPD-MCQ-12.s: A 68-year-old ex-smoker (20 pack-years) presents with 3 months of breathlessness. He now sleeps on three pillows and wakes at night gasping. Examination shows bibasal fine crackles, a raised jugular venous pressure and pitting ankle edema. Post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC is 0.78 with a reduced FVC. What is the most likely explanation of his breathlessness?
CH-COPD-MCQ-12.p: Ratio ≥ 0.7 = ไม่ใช่ COPD · orthopnea/PND/crepitation → หัวใจ

CH-COPD-MCQ-13.s: A 55-year-old Thai farmer who has never smoked completed treatment for smear-positive pulmonary tuberculosis 8 years ago. He now has exertional breathlessness. Sputum AFB and GeneXpert are negative. Chest radiograph shows bilateral upper-zone fibrocalcific scarring unchanged from 2 years ago. Post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC is 0.60. Which statement is most appropriate?
CH-COPD-MCQ-13.a: Chronic airflow obstruction after tuberculosis is recognised; treat with bronchodilators, and use inhaled corticosteroids only with caution after excluding active TB
CH-COPD-MCQ-13.p: ประวัติ TB + obstruction = TB-associated COPD · ICS ระวัง TB

CH-COPD-MCQ-14.s: Tiotropium improves airflow in COPD mainly by which mechanism?
CH-COPD-MCQ-14.a: Blocking M3 muscarinic receptors on airway smooth muscle, preventing acetylcholine-induced rises in intracellular calcium
CH-COPD-MCQ-14.p: LAMA = บล็อก M3 · LABA = กระตุ้น β2 · ใช้คู่กันเสริมฤทธิ์

CH-COPD-MCQ-15.s: A 74-year-old woman admitted with an exacerbation of COPD has received nebulised salbutamol every 1–2 hours for 12 hours. She has a fine tremor and a heart rate of 118/min. Serum potassium has fallen from 4.1 to 2.9 mmol/L. What is the mechanism of the hypokalaemia?
CH-COPD-MCQ-15.a: Beta-2-mediated stimulation of Na+/K+-ATPase that shifts potassium into cells
CH-COPD-MCQ-15.p: SABA ถี่ → K ต่ำจาก shift เข้าเซลล์ · ตรวจ K ใน exacerbation

CH-COPD-MCQ-16.s: A 69-year-old man is prescribed a dry powder inhaler (DPI) containing LABA+LAMA. Which instruction is correct for this device?
CH-COPD-MCQ-16.a: Breathe out away from the device, then inhale quickly and forcefully from the start, then hold the breath
CH-COPD-MCQ-16.p: DPI = สูดแรงเร็ว · pMDI = สูดช้าลึก · ทั้งสองแบบไม่เป่าใส่เครื่อง

CH-COPD-MCQ-17.s: A 61-year-old woman with newly diagnosed COPD (post-bronchodilator FEV1 58% predicted) has a CAT score of 17 and no exacerbations in the past year. Blood eosinophil count is 150 cells/µL. Which initial maintenance treatment is recommended by GOLD 2026, provided there are no issues of cost or availability?

CH-COPD-MCQ-18.s: A 66-year-old man with newly diagnosed COPD (FEV1 46% predicted, CAT 14) was admitted once last year for an exacerbation. He has never received maintenance inhalers. Blood eosinophils are 380 cells/µL. Which initial maintenance regimen is most appropriate?
CH-COPD-MCQ-18.p: กลุ่ม E + eos ≥ 300 → เริ่ม triple ได้

CH-COPD-MCQ-19.s: A 70-year-old man with COPD has used a LABA+LAMA inhaler correctly and regularly for 1 year. He has had two exacerbations treated with prednisolone in the past 12 months. He stopped smoking 5 years ago. Blood eosinophil count is 240 cells/µL. What is the most appropriate change?
CH-COPD-MCQ-19.p: LABA+LAMA ยัง exacerbate + eos ≥ 100 → triple

CH-OLD-49.s: A 68-year-old man with COPD remains breathless on exertion despite regular inhaled tiotropium and as-needed salbutamol, and has had two exacerbations in the past year. What is the most appropriate next step in his maintenance therapy?
CH-OLD-49.a: Add a long-acting beta-2 agonist to make a LABA plus LAMA combination

CH-COPD-MCQ-20.s: A 59-year-old man with COPD smokes 25 cigarettes a day, lights his first cigarette within 10 minutes of waking, and says he wants to stop within the next month. Which approach is most likely to achieve long-term abstinence?
CH-COPD-MCQ-20.a: Behavioural counselling combined with pharmacotherapy such as varenicline or nicotine replacement
CH-COPD-MCQ-20.p: Counseling + ยา = วิธีเลิกบุหรี่ที่ดีที่สุด

CH-COPD-MCQ-21.s: A 72-year-old woman with COPD has been stable for 3 months. On two occasions 3 weeks apart, arterial blood gas on room air at rest shows PaO2 58 mmHg. She has bilateral pitting ankle edema, a loud P2, and haematocrit 57%. What is the most appropriate management of her hypoxaemia?
CH-COPD-MCQ-21.a: Long-term oxygen therapy for more than 15 hours per day
CH-COPD-MCQ-21.p: PaO2 55–60 + cor pulmonale/PH/Hct > 55% = ให้ LTOT

CH-COPD-MCQ-22.s: A 68-year-old man with COPD asks which vaccines he should receive. He has had no vaccinations since childhood. According to GOLD 2026, which recommendation is most appropriate?
CH-COPD-MCQ-22.a: Annual inactivated influenza vaccine, a pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (e.g., PCV20 or PCV21) and RSV vaccine, plus Tdap and zoster vaccines
CH-COPD-MCQ-22.p: COPD: influenza ทุกปี + pneumococcal + RSV + Tdap + zoster

CH-MCQ-37.s: A 70-year-old man with severe COPD (FEV1 34% predicted) has stopped smoking for 1 year. He is clinically stable on triple inhaled therapy and has had no exacerbation for 4 months. On two separate occasions 4 weeks apart, arterial blood gas on room air at rest shows PaO2 52 and 54 mmHg with PaCO2 48 mmHg. Haematocrit is 46% and echocardiography is normal. Which of the following is most likely to improve his survival?
CH-MCQ-37.a: Long-term oxygen therapy for at least 15 hours per day
CH-MCQ-37.p: LTOT: PaO2 ≤55 หรือ 56–59 ที่มี cor pulmonale/Hct >55% — ต้องใช้ ≥15 ชม./วัน (ยิ่งมากยิ่งดี) และวัด ABG ตอน stable สองครั้ง

CH-OLD-50.s: A 65-year-old man with COPD can perform activities of daily living but becomes breathless walking more than one block. He is on appropriate inhaled therapy for his stage. SpO2 on room air is 96 percent. Which of the following is indicated in the management of this condition?

CH-MCQ-39.s: A 72-year-old man with moderate COPD (FEV1 55% predicted, no bronchodilator reversibility) has just had an anterior ST-elevation myocardial infarction with a left ventricular ejection fraction of 38%. The medical team is hesitant to start a beta-blocker because of his lung disease. Which of the following is the most appropriate course of action?
CH-MCQ-39.a: Start a cardioselective beta-1 blocker such as bisoprolol at a low dose and titrate with monitoring
CH-MCQ-39.p: COPD ไม่ใช่ข้อห้ามของ cardioselective beta-blocker — เริ่มต่ำแล้วไต่ขึ้น; ความเลือกจับ β1 ลดลงเมื่อยาขนาดสูง

CH-COPD-MCQ-23.s: A 66-year-old man is admitted with an exacerbation of COPD. He is not acidotic and has no pneumonia on chest radiograph. Which systemic corticosteroid regimen is recommended?
CH-COPD-MCQ-23.a: Prednisolone 40 mg orally once daily for 5 days

CH-COPD-MCQ-24.s: A 71-year-old woman with COPD presents with 1 day of sudden breathlessness and right-sided pleuritic chest pain. She has no change in sputum and no fever. Pulse 118/min, RR 28/min, SpO2 86% on room air. Her right calf has been swollen since a hip operation 2 weeks ago. Chest radiograph shows hyperinflation only. Which investigation is most important next?
CH-COPD-MCQ-24.p: Exacerbation ที่ไม่มีเสมหะเปลี่ยน + pleuritic pain + DVT → หา PE

CH-MCQ-38.s: A 66-year-old man with COPD presents with 3 days of increased breathlessness and increased sputum volume; the sputum has changed from white to green. Temperature 37.4°C, SpO2 90% on room air, no consolidation on chest radiograph. He is alert and able to speak in sentences. Which of the following best supports giving him an antibiotic?
CH-MCQ-38.a: He has all three Anthonisen cardinal symptoms, including increased sputum purulence
CH-MCQ-38.p: ให้ยาปฏิชีวนะใน AECOPD เมื่อครบ 3 อาการ, หรือ 2 อาการที่ต้องมี purulence, หรือต้องใช้เครื่องช่วยหายใจ

CH-OLD-51.s: What is the single most common precipitating cause of an acute exacerbation of COPD?

CH-COPD-MCQ-25.s: A 70-year-old man with severe COPD is brought to the emergency department with an exacerbation. Paramedics gave 15 L/min oxygen via a non-rebreather mask. He is now drowsy. ABG: pH 7.21, PaCO2 88 mmHg, PaO2 210 mmHg, HCO3 34 mmol/L. Which mechanism contributes most to the rise in PaCO2?
CH-COPD-MCQ-25.a: Release of hypoxic pulmonary vasoconstriction, worsening ventilation–perfusion mismatch
CH-COPD-MCQ-25.p: CO2 คั่งจาก O2 = V/Q แย่ลง + Haldane → ไตเตรต SpO2 88–92%

CH-COPD-MCQ-26.s: A 64-year-old woman with COPD is admitted with an exacerbation. After 1 hour of nebulised bronchodilators, prednisolone and oxygen titrated to SpO2 90%, she is alert but using accessory muscles. RR 30/min. ABG: pH 7.29, PaCO2 64 mmHg, PaO2 62 mmHg. What is the most appropriate next step?
CH-COPD-MCQ-26.p: pH ≤ 7.35 + PaCO2 ≥ 45 ที่ยังตื่นดี = NIV

CH-COPD-MCQ-27.s: A 67-year-old man is ready for discharge after 5 days in hospital for an exacerbation of COPD. Before admission he used only as-needed salbutamol. Which discharge plan best follows GOLD 2026?
CH-COPD-MCQ-27.a: Start maintenance long-acting bronchodilator therapy, check inhaler technique, refer for pulmonary rehabilitation within 4 weeks and arrange follow-up within 1 month
CH-COPD-MCQ-27.p: ก่อนกลับบ้าน: long-acting + ท่าพ่นยา + rehab ≤ 4 สัปดาห์ + นัด ≤ 1 เดือน

CH-COPD-MCQ-28.s: [Read-more level] A 64-year-old ex-smoker with COPD (FEV1 42% predicted) has had three moderate exacerbations in the past year despite correct use of single-inhaler LABA+LAMA+ICS. He has chronic cough with sputum most days. Blood eosinophils have been 420 and 380 cells/µL. Which add-on therapy is supported by GOLD 2026?

CH-COPD-MCQ-29.s: [Read-more level] A 52-year-old current smoker has exertional breathlessness. Post-bronchodilator spirometry: FEV1 68% predicted, FVC 70% predicted, FEV1/FVC 0.76. Which term describes this result according to GOLD 2026?

CH-COPD-MCQ-30.s: [Read-more level] A 63-year-old ex-smoker has severe upper-lobe-predominant emphysema with marked hyperinflation (FEV1 28% predicted, RV 240% predicted) despite optimal therapy and pulmonary rehabilitation. CT shows intact fissures in the right upper lobe. Which statement about endobronchial one-way valve therapy is correct?
CH-COPD-MCQ-30.a: The most common serious early complication is pneumothorax
CH-COPD-MCQ-30.p: EBV: ลมออกทางเดียว · ต้อง fissure สมบูรณ์ · pneumothorax

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-01.s: A 58-year-old man with CKD stage 4 (eGFR 22 mL/min/1.73 m²) has fatigue and pallor. Hb is 8.6 g/dL with normal MCV, ferritin and transferrin saturation are adequate, and reticulocytes are low. Loss of which renal cell population best explains his anaemia?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-01.a: Peritubular interstitial fibroblasts of the cortex and outer medulla
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-01.p: EPO = peritubular interstitial fibroblast ตอบ PaO₂ ต่ำ

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-02.s: A 66-year-old woman with long-standing diabetic kidney disease (eGFR 12 mL/min/1.73 m²) is reviewed before starting dialysis. Which set of plasma findings is most consistent with loss of the kidney's excretory and endocrine functions?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-02.a: K⁺ high, phosphate high, Ca²⁺ low, HCO₃⁻ low
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-02.p: ไตวาย: K ↑ Pi ↑ Ca ↓ HCO₃⁻ ↓

MOCK-179.s: ESRD patient with serum Phosphate 7.8, Calcium 7.9, PTH 650 pg/mL, bone subperiosteal resorption. Secondary condition present?

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-03.s: A 24-year-old man is brought in after a motorcycle crash with BP 72/40 mmHg and heart rate 140/min. His urine output over the first 2 hours is 8 mL. Which mechanism contributes most to the abrupt fall in his renal blood flow?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-03.a: Norepinephrine acting on α1-adrenergic receptors causing afferent arteriolar constriction
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-03.p: Shock: NE → α1 afferent หด → RBF เหลือ 10–30%

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-04.s: A 70-year-old smoker has resistant hypertension, a left renal artery stenosis of 85% on CT angiography and an elevated plasma renin activity. Which signal at the juxtaglomerular apparatus of the left kidney is primarily responsible for the increased renin secretion?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-04.a: Decreased stretch of the juxtaglomerular cells due to low afferent arteriolar pressure
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-04.p: RAS: ความดัน afferent ต่ำ → JG cell ยืดน้อย → renin ↑

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-05.s: During a research study, a healthy volunteer receives a para-aminohippuric acid (PAH) infusion. Urine PAH is 12 mg/mL, urine flow 1.0 mL/min, plasma PAH 0.02 mg/mL and haematocrit 40%. Assuming a PAH extraction ratio of 0.9, what is the renal blood flow?

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-06.s: An 84-year-old bedridden woman weighing 38 kg is admitted with pneumonia. Her serum creatinine is 0.8 mg/dL. The team plans to give a renally excreted antibiotic at full dose because her 'creatinine is normal'. Which statement is most accurate?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-06.a: Her GFR is likely much lower than suggested because low muscle mass reduces creatinine production
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-06.p: ผู้สูงอายุตัวเล็ก: sCr "ปกติ" ≠ GFR ปกติ

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-07.s: A 5-year-old boy has generalized oedema and frothy urine. Urine protein is 4+ and the proteinuria is highly selective (mostly albumin, very little IgG). Electron microscopy shows effacement of podocyte foot processes. Which change in the filtration barrier best explains why albumin (69 kDa) is lost while larger IgG (150 kDa) is retained?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-07.a: Loss of the negative charge and slit-diaphragm integrity of the podocyte layer
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-07.p: Selective albuminuria = เสียประจุลบ/slit diaphragm ของ podocyte

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-08.s: A 22-year-old man develops severe muscle pain and cola-coloured urine after an extreme gym session. Urine dipstick is strongly positive for blood, but microscopy shows no red cells. CK is 85,000 U/L. Why does myoglobin appear in the urine so readily?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-08.a: Its small size (about 17 kDa, 3.8 nm) allows it to be filtered about 75% as freely as water
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-08.p: Myoglobin เล็ก (17 kDa) → กรองได้ 75% → ปัสสาวะสีโคล่า

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-09.s: A 76-year-old man with benign prostatic hyperplasia presents with a palpable bladder, 1,400 mL drained on catheterisation, bilateral hydronephrosis and creatinine rising from 1.1 to 3.4 mg/dL. Which change in glomerular Starling forces primarily explains the fall in his GFR?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-09.p: ทางเดินปัสสาวะอุด → P_BC ↑ → GFR ↓

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-10.s: In an experimental animal, plasma albumin is acutely lowered from 4.0 to 2.0 g/dL while renal plasma flow, arteriolar resistances and Kf are held constant. What is the expected immediate effect on GFR and filtration fraction?

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-11.s: A 79-year-old woman with heart failure takes enalapril 10 mg twice daily and furosemide 40 mg daily. After a week of ibuprofen for knee osteoarthritis, she becomes drowsy and oliguric. Creatinine has risen from 1.1 to 2.6 mg/dL; urinalysis is bland and FENa is 0.4%. Which mechanism best explains the fall in GFR?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-11.a: Loss of prostaglandin-mediated afferent dilation in a kidney whose angiotensin II-dependent efferent tone is already blocked
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-11.p: HF + ACEi + diuretic + NSAID = triple whammy → hemodynamic AKI

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-12.s: A 55-year-old man with type 2 diabetes, eGFR 58 mL/min/1.73 m² and albuminuria 600 mg/g already takes losartan. Two weeks after empagliflozin is added, his eGFR is 52 mL/min/1.73 m²; he is euvolaemic and well. What is the most likely explanation?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-12.a: Restored tubuloglomerular feedback causing afferent arteriolar constriction and lower intraglomerular pressure
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-12.p: SGLT2i: Na⁺ ถึง macula densa ↑ → afferent หด → eGFR dip ที่ตั้งใจ

MOCK-169.s: 62yo man with bilateral renal artery stenosis started on Enalapril, serum creatinine rises from 1.2 to 3.2 mg/dL. Physiological change causing decline?
MOCK-169.a: Loss of angiotensin II-mediated efferent arteriolar vasoconstriction, leading to a sudden drop in intraglomerular hydrostatic pressure

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-13.s: A 63-year-old man with septic shock has MAP 58 mmHg despite fluids. Before vasopressors, his urine output falls to 10 mL/h. A student asks why renal autoregulation did not protect his GFR. What is the best answer?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-13.a: Autoregulation only operates when MAP is above about 75–80 mmHg; below this, GFR falls with perfusion pressure

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-14.s: A kidney transplant (which has no renal nerve supply) is studied intra-operatively. When renal artery pressure is raised from 100 to 140 mmHg, afferent arteriolar resistance increases within seconds and RBF returns towards baseline. Which sequence best describes this response?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-14.a: Stretch → opening of stretch-gated cation channels → depolarisation → voltage-gated Ca²⁺ entry → smooth-muscle contraction
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-14.p: Myogenic = ยืด → VGCC → Ca²⁺ → หด (ไม่ต้องใช้เส้นประสาท)

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-15.s: A healthy volunteer receives an intravenous infusion of angiotensin II at a dose that does not change mean arterial pressure. Which combination of changes is expected?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-15.a: RPF ↓, GFR ↑ or unchanged, filtration fraction ↑
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-15.p: AII → RPF ↓ GFR คง → FF ↑

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-16.s: A 70-year-old woman has 4 days of diarrhoea and poor intake. BP is 92/58 mmHg. BUN is 68 mg/dL and creatinine 2.0 mg/dL (baseline 0.9); urine is concentrated with bland sediment. Which mechanism best explains why BUN has risen proportionally more than creatinine?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-16.a: Increased filtration fraction and ADH enhance tubular reabsorption of urea along with water, whereas creatinine is not reabsorbed
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-16.p: Pre-renal: FF ↑ + ADH → ดูด urea กลับ → BUN/Cr > 20

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-17.s: A 35-year-old trekker takes acetazolamide 250 mg twice daily to prevent acute mountain sickness. After several days, venous HCO₃⁻ is 18 mmol/L, K⁺ 3.2 mmol/L and urine pH 7.5. Which mechanism explains both the acid–base and the potassium findings?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-17.a: Inhibition of carbonic anhydrase in the proximal tubule, causing bicarbonaturia and increased distal Na⁺ delivery that enhances K⁺ secretion
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-17.p: Acetazolamide: bicarbonaturia → acidosis + K ต่ำ

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-18.s: A 48-year-old man with HIV on a tenofovir disoproxil–based regimen has bone pain. Plasma glucose is 92 mg/dL, phosphate 1.6 mg/dL, HCO₃⁻ 17 mmol/L with a normal anion gap, and urine shows 2+ glucose and generalized aminoaciduria. Which statement best explains why these abnormalities occur together?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-18.a: Generalized proximal tubular dysfunction: Na⁺-coupled reabsorption of glucose, amino acids, phosphate and HCO₃⁻ all depends on the Na⁺ gradient generated by basolateral Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-18.p: Fanconi = PT ล้มทั้งระบบ → glucose AA Pi HCO₃⁻ หลุดพร้อมกัน

MOCK-181.s: Patient receiving Gentamicin develops steady rise in creatinine 1.0 to 2.8 mg/dL over 7 days with preserved urine output. Renal structure primarily damaged?

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-19.s: A 29-year-old woman at 26 weeks of gestation has 1+ glucose on routine urine dipstick. Her fasting plasma glucose is 78 mg/dL and a 75-g OGTT is normal. Which mechanism best explains the glucosuria?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-19.a: A rise in GFR that increases the filtered glucose load while the tubular transport maximum falls
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-19.p: ตั้งครรภ์: GFR ↑ + Tm ↓ → glucosuria ที่น้ำตาลปกติ

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-20.s: A 61-year-old man with type 2 diabetes is started on dapagliflozin. One month later, his fasting plasma glucose is 112 mg/dL, yet his urine dipstick shows 3+ glucose. How does the drug alter his glucose titration curve?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-20.a: It lowers the reabsorptive capacity of the proximal tubule, shifting the renal threshold to a much lower plasma glucose
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-20.p: SGLT2i → Tm ↓ → threshold ↓ → glucosuria ที่น้ำตาลปกติ

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-21.s: A 66-year-old woman with squamous cell lung cancer has calcium 14.2 mg/dL. After 4 L of isotonic saline she is euvolaemic but becomes mildly overloaded, and furosemide is given. By which mechanism does furosemide increase urinary calcium excretion?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-21.a: It abolishes the lumen-positive voltage created by K⁺ recycling through ROMK, reducing paracellular Ca²⁺ reabsorption in the thick ascending limb
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-21.p: Furosemide → ไม่มี K⁺ รั่วกลับ → ลูเมนไม่บวก → Ca หลุด

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-22.s: A 16-year-old boy has muscle cramps, polyuria and nocturia since childhood. BP is 100/60 mmHg. K⁺ is 2.7 mmol/L, HCO₃⁻ 32 mmol/L, Mg²⁺ 2.0 mg/dL, plasma renin and aldosterone are high, and the urine calcium/creatinine ratio is elevated. He cannot concentrate his urine after water deprivation. He takes no medications. Which disorder best fits?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-22.p: Bartter (TAL) = Ca ในปัสสาวะสูง · Gitelman (DT) = Ca ในปัสสาวะต่ำ

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-23.s: A 68-year-old woman on hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg daily for hypertension has a calcium of 10.9 mg/dL found on routine testing. PTH is 38 pg/mL (normal) and the 24-hour urine calcium is low. By which tubular mechanism does the thiazide raise her serum calcium?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-23.a: Inhibition of NCC lowers intracellular Na⁺ in the distal convoluted tubule, increasing basolateral Na⁺/Ca²⁺ exchange and apical Ca²⁺ entry
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-23.p: Thiazide: Na⁺i ↓ → NCX ↑ → ดูด Ca กลับ ↑

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-24.s: A 19-year-old man has BP 172/104 mmHg, K⁺ 2.9 mmol/L and HCO₃⁻ 31 mmol/L. Plasma renin and aldosterone are both suppressed. His father developed hypertension in his twenties. His BP falls with amiloride but not with spironolactone. Which disorder is most likely?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-24.p: Liddle: HT + K ต่ำ + renin/aldo ต่ำ → ตอบ amiloride

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-25.s: A 71-year-old man started on chlorthalidone 25 mg daily is found 3 weeks later to have K⁺ 2.9 mmol/L and HCO₃⁻ 33 mmol/L. He has no vomiting or diarrhoea. Which explanation best links his hypokalaemia and metabolic alkalosis?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-25.a: Increased distal Na⁺ delivery and flow plus volume-induced aldosterone increase both K⁺ secretion by principal cells and H⁺ secretion by type A intercalated cells
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-25.p: Diuretic → Na ถึง CD + aldosterone → เสีย K⁺ และ H⁺ พร้อมกัน

MOCK-147.s: 52yo alcoholic cirrhotic with ascites prescribed Spironolactone. Physiological mechanism explaining action of Spironolactone in cirrhotic ascites?
MOCK-147.a: Competitive antagonism of aldosterone receptors in the late distal tubule and collecting duct, counteracting secondary hyperaldosteronism

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-26.s: A 42-year-old man with normal kidney function starts high-dose trimethoprim–sulfamethoxazole for Pneumocystis pneumonia. By day 4, serum creatinine has risen from 0.9 to 1.2 mg/dL and K⁺ from 4.2 to 5.3 mmol/L. Urine output, BUN and cystatin C are unchanged and urinalysis is bland. What is the best explanation for the creatinine rise?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-26.a: Trimethoprim inhibition of tubular creatinine secretion through organic cation transporters, without a true fall in GFR
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-26.p: Trimethoprim/cimetidine → sCr ↑ โดย GFR ไม่เปลี่ยน

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-27.s: A 67-year-old man with vomiting for 3 days has creatinine 3.0 mg/dL (baseline 1.0). He takes no diuretics. Spot urine: Na⁺ 20 mmol/L, creatinine 120 mg/dL; plasma Na⁺ 135 mmol/L. What is his FENa and its most likely interpretation?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-27.a: 0.37% — pre-renal AKI with intact tubular Na⁺ reabsorption

MOCK-165.s: 58yo man with sepsis develops oliguria, muddy brown granular casts, FeNa 2.8%, urine osmolality 290 mOsm/kg. Renal failure type?

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-28.s: Two days after transsphenoidal pituitary surgery, a 34-year-old man passes 8.6 L of urine per day. Plasma osmolality is 300 mOsm/kg, urine osmolality 100 mOsm/kg and urine flow 6 mL/min. Which pair of values and interpretation is correct?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-28.a: C_osm 2 mL/min, C_H₂O +4 mL/min — water diuresis
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-28.p: U_osm < P_osm → C_H₂O บวก → water diuresis (DI)

NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-29.s: A 64-year-old man with heart failure has received a continuous high-dose furosemide infusion for 3 days. Even when he becomes volume depleted with high ADH levels, his urine osmolality stays close to 300 mOsm/kg. Which explanation is best?
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-29.a: Blocking NKCC2 in the thick ascending limb abolishes the medullary osmotic gradient, so water cannot be drawn out of the collecting duct even with ADH
NEPH-PHY1-MCQ-29.p: Loop diuretic → medulla washout → U_osm ≈ 300 แม้ ADH สูง

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-01.s: A 66-year-old man with advanced chronic kidney disease has the following laboratory values: Na 138 mEq/L, glucose 90 mg/dL, BUN 112 mg/dL. He is alert and not thirsty. Which statement best explains why his brain cells are not shrinking despite the elevated calculated plasma osmolality?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-01.a: Urea crosses cell membranes freely, so his effective osmolality (tonicity) is about 281 mOsm/L
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-01.p: Urea เพิ่ม Posm แต่ไม่เพิ่ม tonicity

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-02.s: A 58-year-old woman with poorly controlled type 2 diabetes is brought in confused. Serum Na 128 mEq/L, glucose 900 mg/dL, BUN 28 mg/dL. Which best describes her sodium disorder?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-02.a: Hypertonic hyponatremia because glucose draws water out of cells and dilutes sodium
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-02.p: Na ต่ำ + glucose สูง → คำนวณ tonicity ก่อนเสมอ

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-03.s: A 30-year-old marathon runner collapses on a hot day after 4 hours of running with little fluid intake. Sweat is hypotonic to plasma. Compared with before the race, which set of changes is expected?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-03.a: ECF volume decreased, ICF volume decreased, body fluid osmolarity increased
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-03.p: เหงื่อ = เสียน้ำ > เกลือ → hyperosmotic contraction

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-04.s: A 42-year-old woman with primary adrenal insufficiency presents with fatigue and postural hypotension. Serum Na is 124 mEq/L. Which combination of changes is expected (compared with normal)?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-04.a: Blood volume ↓, plasma osmolarity ↓, RBC volume ↑, hematocrit ↑, plasma protein ↑

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-05.s: A 25-year-old man loses 1.5 L of blood after a motorcycle accident. Renal sympathetic activity and angiotensin II rise, constricting the efferent arteriole more than the afferent arteriole. Which change in the peritubular capillary best explains the increased proximal tubular Na reabsorption?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-05.a: Lower hydrostatic pressure and higher oncotic pressure in the peritubular capillary because filtration fraction rises

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-06.s: Which statement best defines glomerulotubular balance?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-06.a: The proximal tubule reabsorbs a nearly constant fraction of the filtered Na load when GFR changes
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-06.p: GT balance = PT ดูดเป็นสัดส่วนคงที่ · TGF = macula densa ปรับ GFR

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-07.s: A 38-year-old woman with Addison disease presents with Na 126 mEq/L and K 6.2 mEq/L. Which mechanism best explains her hyperkalemia?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-07.a: Lack of aldosterone reduces ENaC-mediated Na entry in principal cells, so the lumen is less negative and K secretion falls
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-07.p: ขาด aldosterone → ไม่ดูด Na ที่ P cell → ไม่ขับ K

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-08.s: In a patient with acute volume overload, atrial stretch releases atrial natriuretic peptide (ANP). Which effect of ANP contributes to natriuresis?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-08.a: Dilation of the afferent arteriole and relaxation of mesangial cells, increasing GFR
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-08.p: ANP = เบรกของ RAAS/ADH + เพิ่ม GFR

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-09.s: Two days after transsphenoidal pituitary surgery, a 45-year-old man passes 6 L of urine per day. Serum Na 149 mEq/L, plasma osmolality 302 mOsm/kg, urine osmolality 90 mOsm/kg. After subcutaneous desmopressin, urine osmolality rises to 450 mOsm/kg. What is the most likely diagnosis?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-09.p: Posm สูง + Uosm ต่ำ → DI · ตอบ desmopressin = central

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-10.s: Which sequence correctly describes how ADH increases water reabsorption in the collecting duct?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-10.a: V2 receptor → Gs → cAMP → protein kinase A → insertion of aquaporin-2 into the apical membrane of principal cells

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-11.s: An 84-year-old bedridden woman with dementia has had poor oral intake for 4 days during a heat wave. BP 96/60 mmHg lying, HR 112/min. Serum Na 151 mEq/L, BUN 64 mg/dL, Cr 1.9 mg/dL. Which urine findings are most consistent with her physiological response?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-11.a: Urine osmolality 820 mOsm/kg, urine Na 10 mEq/L, FENa 0.3%
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-11.p: ขาดน้ำ + ไตปกติ → Uosm สูง UNa ต่ำ FENa < 1%

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-12.s: A 52-year-old man drinks about 6 L of beer daily and eats almost nothing; his daily solute intake is about 300 mOsm. His kidneys can dilute urine to a minimum of 60 mOsm/kg. What is the maximum volume of water he can excrete per day before plasma Na starts to fall?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-12.p: ไตขับน้ำได้ = solute load ÷ Uosm ต่ำสุด

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-13.s: A 70-year-old woman with pneumonia has serum Na 124 mEq/L, plasma osmolality 258 mOsm/kg, urine osmolality 480 mOsm/kg, and urine Na 52 mEq/L. She is clinically euvolemic and not taking diuretics; TSH and cortisol are normal. Why is her urine Na high?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-13.a: Water retention mildly expands the ECF, suppressing renin–aldosterone and increasing ANP and GFR, so the kidney excretes Na
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-13.p: SIADH: UNa สูงเพราะไตตอบสนองต่อปริมาตรที่เกินเล็กน้อย

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-14.s: A 48-year-old man with alcohol use disorder and poor intake is admitted with serum Na 112 mEq/L and K 2.9 mEq/L; he is mildly confused but has no seizures. He receives 0.9% saline and KCl, and 24 hours later his Na is 128 mEq/L. Three days later he develops dysarthria, dysphagia and quadriparesis. Which mechanism best explains this complication?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-14.a: The rapid rise in ECF tonicity drew water out of brain cells that had lost organic osmolytes during adaptation, injuring oligodendrocytes
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-14.p: Na ขึ้นเร็วใน hyponatremia เรื้อรัง → น้ำออกจากเซลล์สมอง → ODS

MOCK-170.s: 70yo woman with severe vomiting/diarrhea, Na 105 mEq/L, BP 85/50, hypovolemic. Appropriate initial fluid therapy?
MOCK-170.a: Intravenous 3% Hypertonic Saline bolus (or 0.9% Normal Saline carefully) to raise serum sodium by 4–6 mEq/L rapidly while avoiding overcorrection > 8–10 mEq/L in 24 hours

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-15.s: A 62-year-old man on hemodialysis misses two sessions. Serum K is 7.8 mEq/L and the ECG shows peaked T waves, a prolonged PR interval and a widened QRS complex. Which mechanism best explains the widened QRS?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-15.a: Sustained depolarization of the resting membrane potential inactivates voltage-gated Na channels, slowing phase 0 and conduction
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-15.p: QRS กว้างใน K สูง = Na channel inactivation

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-16.s: A 24-year-old woman with severe asthma receives continuous nebulized salbutamol for 6 hours. Her serum K falls from 4.1 to 2.9 mEq/L; urine K excretion is low. What is the mechanism?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-16.a: β2-adrenergic stimulation increases Na/K-ATPase activity in skeletal muscle, shifting K into cells
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-16.p: β2-agonist → K เข้าเซลล์ (ใช้รักษา K สูงได้)

MOCK-173.s: CKD stage 5 patient with K+ 7.2 mEq/L, ECG showing peaked T waves and QRS widening. Intervention administered FIRST to stabilize cardiac membrane?

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-17.s: A 70-year-old woman with heart failure starts furosemide 80 mg/day. Two weeks later her K is 2.9 mEq/L and HCO3 is 31 mEq/L. Which mechanism contributes most directly to her hypokalemia?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-17.a: Increased Na delivery and flow to the principal cells, plus volume-contraction–induced aldosterone, enhance K secretion
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-17.p: Loop/thiazide → Na/flow ส่วนปลาย + aldosterone → K ต่ำ

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-18.s: A 55-year-old man with chronic alcohol use has K 2.6 mEq/L and Mg 1.0 mg/dL. Despite 120 mEq of IV KCl over 24 hours, his K remains 2.8 mEq/L with ongoing urinary K loss. What is the best explanation?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-18.a: Low intracellular Mg removes the normal block of ROMK channels, so principal cells keep secreting K until Mg is replaced
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-18.p: K ต่ำ + Mg ต่ำ → ให้ Mg ด้วย

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-19.s: A 22-year-old woman becomes anxious during an examination and breathes rapidly. She develops perioral numbness and carpopedal spasm. Total Ca 9.4 mg/dL, albumin 4.2 g/dL. ABG: pH 7.56, PaCO2 24 mmHg, HCO3 21 mEq/L. What explains her tetany?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-19.a: Alkalemia causes albumin to release H+ and bind more Ca, lowering ionized Ca and the threshold for nerve firing
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-19.p: หายใจเร็ว → alkalemia → ionized Ca ↓ → tetany

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-20.s: A 45-year-old man has recurrent calcium oxalate stones with 24-hour urine Ca of 380 mg. Which drug lowers urinary Ca, and by what mechanism?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-20.a: Hydrochlorothiazide, by blocking NaCl entry in the distal convoluted tubule, which enhances Ca reabsorption there (plus proximal reabsorption from mild volume contraction)
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-20.p: Thiazide ลด urine Ca · loop เพิ่ม urine Ca

MOCK-198.s: 30yo woman 24h post total thyroidectomy develops paresthesias, muscle cramps, positive Chvostek sign, serum Ca 6.2 mg/dL. Immediate management?

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-21.s: Use the Henderson–Hasselbalch equation. A patient has PaCO2 40 mmHg and HCO3 12 mEq/L. What is the arterial pH?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-21.p: pH = 6.1 + log(HCO3/0.03PaCO2) — HCO3 ครึ่ง ไม่ชดเชย → pH 7.10

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-22.s: The pKa of the bicarbonate buffer system (6.1) is far from normal plasma pH (7.4), yet it is the most important extracellular buffer. Why?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-22.a: It is an open system: CO2 generated by buffering is exhaled by the lungs and HCO3 is regenerated by the kidneys
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-22.p: HCO3/CO2 = ระบบเปิด (ปอด + ไต)

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-23.s: A 64-year-old man with diabetic nephropathy (eGFR 40 mL/min/1.73 m²) has Na 138, K 6.0, Cl 112, HCO3 18 mEq/L; urine pH 5.2. Plasma renin and aldosterone are low. What is the main reason he cannot excrete his daily acid load normally?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-23.a: Hypoaldosteronism with hyperkalemia suppresses proximal ammoniagenesis, so NH4 excretion falls (type 4 RTA)
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-23.p: NAG acidosis + K สูง + urine pH < 5.5 → type 4 RTA

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-24.s: A healthy volunteer on a typical diet collects 24-hour urine: volume 1.5 L, titratable acid 20 mEq/L, NH4 30 mEq/L, HCO3 2 mEq/L. What is the net acid excretion?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-24.p: NAE = TA + NH4 − HCO3 (คูณปริมาตร)

MOCK-180.s: 45yo woman with muscle weakness, hypokalemia (K 2.6), metabolic acidosis (HCO3 14), urine pH persistently > 5.5 despite systemic acidemia. Diagnosis?

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-25.s: A 19-year-old woman with type 1 diabetes has had vomiting for 2 days and now seems drowsy. Glucose 480 mg/dL, Na 134, Cl 98, HCO3 8 mEq/L. ABG: pH 7.11, PaCO2 26 mmHg. What is the acid–base diagnosis?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-25.a: High anion gap metabolic acidosis with a concomitant respiratory acidosis
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-25.p: Winter: PaCO2 = 1.5 × HCO3 + 8 ± 2 — สูงกว่าช่วง = resp. acidosis ร่วม

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-26.s: A 46-year-old man with gastric outlet obstruction has vomited for 5 days. Na 132, K 2.8, Cl 82, HCO3 38 mEq/L; ABG pH 7.53, PaCO2 47 mmHg. Urine pH 5.5, urine Na 15 mEq/L, urine Cl 8 mEq/L. Why is his urine acidic despite alkalemia?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-26.a: Volume and Cl depletion, hypokalemia and high aldosterone drive H+ secretion and HCO3 reabsorption, maintaining the alkalosis
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-26.p: อาเจียน + urine pH ต่ำ + UCl ต่ำ = maintenance ด้วยปริมาตร/K → ให้ NSS + KCl

MOCK-135.s: Obtunded overdose patient, ABG: pH 7.32, PaCO2 60 mmHg, PaO2 70 mmHg, HCO3- 26 mEq/L. Correct blood gas interpretation?
MOCK-135.a: Acute respiratory acidosis with mild hypoxemia secondary to hypoventilation

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-27.s: A 35-year-old man with type 1 diabetes has vomited repeatedly for 3 days. Na 136, Cl 88, HCO3 16 mEq/L, glucose 520 mg/dL, albumin 4.0 g/dL. ABG: pH 7.34, PaCO2 31 mmHg. What is the most complete acid–base diagnosis?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-27.a: High anion gap metabolic acidosis with a coexisting metabolic alkalosis
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-27.p: Delta ratio > 2 ใน DKA = มีอาเจียน/alkalosis ร่วม

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-28.s: A 40-year-old man is brought in 18 hours after drinking homemade liquor; he now complains of blurred vision. Na 138, Cl 100, HCO3 10 mEq/L, glucose 90 mg/dL, BUN 14 mg/dL, measured serum osmolality 330 mOsm/kg; serum ethanol undetectable. ABG: pH 7.26, PaCO2 23 mmHg. What is the most likely cause?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-28.p: AG กว้าง + osmolal gap กว้าง + ตามัว → methanol

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-29.s: A 30-year-old man had a complete T6 spinal cord injury 4 months ago. Urodynamics show involuntary detrusor contractions while the external urethral sphincter contracts simultaneously; he has recurrent UTIs and bilateral hydronephrosis. Which best explains this pattern?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-29.a: Interruption of pathways to the pontine micturition center leaves the sacral reflex intact but uncoordinated, causing detrusor–sphincter dyssynergia
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-29.p: SCI เหนือ sacral → reflex bladder + DSD

NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-30.s: Which receptor–effect pairing correctly describes bladder physiology?
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-30.a: Sympathetic hypogastric fibers relax the detrusor via β3 receptors and contract the internal sphincter via α1 receptors during filling
NEPH-PHY2-MCQ-30.p: β3 คลาย · α1 บีบหูรูดใน · M3 บีบ detrusor · N หูรูดนอก

N-OLD-004.s: A woman has calcium 12.5 mg/dL with phosphate 1.9 mg/dL and elevated intact PTH. What is the mechanism?
