N-OLD-004.a: Excess parathyroid hormone increasing bone resorption, renal calcium reabsorption and phosphate excretion

NEPHRO-05-01-Q1.s: Which of the following best describes the direct action of FGF-23 on the kidney?
NEPHRO-05-01-Q1.a: It downregulates NaPi-2a and NaPi-2c in the proximal tubule and inhibits 1-alpha-hydroxylase
NEPHRO-05-01-Q1.p: FGF-23 ลดฟอสเฟตสองทาง — ขับออกทางไต และตัด calcitriol ไม่ให้ลำไส้ดูดซึม

NEPHRO-05-02-Q1.s: A 61-year-old man in the intensive care unit with septic shock and cirrhosis has a total serum calcium of 6.8 mg/dL (normal 8.6-10.2) and an albumin of 1.8 g/dL. He has no paresthesia, no carpopedal spasm, a negative Trousseau sign and a normal QTc interval. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
NEPHRO-05-02-Q1.p: อัลบูมินต่ำ + ไม่มีอาการ = ส่ง ionized calcium ก่อน อย่าเพิ่งรักษาตาม corrected calcium

N-MCQ-01.s: A 62-year-old woman is found to have a serum calcium of 11.2 mg/dL (normal 8.6-10.2) on a routine health check-up. She has no symptoms, takes no medication and no vitamin supplements. Serum phosphate is 2.1 mg/dL (normal 2.7-4.5), albumin 4.2 g/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL. Which of the following is the most likely cause of her hypercalcaemia?
N-MCQ-01.p: แยก PHPT จาก **familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia (FHH)** ด้วย **24-hour urine calcium และ calcium/creatinine clearance ratio** (FHH ขับ Ca ในปัสสาวะต่ำ <0.01) เพราะ FHH **ไม่ต้องผ่าตัด** — ถ้าผ่าไปจะไม่หาย

N-OLD-001.s: What is the most common cause of hypercalcaemia in the outpatient setting?

N-OLD-002.s: A 70-year-old asymptomatic man has calcium 11.0 mg/dL (8.6-10.2) and phosphate 1.1 mg/dL (2.7-4.5) with no drug history. What is the most likely cause?

N-OLD-003.s: A patient with bone metastases presents with drowsiness, polyuria and constipation. Which electrolyte abnormality is most likely?

N-OLD-014.s: A 77-year-old woman has severe back pain, anaemia, creatinine 2.8 mg/dL and calcium 12.8 mg/dL with lytic bone lesions. What is the most likely diagnosis?

N-MCQ-02.s: A 68-year-old woman with known breast cancer presents with 5 days of progressive drowsiness, polyuria, constipation and vomiting. Vital signs: PR 104/min, BP 96/62 mmHg, dry mucous membranes. Laboratory results: corrected calcium 14.8 mg/dL, phosphate 4.6 mg/dL, creatinine 2.6 mg/dL (baseline 0.8), intact PTH 4 pg/mL (low), albumin 3.2 g/dL. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial treatment?
N-MCQ-02.a: Intravenous isotonic saline to restore intravascular volume
N-MCQ-02.p: อาการของ hypercalcemia จำด้วย **"stones, bones, groans, thrones, psychiatric overtones"** (นิ่วไต, ปวดกระดูก, ปวดท้อง/ท้องผูก, ปัสสาวะมาก, ซึม/สับสน). ถ้าเป็นมะเร็งร่วมกับ **CRAB (hyperCalcemia, Renal failure, Anemia, Bone lesion)** ต้องนึกถึง **multiple myeloma**

N-OLD-013.s: A patient with metastatic cancer has calcium 14 mg/dL, drowsiness and creatinine 2.4 mg/dL. What is the correct order of treatment?
N-OLD-013.a: Intravenous isotonic saline first, then a bisphosphonate (with calcitonin for rapid effect)

N-OLD-007.s: What is the most common cause of hypocalcaemia in adults?

N-OLD-012.s: A patient with a round face, short stature and shortened fourth metacarpals has low calcium, high phosphate and a high PTH level. What is the diagnosis?

N-MCQ-04.s: A 54-year-old man with end-stage renal disease on maintenance haemodialysis has a corrected calcium of 7.2 mg/dL, phosphate 6.8 mg/dL, intact PTH 620 pg/mL and alkaline phosphatase 320 U/L. He is not taking calcium or vitamin D supplements. Which of the following best explains his hypocalcaemia?
N-MCQ-04.a: Reduced renal 1-alpha-hydroxylase activity with hyperphosphataemia-driven suppression of calcitriol synthesis
N-MCQ-04.p: ระวังภาวะ **tertiary hyperparathyroidism** — ต่อมกลายเป็น autonomous ทำให้ **Ca สูง** ได้ในที่สุด; และระวัง **calciphylaxis** เมื่อ Ca x PO4 product สูงมาก. ข้อสอบชอบถาม "most common cause of hypocalcemia" ซึ่งโดยทั่วไปตอบ **iatrogenic/post-surgical (hypoparathyroidism หลังผ่าตัดคอ)** แต่ในบริบท **ESRD ตอบ CKD-MBD**

N-OLD-008.s: What is the main mechanism of hypocalcaemia in end-stage renal disease?
N-OLD-008.a: Phosphate retention with reduced calcitriol production by the failing kidney

N-MCQ-06.s: A 34-year-old man with massive upper gastrointestinal bleeding receives 12 units of packed red cells and 6 units of fresh frozen plasma over 3 hours. He then develops peri-oral numbness, carpopedal spasm and a positive Trousseau sign. ECG shows a prolonged QT interval. Which electrolyte abnormality is most likely responsible?
N-MCQ-06.p: ภาวะแทรกซ้อนของ massive transfusion ที่ต้องจำ: **hypocalcaemia (citrate), hyperkalaemia, hypothermia, metabolic alkalosis (citrate → bicarbonate) หรือ acidosis จาก hypoperfusion, dilutional coagulopathy, TACO/TRALI**. ข้อสอบ MED ออกทั้ง "citrate toxicity ทำให้ electrolyte ใดตก" และ "ให้เลือดแล้ว volume overload → TACO"

N-OLD-009.s: Which electrolyte falls as a result of citrate toxicity after massive blood transfusion?

NEPHRO-05-07-Q1.s: A 58-year-old man with stage 3b chronic kidney disease (eGFR 34 mL/min/1.73 m2) has a serum phosphate of 3.6 mg/dL (normal 2.7-4.5), calcium 9.1 mg/dL, intact PTH 180 pg/mL (high) and a markedly elevated FGF-23. Which of the following best explains why his serum phosphate is still normal?
NEPHRO-05-07-Q1.a: FGF-23 and PTH have increased the fractional excretion of phosphate by the remaining nephrons
NEPHRO-05-07-Q1.p: ฟอสเฟตปกติใน CKD ระยะกลางคือผลของ FGF-23 และ PTH ที่สูงไปแล้ว ไม่ใช่สัญญาณว่าแกนนี้ยังปกติ

N-MCQ-05.s: A 42-year-old man with acute lymphoblastic leukaemia and a high white cell count develops oliguria, nausea and muscle cramps 24 hours after his first cycle of chemotherapy. Which of the following laboratory findings would NOT be expected in this condition?
N-MCQ-05.p: Cairo-Bishop criteria: **laboratory TLS** = ความผิดปกติอย่างน้อย 2 อย่างใน (uric acid, K, PO4 สูง / Ca ต่ำ) ภายใน 3 วันก่อน–7 วันหลังเริ่มรักษา; **clinical TLS** = laboratory TLS + **Cr สูงขึ้น / arrhythmia / ชัก**

N-OLD-005.s: Which finding is NOT expected in tumour lysis syndrome?

N-OLD-006.s: A patient with acute leukaemia develops K 5.6 mEq/L, calcium 7.8 mg/dL, phosphate 6.8 mg/dL and creatinine rising 1 day after the first chemotherapy. What is the diagnosis and the key preventive measure?
N-OLD-006.a: Tumour lysis syndrome; aggressive intravenous hydration with rasburicase or allopurinol in high-risk patients

NEPHRO-05-09-Q1.s: A 46-year-old man is admitted after 3 weeks of almost no oral intake. On the second day of enteral feeding he develops generalised weakness and is unable to be weaned from the ventilator. Serum phosphate is 1.0 mg/dL (normal 2.7-4.5), potassium 2.9 mEq/L and magnesium 1.2 mg/dL. Spot urine studies give a fractional excretion of phosphate of 6%. Which of the following best explains his hypophosphataemia?
NEPHRO-05-09-Q1.a: Insulin-driven shift of phosphate from the extracellular fluid into cells after refeeding
NEPHRO-05-09-Q1.p: ฟอสเฟตต่ำ + K ต่ำ + Mg ต่ำ หลังเริ่มให้อาหาร = refeeding syndrome · FE phosphate ต่ำยืนยันว่าไตไม่ได้รั่ว

NEPHRO-05-09-Q2.s: A 39-year-old woman has had 2 years of progressive bone pain, proximal muscle weakness and two low-trauma fractures. Serum phosphate is 1.4 mg/dL (normal 2.7-4.5), calcium 9.4 mg/dL, intact PTH normal, 25-hydroxyvitamin D normal and the fractional excretion of phosphate is 35%. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
NEPHRO-05-09-Q2.a: Tumour-induced osteomalacia from ectopic FGF-23 secretion
NEPHRO-05-09-Q2.p: ฟอสเฟตต่ำจากไตรั่ว + แคลเซียมและ PTH ปกติ ในผู้ใหญ่ = FGF-23 เกิน ให้ตามหาเนื้องอก

NEPHRO-05-10-Q1.s: A 52-year-old woman receiving cetuximab for metastatic colorectal cancer has a serum magnesium of 1.1 mg/dL (normal 1.7-2.4). She has no diarrhoea and is not taking diuretics or proton pump inhibitors. Serum creatinine is 0.9 mg/dL. A spot urine gives a fractional excretion of magnesium of 8%. Which mechanism best explains her hypomagnesaemia?
NEPHRO-05-10-Q1.a: Blockade of EGFR reduces TRPM6 in the luminal membrane of the distal convoluted tubule
NEPHRO-05-10-Q1.p: แมกนีเซียมต่ำในคนที่ได้ cetuximab = EGFR ถูกบล็อก → TRPM6 ที่ DCT ลดลง → ไตรั่ว

N-MCQ-03.s: A 16-year-old girl with acute lymphoblastic leukaemia has been hospitalised for 2 months and has received multiple courses of amphotericin B for candidaemia. Over the past 2 weeks she has had persistent hypokalaemia (potassium 2.8-3.1 mEq/L) despite daily oral and intravenous potassium replacement. Renal function is normal and she is not vomiting or taking diuretics. Which additional laboratory value should be checked, and would it be expected to be high or low?
N-MCQ-03.p: ท่องเป็นกฎ: **"แก้ K ไม่ขึ้น ให้ดู Mg; แก้ Ca ไม่ขึ้น ให้ดู Mg"** — Mg ต่ำทำให้ทั้ง hypokalemia และ hypocalcemia ดื้อต่อการรักษา และเป็นสาเหตุของ **torsades de pointes**

N-OLD-010.s: A 16-year-old girl with leukaemia on prolonged amphotericin B has persistent hypokalaemia despite daily potassium replacement. Which additional test is most useful?

N-OLD-011.s: A patient with HIV on amphotericin B for 1 week develops proximal muscle weakness grade 3. Which investigation should be sent first?
N-OLD-011.a: Serum electrolytes including potassium and magnesium

N-OLD-015.s: Which statement about magnesium is correct?
N-OLD-015.a: Hypomagnesaemia causes refractory hypokalaemia and hypocalcaemia and must be corrected first

NEPHRO-05-12-Q1.s: A 78-year-old woman with chronic kidney disease (eGFR 22 mL/min/1.73 m2) is admitted with drowsiness and constipation after taking a magnesium-containing laxative daily for a week. Blood pressure is 88/54 mmHg, heart rate 48/min, and her deep tendon reflexes are absent. Serum magnesium is 9.8 mg/dL (normal 1.7-2.4). Which of the following is the most appropriate immediate treatment?
NEPHRO-05-12-Q1.a: Stop the laxative and give intravenous calcium gluconate
NEPHRO-05-12-Q1.p: รีเฟล็กซ์หาย + ความดันต่ำ + หัวใจช้า ในคนไข้ CKD ที่กินยาระบายแมกนีเซียม = ให้แคลเซียมทางหลอดเลือดทันที

NEPHRO-05-12-Q2.s: A 29-year-old woman with severe pre-eclampsia is receiving an intravenous magnesium sulfate infusion. Which bedside finding should prompt the infusion to be stopped first?
NEPHRO-05-12-Q2.a: Loss of the patellar deep tendon reflex
NEPHRO-05-12-Q2.p: เฝ้าระวังพิษ MgSO₄ ด้วยรีเฟล็กซ์เอ็นลึก — รีเฟล็กซ์หายมาก่อนการกดการหายใจเสมอ

NEPH-GN-MCQ-01.s: A 7-year-old boy has generalized edema, urine protein 4+ with no red cells, serum albumin 1.6 g/dL and a normal serum creatinine. Kidney biopsy shows normal glomeruli on light microscopy and no immune deposits. Injury to which component of the glomerular filtration barrier best explains his heavy proteinuria?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-01.a: Podocyte foot processes and slit diaphragm
NEPH-GN-MCQ-01.p: albumin รั่วมาก + LM ปกติ = podocyte (foot process effacement)

NEPH-GN-MCQ-02.s: A 19-year-old man has persistent microscopic hematuria, mild proteinuria and progressive sensorineural hearing loss. His maternal uncle required dialysis at age 35. A defect in which structure is most likely?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-02.a: Glomerular basement membrane type IV collagen
NEPH-GN-MCQ-02.p: hematuria + หูหนวก + ประวัติครอบครัวฝั่งแม่ = Alport (GBM collagen IV)

NEPH-GN-MCQ-03.s: A 9-year-old girl develops facial puffiness, cola-colored urine and blood pressure 150/95 mmHg two weeks after a sore throat. Serum albumin is 3.8 g/dL. Which mechanism best explains her hypertension and edema?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-03.a: Primary renal sodium retention with expanded plasma volume and suppressed renin
NEPH-GN-MCQ-03.p: nephritic บวม + HT = โซเดียมคั่ง (overfill) renin ต่ำ · albumin ปกติ

NEPH-GN-MCQ-04.s: A 35-year-old woman says that for 3 weeks her eyelids are swollen on waking and the swelling 'moves' to her ankles by late afternoon; her urine has persistent froth. Which statement best explains this pattern?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-04.a: Periorbital tissue is loose with low tissue pressure, and fluid redistributes with posture through the day
NEPH-GN-MCQ-04.p: บวมรอบตาตอนเช้า → ขาตอนบ่าย + ปัสสาวะเป็นฟอง = บวมจากไต (โปรตีนรั่ว)

N-OLD-032.s: A patient presents with periorbital and bilateral leg oedema with very foamy urine. Which investigation should be ordered first?

NEPH-GN-MCQ-05.s: A 60-kg man collects a 24-hour urine sample for protein, which returns 1.1 g/day. The total urine creatinine in the same collection is 650 mg. What is the best interpretation?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-05.a: The collection is incomplete, so the true protein excretion is likely higher
NEPH-GN-MCQ-05.p: 24-h urine: creatinine ชาย 20–25 · หญิง 15–20 mg/kg/วัน — ต่ำกว่านี้ = เก็บไม่ครบ

NEPH-GN-MCQ-06.s: A first-morning spot urine sample shows protein 360 mg/dL and creatinine 90 mg/dL. Which estimate of daily protein excretion is most appropriate?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-06.p: UPCR (mg/dL ÷ mg/dL) ≈ กรัมต่อวัน

N-MCQ-08.s: A 46-year-old woman presents with 3 weeks of periorbital puffiness in the morning, bilateral leg oedema and frothy urine. Urine analysis shows specific gravity 1.020, protein 4+, glucose negative, RBC 0-2/HPF, WBC 0-1/HPF, and oval fat bodies with a Maltese cross appearance under polarised light. Serum albumin is 2.4 g/dL and total cholesterol 340 mg/dL. Which investigation is most appropriate to quantify the severity of her proteinuria in routine practice?
N-MCQ-08.a: Urine protein-to-creatinine ratio from a first-morning voided specimen
N-MCQ-08.p: **Oval fat body / Maltese cross** บน polarised light และ **fatty cast** เป็นลักษณะเฉพาะของ nephrotic range proteinuria — ออกทั้ง MCQ และ SAQ แปลผล UA ทุกปี

N-OLD-018.s: Which test is most appropriate to quantify proteinuria in a patient with suspected nephrotic syndrome?
N-OLD-018.a: Spot urine protein-to-creatinine ratio (or 24-hour urine protein)

N-OLD-025.s: A 65-year-old man has 3 months of malaise, Hct 25 percent, BUN/Cr 22/1.8 mg/dL, K 3.0 mEq/L, HCO3 18 mEq/L and 24-hour urine protein 3 g with a negative dipstick for albumin. What is the most likely diagnosis?
N-OLD-025.a: Multiple myeloma with light chain (cast) nephropathy

NEPH-GN-MCQ-07.s: A 58-year-old man with acute monocytic leukemia has urine protein of 2.4 g/day; serum albumin and creatinine are normal and the urine sediment is bland. Most of the urinary protein is lysozyme. What is the mechanism of his proteinuria?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-07.a: Filtered load of a small protein exceeding proximal tubular reabsorption
NEPH-GN-MCQ-07.p: โปรตีนเล็กในเลือดล้น (light chain, lysozyme, myoglobin, Hb) = overflow

N-MCQ-29.s: A 19-year-old male university athlete is found to have protein 1+ on a urine dipstick during a pre-participation screening performed in the afternoon after football practice. He is asymptomatic with no oedema. Blood pressure is 112/70 mmHg, creatinine 0.8 mg/dL, serum albumin 4.4 g/dL, and urine microscopy shows no red cells, no white cells and no casts. A first-morning urine specimen collected before rising shows protein negative, with a urine protein-to-creatinine ratio of 0.08 g/g. Which of the following is the most appropriate interpretation and management?
N-MCQ-29.a: Orthostatic or exercise-related functional proteinuria; reassurance with periodic annual urine testing
N-MCQ-29.p: โจทย์เก่าออกซ้ำสองรุ่นด้วยคำว่า "**ออกกำลังกาย มี protein ออกมา → functional proteinuria, annual checkup**" และ "**orthostatic proteinuria: proteinuria less than 1 g/day**" — เป็นข้อที่ได้คะแนนฟรีถ้ารู้ว่าต้องเก็บปัสสาวะเช้าแรก

N-OLD-078.s: A healthy young man has 1+ proteinuria after exercise, which disappears on a repeat sample taken at rest. What is the diagnosis and management?
N-OLD-078.a: Functional (exercise-induced) proteinuria; reassure and check annually

N-OLD-079.s: Which statement about orthostatic proteinuria is correct?
N-OLD-079.a: Protein excretion is normal in the recumbent first morning sample and less than 1 g per day overall, with a benign prognosis

N-OLD-028.s: A patient with generalised oedema has 2.5 g proteinuria per day with a bland urine sediment. Which mechanism of proteinuria is most likely?
N-OLD-028.a: Glomerular proteinuria from increased glomerular permeability

NEPH-GN-MCQ-08.s: A 24-year-old man develops dark red urine 2 days after an extreme cross-fit session. The urine dipstick is 3+ for blood, but microscopy shows 0–2 RBC/HPF; the urine supernatant remains red after centrifugation. Serum creatine kinase is 48,000 U/L. What explains the dipstick result?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-08.a: Myoglobin reacting with the heme peroxidase pad
NEPH-GN-MCQ-08.p: heme บวก + ไม่มี RBC + น้ำส่วนบนแดง = myoglobin หรือ hemoglobin

NEPH-GN-MCQ-09.s: Urine microscopy from a 30-year-old woman shows 25 RBC/HPF. Which finding most strongly localizes the bleeding to the glomerulus?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-09.a: Acanthocytes making up 8% of the red cells
NEPH-GN-MCQ-09.p: acanthocyte > 5% หรือ dysmorphic > 50% หรือ RBC cast = glomerular

N-MCQ-11.s: A 30-year-old woman presents with red-coloured urine. You suspect a glomerular source of bleeding. Which of the following findings would argue AGAINST a glomerular origin?
N-MCQ-11.a: Blood clots passed in the urine
N-MCQ-11.p: ชุดคำ "**smoking + painless gross haematuria**" = ต้องคิดถึง **bladder cancer** → investigation of choice คือ **cystoscopy** (ออกใน MED34 ครั้งที่ 4 ข้อ 4 และ MED35 ข้อ 35)

N-OLD-026.s: Red blood cells in the urine with dysmorphic forms and red cell casts indicate bleeding from which site?

N-OLD-027.s: Which finding argues AGAINST a glomerular source of haematuria?

N-OLD-030.s: Urinalysis shows RBC 50-100/HPF with dysmorphic forms, trace protein, no glucose and WBC 0-1/HPF. Which set of differential diagnoses is most appropriate?
N-OLD-030.a: Post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis, IgA nephropathy and rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis

NEPH-GN-MCQ-10.s: A 52-year-old woman has creatinine that rose from 0.9 to 2.4 mg/dL over 5 weeks, with dysmorphic red cells, red cell casts and urine protein 1.5 g/day. Which glomerular syndrome is this?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-10.p: creatinine เพิ่มเกินเท่าตัวในไม่กี่สัปดาห์ + RBC cast = RPGN → หา anti-GBM/ANCA/C3 และเจาะไตด่วน

NEPH-GN-MCQ-11.s: In which location do immune deposits typically produce heavy proteinuria with a bland urine sediment, because circulating inflammatory cells cannot reach them?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-11.a: Subepithelial space on the outer side of the GBM
NEPH-GN-MCQ-11.p: subepithelial (MN) = รั่วไม่อักเสบ · subendothelial (LN IV) = อักเสบ

N-MCQ-07.s: Which of the following is NOT part of the diagnostic criteria for nephrotic syndrome?
N-MCQ-07.a: Microscopic haematuria with dysmorphic red blood cells
N-MCQ-07.p: บางโรคมาเป็น **nephritic-nephrotic overlap** (เช่น lupus nephritis class IV, membranoproliferative GN, diffuse proliferative GN) — เจอ proteinuria หนักร่วมกับ dysmorphic RBC/RBC cast ได้ จึงต้องอ่าน UA ให้ครบทุกองค์ประกอบ ไม่ฟันธงจากข้อเดียว

N-OLD-016.s: Which of the following is NOT part of the diagnostic criteria for nephrotic syndrome?

MOCK-166.s: 20yo male with generalized edema, 24h urine protein 6.5 g/day, albumin 2.1 g/dL, cholesterol 380 mg/dL, oval fat bodies in urine. Clinical syndrome?

NEPH-GN-MCQ-12.s: A 40-year-old man with nephrotic syndrome (albumin 2.0 g/dL, urine protein 8 g/day) has low total T4 but normal free T4 and TSH. He has no thyroid symptoms. What is the best interpretation?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-12.a: Urinary loss of thyroxine-binding globulin with normal thyroid function
NEPH-GN-MCQ-12.p: nephrotic: T4 รวมต่ำ / Ca รวมต่ำ จากโปรตีนจับรั่ว — ดู free T4, ionized Ca

NEPH-GN-MCQ-13.s: A patient with nephrotic syndrome (albumin 1.9 g/dL) remains edematous despite oral furosemide 40 mg daily. Which mechanism best explains the diuretic resistance?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-13.a: Reduced albumin-bound delivery to the proximal tubule and binding of furosemide by albumin within the tubular lumen
NEPH-GN-MCQ-13.p: albumin ต่ำ = furosemide ส่งถึงท่อน้อย + ถูกจับในท่อ → ขนาดสูง ± thiazide/amiloride

N-OLD-017.s: A patient has foamy urine, periorbital oedema and urine microscopy showing oval fat bodies and fatty casts. What is the diagnosis?

N-OLD-075.s: Fatty casts and oval fat bodies in the urine indicate which condition?

N-MCQ-12.s: A 20-year-old man presents with 1 week of rapidly progressive periorbital and leg oedema. Urine protein is 4+ with a urine protein-to-creatinine ratio of 9 g/g, serum albumin 1.8 g/dL, total cholesterol 420 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, and urine microscopy shows no red cells and no casts apart from occasional fatty casts. Complement levels, ANA, HBsAg, anti-HCV and anti-HIV are all negative. He is started on prednisolone 1 mg/kg/day. Two days later he develops sudden right flank pain, gross haematuria and a rise in creatinine to 2.1 mg/dL. Which of the following is the most likely explanation?
N-MCQ-12.a: Renal vein thrombosis related to the hypercoagulable state of nephrotic syndrome
N-MCQ-12.p: MCD ในผู้ใหญ่: ต้องคัด **secondary cause** ทุกราย — **NSAID, lithium, interferon, Hodgkin lymphoma และมะเร็งทางโลหิตวิทยา**; ตอบสนองต่อ steroid ดีมาก (>80%) แต่ **relapse บ่อย**

N-OLD-019.s: Which complication is characteristic of nephrotic syndrome?
N-OLD-019.a: Venous thromboembolism from urinary loss of antithrombin III

NEPH-GN-MCQ-14.s: A 68-year-old woman has chronic sinusitis, creatinine rising from 1.0 to 3.1 mg/dL over 4 weeks and red cell casts. Kidney biopsy shows crescents in 60% of glomeruli with little or no immunoglobulin or complement staining. Which test is most likely positive?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-14.p: crescent + IF ว่าง = pauci-immune = ANCA

NEPH-GN-MCQ-15.s: A 45-year-old man has hypertension, creatinine 4.8 mg/dL that has been rising for 3 years, urine protein 2.5 g/day and dysmorphic hematuria. Ultrasound shows both kidneys measuring 8 cm with thin echogenic cortex. What is the most appropriate next step?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-15.a: CKD care: BP control, RAS blockade as tolerated and preparation for kidney replacement therapy, without biopsy
NEPH-GN-MCQ-15.p: ไตเล็ก + เสื่อม > 3 เดือน = CGN → ดูแลแบบ CKD ไม่เจาะไต

MOCK-177.s: 50yo man with hemoptysis and rapidly progressive renal failure, crescents > 80% glomeruli, IF shows linear IgG along GBM, anti-GBM positive. Diagnosis?

NEPH-GN-MCQ-16.s: A 38-year-old man with BMI 46 kg/m² has urine protein 2.6 g/day, serum albumin 3.9 g/dL, no edema and creatinine 1.3 mg/dL. Biopsy shows perihilar segmental sclerosis with enlarged glomeruli and only segmental foot-process effacement. What is the best management?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-16.p: FSGS + อ้วน + albumin ปกติ + effacement เป็นหย่อม = adaptive → ACEi/ARB + ลดน้ำหนัก

NEPH-GN-MCQ-17.s: A 70-kg 30-year-old man has biopsy-proven minimal change disease. According to the dosing in the lecture (KDIGO), which initial regimen is correct?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-17.a: Prednisolone 70 mg daily for at least 4 weeks (up to 16 weeks if not in complete remission), then taper
NEPH-GN-MCQ-17.p: MCD: 1 mg/kg/วัน (max 80) ≥ 4 สัปดาห์ ถึง 16 สัปดาห์ → ลด 5–10 มก./สัปดาห์

N-OLD-021.s: A 20-year-old man has sudden onset generalised oedema with nephrotic-range proteinuria, normal renal function and no haematuria. What is the most likely diagnosis?

N-OLD-022.s: A patient with minimal change disease on high-dose prednisolone develops acute kidney injury 2 weeks later with sterile pyuria and WBC casts. What is the most likely cause?
N-OLD-022.a: Acute interstitial nephritis from a concurrent drug

N-MCQ-09.s: A 25-year-old man is evaluated for swelling of the feet and legs. He has a 5-year history of HIV infection and has refused antiretroviral therapy. Vital signs: temperature normal, BP 138/84 mmHg, PR 86/min, RR 20/min, BMI 23. Cardiopulmonary and abdominal examinations are normal. There is 2+ presacral and 3+ bilateral lower extremity oedema. Laboratory studies: CD4 count 140 cells/microlitre, HIV RNA 120,000 copies/mL, HBsAg negative, anti-HCV negative, VDRL negative, ANA negative, BUN/creatinine 18/1.5 mg/dL, urine examination protein 4+ with RBC 2-3/HPF and WBC 2-3/HPF, 24-hour urine protein 12 grams. Renal ultrasonography shows bilaterally enlarged kidneys with increased echogenicity. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
N-MCQ-09.p: ใน HIV ที่มีโรคไต ต้องแยก 3 กลุ่ม: **(1) HIVAN (collapsing FSGS) (2) HIV-immune complex kidney disease (3) โรคไตจากยา** เช่น **tenofovir disoproxil fumarate → proximal tubulopathy/Fanconi syndrome** และ **indinavir/atazanavir → crystalluria/นิ่ว**

N-OLD-023.s: A 25-year-old man with untreated HIV has 24-hour urine protein 12 g and ultrasound showing bilaterally enlarged echogenic kidneys. What is the most likely lesion?

N-OLD-024.s: A 37-year-old man with generalised oedema, albumin 2.8 g/dL, urine protein 3+ without significant RBC or WBC, and linear scars over the arms has which likely underlying cause?
N-OLD-024.a: Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis related to intravenous drug use

MOCK-168.s: 6yo boy with nephrotic syndrome, light microscopy normal, electron microscopy shows diffuse effacement of podocyte foot processes. Diagnosis and first-line treatment?

MOCK-167.s: Early diabetic nephropathy hemodynamic mechanism initiating disease?
MOCK-167.a: Glomerular hyperfiltration and intraglomerular hypertension driven by afferent arteriolar vasodilation

NEPH-GN-MCQ-18.s: A 56-year-old man with membranous nephropathy (albumin 1.7 g/dL, urine protein 11 g/day) suddenly develops left flank pain, gross hematuria and a new left-sided varicocele; creatinine rises from 1.0 to 1.7 mg/dL. Which complication is most likely?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-18.p: MN + ปวดสีข้าง + hematuria + varicocele ซ้าย = RVT

NEPH-GN-MCQ-19.s: A 47-year-old woman has nephrotic syndrome with normal eGFR, bland sediment and a strongly positive serum anti-PLA2R antibody. HBV, HCV, HIV, ANA and age-appropriate cancer screening are negative. According to KDIGO 2021, what is the status of kidney biopsy?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-19.a: Biopsy is not required to diagnose primary membranous nephropathy in this setting
NEPH-GN-MCQ-19.p: anti-PLA2R บวก + ภาพเข้ากับ MN ปฐมภูมิ → วินิจฉัยได้โดยไม่ต้องเจาะไต (KDIGO 2021)

N-OLD-020.s: A 55-year-old man with nephrotic syndrome and microscopic haematuria is found to have an underlying solid organ malignancy. Which glomerular lesion is most likely?

NEPH-GN-MCQ-20.s: Which sequence best describes the pathogenesis of IgA nephropathy?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-20.a: Galactose-deficient IgA1 is recognized by IgG autoantibodies, forming immune complexes that deposit in the mesangium
NEPH-GN-MCQ-20.p: IgAN = Gd-IgA1 + anti-glycan IgG → mesangial deposit

N-OLD-033.s: Which feature best distinguishes IgA nephropathy from post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis?
N-OLD-033.a: Haematuria occurring within 1-2 days of an upper respiratory infection with normal complement levels

MOCK-176.s: 22yo male with recurrent painless gross hematuria 1–2 days after URI onset ('synpharyngitic hematuria'), normal complement levels. Biopsy shows mesangial IgA deposition. Diagnosis?

NEPH-GN-MCQ-21.s: A 12-year-old boy with post-impetigo acute nephritic syndrome had low C3 at presentation. At 12 weeks, his blood pressure has normalized but C3 remains low and microscopic hematuria persists. What is the most appropriate next step?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-21.a: Kidney biopsy to look for C3 glomerulopathy, MPGN or lupus nephritis
NEPH-GN-MCQ-21.p: C3 ต่ำเกิน 8–10 สัปดาห์ = ไม่ใช่ PSGN ธรรมดา → เจาะไต

NEPH-GN-MCQ-22.s: A 7-year-old girl develops cola-colored urine and hypertension 5 weeks after impetigo. Which serologic test is most likely to document the preceding streptococcal infection?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-22.p: หลัง impetigo ใช้ anti-DNase B (70%) ดีกว่า ASO (30%)

N-MCQ-10.s: A 30-year-old man presents with occipital headache for 3 hours. Two weeks earlier he had fever and sore throat. Two days ago he noticed dark cola-coloured urine without frothiness and without dysuria. Vital signs: BT 37.0 C, PR 84/min, RR 18/min, BP 180/106 mmHg, BMI 27 kg/m2. Examination shows no pale conjunctivae, no injected pharynx, no CVA tenderness, no rash and no oedema. Laboratory results: urine analysis protein 1+, RBC 30-50/HPF with dysmorphic forms and occasional RBC casts, WBC 2-3/HPF; anti-streptolysin O titre elevated; C3 low with normal C4; creatinine 1.3 mg/dL. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis and the most important immediate management?
N-MCQ-10.a: Acute post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis; control blood pressure and restrict salt and water
N-MCQ-10.p: แยก **nephritic ที่ C3 ต่ำ**: APSGN (C3 ต่ำ C4 ปกติ, หายเอง), lupus nephritis (C3 **และ** C4 ต่ำ, ANA/anti-dsDNA positive), MPGN/C3 glomerulopathy (C3 ต่ำนานเกิน 8 สัปดาห์), infective endocarditis-associated GN (มีไข้เรื้อรัง murmur hemoculture positive)

N-OLD-029.s: A 30-year-old man has headache and cola-coloured urine 2 weeks after pharyngitis, with BP 180/110 mmHg, periorbital oedema, RBC casts and low C3. What is the diagnosis and treatment?
N-OLD-029.a: Acute post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis; salt and water restriction with antihypertensive therapy and penicillin for residual infection

MOCK-172.s: 7yo boy with tea-colored urine, facial edema, hypertension 2 wks post impetigo, dysmorphic RBCs, RBC casts, low C3, elevated ASO. Biopsy shows subepithelial humps. Diagnosis?

NEPH-GN-MCQ-23.s: A 29-year-old woman with SLE has edema, urine protein 6 g/day, bland sediment, normal creatinine and low-normal C3. Biopsy shows diffuse GBM thickening with subepithelial deposits and no endocapillary proliferation. Which ISN/RPS class is this?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-23.p: LN nephrotic ตะกอนใส + subepithelial = class V

NEPH-GN-MCQ-24.s: A 24-year-old woman with SLE has two urine tests a week apart showing protein 0.7 g/24 h and 10 RBC/HPF without infection; creatinine is normal. According to the lecture's criteria, what is the most appropriate next step?
NEPH-GN-MCQ-24.p: SLE + protein ≥ 0.5 g + RBC ≥ 5/HPF (หรือ cellular cast) → เจาะไต

N-OLD-031.s: A young woman with a photosensitive rash and arthritis has urine protein 3+ with RBC 30-50/HPF. What is the most likely diagnosis and the next step?
N-OLD-031.a: Lupus nephritis; send ANA, anti-dsDNA, complement levels and arrange renal biopsy

N-OLD-076.s: Urine sediment shows oval fat bodies together with dysmorphic red blood cells in a young woman with arthritis. What is the most likely diagnosis?
N-OLD-076.a: Lupus nephritis with a mixed nephrotic-nephritic picture

N-OLD-085.s: Urinalysis shows proteinuria, microscopic haematuria and pyuria in a young woman with a malar rash. What is the interpretation?

N-OLD-086.s: Which urine finding indicates significant proteinuria with lipiduria in lupus nephritis?
N-OLD-086.a: Oval fat bodies with a Maltese cross appearance under polarised light

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-01.s: A 30-year-old non-pregnant woman has two consecutive clean-catch urine cultures, taken one week apart for a pre-employment check-up, that both grow Escherichia coli at more than 100,000 CFU/mL. She has no urinary symptoms and no fever. Urinalysis shows WBC 10-20/HPF. Which term best describes her condition?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-01.p: ASB = เชื้อ ≥ 10⁵ (หญิง 2 ครั้ง) ไม่มีอาการ · pyuria ไม่ใช่เหตุให้รักษา

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-02.s: According to the classification used in the lecture, which of the following patients has a complicated urinary tract infection?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-02.a: A 40-year-old man with 1 day of dysuria and frequency without fever
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-02.p: Complicated = ปัจจัยของผู้ป่วย (ชาย DM ภูมิต่ำ ตั้งครรภ์ ปลูกถ่ายไต เป็นซ้ำ) ไม่ใช่ความรุนแรง

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-03.s: Uropathogenic Escherichia coli adhere to the bladder urothelium mainly through which interaction?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-03.a: Type 1 fimbriae (FimH) binding mannosylated uroplakin on umbrella cells
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-03.p: FimH–uroplakin = กระเพาะ · PapG–globoside = ไต

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-04.s: A 64-year-old man without a urinary catheter or recent urologic procedure is admitted with fever. Urine culture grows Staphylococcus aureus at 100,000 CFU/mL. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-04.a: Obtain blood cultures and look for a source of bacteraemia such as endocarditis or abscess
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-04.p: S. aureus ในปัสสาวะ (ไม่มีสายสวน) → hemoculture + หาแหล่งในกระแสเลือด

N-OLD-091.s: A man with three urinary tract infections in 1 year has nitrite 1+ and a Gram stain showing gram-negative bacilli. Which organism is most likely?

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-05.s: A 29-year-old woman has 2 days of fever 39.1 C, chills, nausea and right flank pain. Percussion over the right costovertebral angle reproduces severe pain. Which mechanism best explains the flank pain and costovertebral angle tenderness?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-05.a: Inflammatory oedema of the renal parenchyma stretching the renal capsule, with pain carried by afferents entering T10–L1
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-05.p: ปวดเอวใน pyelo = แคปซูลไตถูกยืด (T10–L1)

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-06.s: A 66-year-old woman with long-standing type 2 diabetes and peripheral neuropathy presents with fever and confusion. She denies dysuria or urgency. Her post-void residual volume is 350 mL and urine culture grows Klebsiella pneumoniae. Why did she lack lower urinary tract symptoms?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-06.a: Diabetic autonomic neuropathy reduces bladder sensation and impairs emptying, so inflammation is not perceived and urine stagnates
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-06.p: เบาหวาน: กระเพาะชา + ปัสสาวะค้าง → UTI ที่ไม่มีอาการ lower tract

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-07.s: A 24-year-old sexually active woman complains of burning when urine touches the vulva, with a thick white vaginal discharge and itching. She has no urinary frequency or urgency and no suprapubic pain. Which diagnosis is most likely?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-07.p: External dysuria + ตกขาว ไม่มี frequency = vaginitis

N-OLD-098.s: Which chemotherapeutic agent causes haemorrhagic cystitis, and what prevents it?
N-OLD-098.a: Cyclophosphamide or ifosfamide; prevented by hydration and mesna

N-OLD-100.s: An elderly woman with an indwelling catheter and bacteriuria develops agitation and confusion. What is the most appropriate approach?
N-OLD-100.a: Search systematically for other causes of delirium before attributing it to the bacteriuria

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-08.s: A 27-year-old woman with dysuria and frequency has been voiding every 30 to 45 minutes all day. Dipstick of a random urine sample shows leucocyte esterase 3+ and nitrite negative. Culture later grows Escherichia coli at 100,000 CFU/mL. Which is the most likely explanation for the negative nitrite?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-08.a: The urine did not remain in the bladder long enough for nitrate to be reduced to nitrite
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-08.p: Nitrite ลบลวง: ปัสสาวะบ่อย ค้าง < 4 ชม. หรือเชื้อไม่มีเอนไซม์

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-09.s: A 52-year-old man receiving chemotherapy for lymphoma has fever 38.8 C. Absolute neutrophil count is 200/µL. Urinalysis shows WBC 0-1/HPF and leucocyte esterase negative, but urine and blood cultures both grow Escherichia coli. Which statement best explains the urinalysis?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-09.a: Without circulating neutrophils there are no cells to form pyuria, so a urinary source cannot be excluded by a normal urinalysis
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-09.p: Neutropenia: ไม่มี pyuria ไม่ได้แปลว่าไม่มี UTI

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-10.s: A 35-year-old woman with dysuria provides a urine sample. Microscopy shows squamous epithelial cells 20-30/HPF, WBC 10-15/HPF and mixed bacteria. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-10.a: Repeat the urinalysis on a properly collected clean-catch midstream specimen
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-10.p: Squamous epithelium มาก = ปนเปื้อน → เก็บใหม่

N-MCQ-26.s: A 46-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes presents with 2 days of fever, chills, right flank pain and dysuria. Vital signs: BT 39.0 C, PR 110/min, BP 108/68 mmHg. There is marked right costovertebral angle tenderness. Urine analysis shows protein 1+, nitrite positive, leucocyte esterase positive, WBC 80-100/HPF, RBC 5-10/HPF and numerous white blood cell casts. Gram stain of the urine shows gram-negative bacilli. Which of the following does the presence of white blood cell casts indicate?
N-MCQ-26.a: Involvement of the renal parenchyma rather than infection confined to the bladder
N-MCQ-26.p: เบาหวานเพิ่มความเสี่ยงรูปแบบรุนแรงของ UTI: **emphysematous pyelonephritis/cystitis, renal papillary necrosis, perinephric abscess, fungal UTI** — ถ้าเบาหวาน + pyelonephritis ที่ไม่ดีขึ้น ต้องนึกถึงกลุ่มนี้ทันที

N-OLD-074.s: White blood cell casts in the urine indicate inflammation at which site?
N-OLD-074.a: The renal parenchyma — pyelonephritis or acute interstitial nephritis

N-OLD-093.s: Which organism is suggested by nitrite-positive urine with gram-negative bacilli on Gram stain?
N-OLD-093.a: A member of the Enterobacteriaceae such as E. coli or Klebsiella

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-11.s: A 72-year-old man with a long-term urinary catheter has fever on day 3 of intravenous ceftriaxone for a catheter-associated urinary tract infection. The urine Gram stain shows Gram-positive cocci in chains. Which of the following is the most appropriate change in therapy?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-11.a: Switch to ampicillin, because enterococci are intrinsically resistant to cephalosporins
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-11.p: GPC in chains = Enterococcus → ampicillin (ดื้อ cephalosporin)

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-12.s: A 45-year-old man has 1 month of night fevers, fatigue and weight loss. Urinalysis repeatedly shows WBC 30-50/HPF and RBC 10-20/HPF, but routine urine cultures show no growth, and two courses of antibiotics have not helped. CT urography shows blunted, irregular calyces and a long stricture of the right ureter with hydronephrosis. Which diagnosis is most likely?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-12.p: Sterile pyuria + calyx ผิดรูป + ureter ตีบ = GU TB

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-13.s: A urine culture from a woman with dysuria reports three different organisms, each at 10,000 CFU/mL, including lactobacilli. Which interpretation is most appropriate?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-13.a: Contamination of the specimen; a properly collected specimen should be repeated
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-13.p: ≥ 3 ชนิด (โดยเฉพาะมี lactobacilli) = ปนเปื้อน → เก็บใหม่

N-MCQ-34.s: A 32-year-old woman presents with 2 days of dysuria, urinary frequency and suprapubic discomfort without fever or flank pain. Urine analysis shows leucocyte esterase positive, nitrite positive, WBC 30-40/HPF and bacteria. Which of the following statements about the diagnosis of her urinary tract infection is most accurate?
N-MCQ-34.a: A clean-catch midstream culture growing a single uropathogen at 100,000 colony-forming units per millilitre confirms the diagnosis, although 1,000 to 10,000 CFU/mL may be significant in a symptomatic woman
N-MCQ-34.p: ในไทยต้องนึกถึง **renal TB** เมื่อเจอ **sterile pyuria เรื้อรัง ร่วมกับ microscopic haematuria และปัสสาวะเป็นกรด** — ข้อสอบเก่าถาม "TB ลงไต ตรวจอะไร" → ส่ง **urine AFB/molecular test หลายครั้ง**

N-OLD-090.s: What quantitative threshold on urine culture supports the diagnosis of urinary tract infection in a symptomatic woman with a clean-catch specimen?
N-OLD-090.a: At least 10^5 CFU/mL of a single uropathogen (10^2-10^3 may suffice with typical symptoms)

N-OLD-102.s: A patient with sterile pyuria and chronic urinary symptoms from a TB-endemic area should have which investigation?
N-OLD-102.a: Urine for acid-fast bacilli and molecular testing (Xpert MTB/RIF) on early morning samples

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-14.s: A 26-year-old non-pregnant woman has 2 days of dysuria, frequency and suprapubic pain. She has no fever, no flank pain and no vaginal discharge. She has no drug allergies and normal renal function. According to the lecture, which regimen is the first-line treatment?

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-15.s: A 31-year-old woman has fever 38.9 C, rigors and left costovertebral angle tenderness. A colleague suggests oral nitrofurantoin because her last cystitis responded well to it. Why is nitrofurantoin inappropriate?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-15.a: Nitrofurantoin achieves therapeutic concentrations in urine but not in renal tissue or blood
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-15.p: Nitrofurantoin/fosfomycin = ยาของกระเพาะ ไม่ถึงไต

N-OLD-104.s: A healthy young woman has 2 days of dysuria and frequency without fever or flank pain. What is the best management?
N-OLD-104.a: A short course of oral antibiotics for uncomplicated cystitis, guided by local resistance patterns

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-16.s: A 47-year-old woman with acute pyelonephritis has BP 82/48 mmHg despite 30 mL/kg of crystalloid, HR 124/min and lactate 4.6 mmol/L. Urine and blood cultures have been taken. According to the lecture, which empirical antibiotic is most appropriate?

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-17.s: A 33-year-old woman with acute uncomplicated pyelonephritis improved on intravenous ceftriaxone. On day 3 she is afebrile and eating. The Escherichia coli isolate is susceptible to cefixime but resistant to fluoroquinolones and trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole. She is switched to oral cefixime. According to the lecture, what should the total duration of therapy be?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-17.p: Pyelo step-down: 7 วัน · oral cephalosporin 10–14 วัน

N-OLD-096.s: After starting empirical meropenem for pyelonephritis, culture grows E. coli sensitive to ceftriaxone. What should be done?
N-OLD-096.a: De-escalate to ceftriaxone according to the culture result

MOCK-019.s: A 54-year-old woman presents with severe right flank pain, high fever (39.2°C), chills, and CVA tenderness. Urine dipstick shows leukocyte esterase (+), nitrites (+), and WBC casts. Which of the following is the best initial empiric antibiotic regimen?

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-18.s: A 58-year-old woman with diabetes has fever 39.5 C, right flank pain and BP 84/50 mmHg after fluid resuscitation. Intravenous meropenem has been started. Bedside ultrasound shows moderate right hydronephrosis, and CT shows an 8-mm stone in the right proximal ureter. Which is the most important next step?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-18.a: Urgent decompression of the right kidney by percutaneous nephrostomy or ureteric stent
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-18.p: Pyelo + อุดกั้น + ช็อก → ระบายด่วน (PCN/DJ stent)

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-19.s: A 67-year-old man was discharged 10 days ago after a 2-week admission with an indwelling urinary catheter. He now has fever, suprapubic pain and pyuria. According to the lecture, which empirical regimen is most appropriate while awaiting culture results?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-19.p: Complicated + nosocomial/MDR risk → pip/tazo, ceftazidime, cefepime

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-20.s: A 36-year-old woman has fever, left flank pain and pyuria with white blood cell casts. Contrast-enhanced CT shows several wedge-shaped, hypodense striations extending from the renal papillae to the cortex of the left kidney, without gas, hydronephrosis or a focal fluid collection. Which interpretation is most appropriate?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-20.a: Acute pyelonephritis, managed with antibiotics alone
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-20.p: CT: ลิ่มสามเหลี่ยมสีจาง = pyelo · ก้อนสีจางใหญ่ = ฝี

N-MCQ-33.s: A 52-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes is admitted with acute pyelonephritis and started on intravenous ceftriaxone. Urine and blood cultures grow Escherichia coli susceptible to ceftriaxone. After 72 hours she remains febrile at 38.8 C with persistent right flank pain, and her white cell count has not fallen. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
N-MCQ-33.a: Perform imaging of the kidneys and urinary tract to look for obstruction or abscess
N-MCQ-33.p: กฎ 72 ชั่วโมง: **"ไข้ไม่ลงใน 48-72 ชม. หลังยาที่เชื้อไว = หา abscess หรือ obstruction"** — ใช้ได้กับการติดเชื้อทุกระบบ (ปอด ช่องท้อง ข้อ ผิวหนัง) ไม่เฉพาะทางเดินปัสสาวะ

N-OLD-095.s: A patient with acute pyelonephritis remains febrile after 72 hours of appropriate intravenous antibiotics. Ultrasound shows a renal abscess. What is the management?
N-OLD-095.a: Continue antibiotics and arrange drainage (percutaneous or surgical) for source control

N-OLD-087.s: A patient with recurrent urinary tract infections has nitrite-positive urine and a staghorn stone in the left renal pelvis. Which organism is most likely?

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-21.s: A 64-year-old man has fever 39.4 C, chills, dysuria, perineal pain and difficulty voiding. Digital rectal examination reveals an exquisitely tender, warm, boggy prostate. Which action should be avoided?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-21.a: Vigorous prostatic massage to obtain expressed prostatic secretions
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-21.p: Acute prostatitis: ห้ามนวดต่อม

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-22.s: A 58-year-old man has had four episodes of Escherichia coli cystitis in 18 months, each with the same susceptibility pattern, and is asymptomatic between episodes. Urine culture after prostatic massage grows the same organism. Which treatment is most appropriate?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-22.a: A fluoroquinolone such as levofloxacin for 4–6 weeks
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-22.p: Chronic bacterial prostatitis → FQ 4–6 สัปดาห์

N-MCQ-32.s: A 70-year-old man has had three episodes of culture-proven urinary tract infection in the past year, twice with fever and perineal discomfort. He reports a weak urinary stream, hesitancy and nocturia. Vital signs are normal today. Which of the following should be performed to identify the most likely underlying cause?
N-MCQ-32.a: Digital rectal examination with assessment of post-void residual urine
N-MCQ-32.p: ธงแดงของ complicated/recurrent UTI ที่ต้องสืบค้น imaging: **เพศชาย, ไข้สูงหรือ bacteraemia, อาการไม่ดีขึ้นใน 48-72 ชม., นิ่ว, ไตเดียว, การตั้งครรภ์, ภูมิคุ้มกันบกพร่อง, เบาหวานคุมไม่ได้, คาสายสวน, เคยผ่าตัดทางเดินปัสสาวะ และเชื้อที่สร้าง urease (สงสัย struvite stone)**

N-OLD-094.s: An elderly man with recurrent urinary tract infections and perineal discomfort should have which examination?
N-OLD-094.a: Digital rectal examination to assess the prostate, with post-void residual measurement

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-23.s: A 41-year-old woman completed 7 days of ciprofloxacin for Escherichia coli pyelonephritis. Ten days after finishing therapy she again has fever and flank pain, and the urine grows Escherichia coli with an identical susceptibility pattern. How should this episode be classified, and what should be done?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-23.a: Relapse; image the urinary tract to look for a persistent focus such as a stone, abscess or obstruction
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-23.p: Relapse (≤ 2 สัปดาห์ เชื้อเดิม) → หาแหล่งด้วยภาพ

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-24.s: A 62-year-old postmenopausal woman has had three episodes of culture-proven cystitis in the past year. She has vaginal atrophy and no urinary tract abnormality on ultrasound. Vaginal oestrogen is prescribed. What is the mechanism by which it reduces recurrence?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-24.a: It restores glycogen-rich vaginal epithelium so lactobacilli recolonise and lower the vaginal pH, preventing Escherichia coli colonisation of the introitus
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-24.p: Vaginal estrogen → lactobacilli กลับมา → pH ต่ำ → E. coli เกาะไม่ได้

N-OLD-103.s: A patient with recurrent cystitis has nitrite-positive urine and a staghorn stone. What is the definitive management?
N-OLD-103.a: Complete surgical removal of the stone with antibiotic therapy

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-25.s: A 79-year-old bedridden man has had an indwelling urethral catheter for 2 months. He develops fever 38.7 C without another source. Before starting antibiotics, how should the urine specimen for culture be obtained?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-25.a: Replace the catheter and collect urine from the newly inserted catheter
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-25.p: CA-UTI: เปลี่ยนสายก่อนเก็บปัสสาวะส่งเพาะ

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-26.s: A 68-year-old woman in the intensive care unit with an indwelling catheter and receiving broad-spectrum antibiotics has Candida albicans at more than 100,000 CFU/mL in the urine. She is afebrile, has no urinary symptoms, and her neutrophil count is normal. No urologic procedure is planned. What is the most appropriate management?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-26.a: Remove or replace the catheter and stop unnecessary antibiotics, without antifungal therapy
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-26.p: Asymptomatic candiduria → ถอด/เปลี่ยนสาย ไม่ต้องให้ยาต้านเชื้อรา

N-OLD-099.s: A patient with a long-term indwelling urinary catheter has a urinary tract infection with gram-positive cocci in chains. Which organism is most likely?

N-OLD-101.s: A bedridden patient with a long-term catheter has purple discolouration of the urine bag. What is the cause?
N-OLD-101.a: Purple urine bag syndrome from bacterial indoxyl sulfate metabolism in alkaline urine

MOCK-020.s: A 62-year-old hospitalized patient with a Foley catheter develops dysuria and suprapubic discomfort. Urine culture grows Gram-negative lactose-fermenting bacilli with a prominent mucoid capsule. Which of the following is the most likely organism?

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-27.s: A 61-year-old woman with poorly controlled diabetes has severe right pyelonephritis. Non-contrast CT shows gas within the right renal parenchyma extending into the perinephric space, confined within Gerota's fascia. The left kidney is normal. According to the classification shown in the lecture, which class is this?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-27.p: IIIA = perinephric (ใน Gerota) · IIIB = เลย fascia

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-28.s: A 48-year-old woman with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease has fever 38.9 C and left flank pain. CRP is 160 mg/L. Urine culture is negative, and MRI suggests an infected cyst in the left kidney. Which antibiotic regimen is most appropriate?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-28.p: ADPKD cyst infection → levofloxacin/TMP-SMX 4–6 สัปดาห์

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-29.s: A 46-year-old woman with recurrent urinary tract infections has 3 months of left flank pain, low-grade fever and 6 kg weight loss. A firm left flank mass is palpable. Haemoglobin is 9.8 g/dL and ESR 98 mm/h. CT shows an enlarged non-functioning left kidney with a central staghorn calculus and multiple dilated low-attenuation spaces arranged like a bear's paw. Nephrectomy shows sheets of lipid-laden macrophages. Which diagnosis is most likely?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-29.p: XPN: นิ่ว + ก้อนไตข้างเดียว + bear's paw + foam cell

N-OLD-092.s: Which factor increases the risk of complicated urinary tract infection in a diabetic patient?
N-OLD-092.a: Glycosuria with impaired neutrophil function and possible neurogenic bladder

N-OLD-097.s: Which antidiabetic drug increases the risk of genitourinary infection?

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-30.s: A 72-year-old man is scheduled for transurethral resection of the prostate next week. He has no urinary symptoms or fever. Pre-operative urine culture grows Escherichia coli at more than 100,000 CFU/mL. What is the most appropriate management?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-30.a: Culture-directed antibiotic therapy started shortly before the procedure
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-30.p: ASB ก่อนหัตถการที่มีเลือดออก (TURP) → รักษาก่อนหัตถการ

NEPH-UTI-MCQ-31.s: An 84-year-old nursing-home resident with dementia has cloudy, foul-smelling urine noticed by staff. She is afebrile, eating normally, and her mental status is at baseline. Dipstick shows leucocyte esterase 2+ and nitrite positive. What is the most appropriate management?
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-31.a: No antibiotic treatment; ensure hydration and observe for genuine symptoms
NEPH-UTI-MCQ-31.p: ปัสสาวะขุ่น/มีกลิ่น + dipstick บวก ไม่มีอาการ = ASB ไม่ให้ยา

N-MCQ-30.s: A 26-year-old woman at 9 weeks of gestation has a routine screening urine culture that grows Escherichia coli at 100,000 colony-forming units per millilitre. She has no dysuria, no frequency, no fever and no flank pain. The organism is susceptible to amoxicillin, nitrofurantoin and trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
N-MCQ-30.a: Treat with amoxicillin and obtain a test-of-cure culture after therapy
N-MCQ-30.p: ยาปฏิชีวนะที่ **ห้าม/เลี่ยงในครรภ์**: **fluoroquinolone, tetracycline/doxycycline (ฟันและกระดูกทารก), aminoglycoside (ototoxicity), TMP-SMX (ไตรมาส 1 และ 3), chloramphenicol (grey baby), metronidazole (หลีกเลี่ยงไตรมาสแรกในบางแนวทาง)**

N-MCQ-31.s: A 58-year-old woman with well-controlled type 2 diabetes attends for a routine annual check-up. She feels well with no urinary symptoms, no fever and no flank pain. Urine analysis shows WBC more than 100/HPF, RBC few, nitrite positive and many bacteria. Urine culture grows Escherichia coli at 100,000 colony-forming units per millilitre. Creatinine is 0.9 mg/dL. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
N-MCQ-31.a: No antibiotic treatment; observation and patient education
N-MCQ-31.p: ในผู้สูงอายุที่มี **สับสนเฉียบพลัน (delirium)** แล้วตรวจพบ bacteriuria — **อย่ารีบสรุปว่าเป็น UTI** ต้องค้นหาสาเหตุอื่นของ delirium ให้ครบก่อน (ยา, ขาดน้ำ, ปวด, ท้องผูก, การติดเชื้ออื่น, metabolic) เพราะ ASB พบได้ถึง 20-50% ในผู้สูงอายุและมักเป็นตัวเบี่ยงเบนความสนใจ

N-OLD-088.s: A pregnant woman at 12 weeks has asymptomatic bacteriuria with more than 100,000 CFU/mL of E. coli. What is the management?
N-OLD-088.a: Treat with a pregnancy-safe antibiotic such as amoxicillin, cephalexin or nitrofurantoin (avoid in the third trimester) and repeat the culture

N-OLD-089.s: A woman with diabetes has a routine urinalysis showing WBC more than 100/HPF with many bacteria but no symptoms. What is the appropriate management?

MOCK-011.s: A 26-year-old pregnant woman at 12 weeks of gestation undergoes routine antenatal screening. Midstream urine culture yields > 10^5 CFU/mL of Escherichia coli. She reports no urinary symptoms. Which of the following is the most appropriate intervention?
MOCK-011.a: Administer oral Amoxicillin or Nitrofurantoin for 5–7 days

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-01.s: A 74-year-old man is admitted with a minor ischaemic stroke. He is alert and cooperative but has urge incontinence. A bladder scan after voiding shows 30 mL. Nurses request an indwelling catheter to keep him dry. What is the most appropriate management?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-01.a: Male external (condom) catheter with scheduled toileting
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-01.p: กลั้นไม่ได้แต่ไม่คั่ง → external catheter ไม่ใช่ Foley

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-02.s: A 32-year-old man with a T10 spinal cord injury has a neurogenic bladder with post-void residuals of 400–500 mL. He has normal hand function and wants to return to work. Which long-term bladder management is preferred?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-02.a: Clean intermittent self-catheterization several times a day
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-02.p: Neurogenic bladder + มือดี → CISC

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-03.s: Which of the following is an appropriate indication for placing an indwelling urethral catheter according to CDC/HICPAC 2009 guidance?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-03.a: Accurate hourly urine output measurement in a patient with septic shock on norepinephrine
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-03.p: วัดปัสสาวะรายชั่วโมง = ผู้ป่วยวิกฤตเท่านั้น

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-04.s: A 50-year-old woman with diabetes presents with fever 38.5 °C and flank pain (complicated UTI). She is alert, BP 121/80 mmHg, and walks to the toilet independently. How should urine for culture be obtained?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-04.a: Midstream clean-catch urine; no catheter unless retention is demonstrated
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-04.p: ปัสสาวะเองได้ → clean-catch ไม่ใช่ Foley

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-05.s: A 58-year-old man had an uncomplicated total hip replacement under spinal anaesthesia yesterday. A urinary catheter was placed in theatre. He is haemodynamically stable and drinking well. What is the best plan for the catheter?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-05.a: Remove it now (within 24 hours of surgery) and monitor voiding/post-void residual
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-05.p: Peri-operative catheter → ถอดภายใน 24 ชม.

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-06.s: A 76-year-old man with known benign prostatic hyperplasia develops inability to void for 10 hours after taking an over-the-counter cold remedy containing pseudoephedrine and chlorpheniramine. Which mechanism best explains his retention?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-06.a: α1-adrenergic stimulation increases smooth-muscle tone at the bladder neck and prostate, while antimuscarinic action weakens detrusor contraction
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-06.p: ยาแก้หวัด = α-agonist + anticholinergic → AUR ในชาย BPH

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-07.s: An 84-year-old woman with dementia in a nursing home becomes acutely agitated and is hitting staff. She is afebrile, BP 172/96 mmHg, HR 108/min. Her diaper is constantly damp with small amounts of urine. There is a tender, dull mass above the pubic symphysis. What is the most appropriate next step?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-07.a: Bladder scan and, if retention is confirmed, urinary catheterization
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-07.p: Delirium ในผู้สูงอายุ → คลำ/สแกนกระเพาะเสมอ

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-08.s: A 70-year-old man had an indwelling catheter placed for acute urinary retention due to BPH (1,100 mL drained). Renal function is normal. Which strategy most increases the chance of successful voiding when the catheter is removed?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-08.a: Start an α1-blocker (e.g., tamsulosin) for 2–3 days, then trial without catheter
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-08.p: AUR จาก BPH: alpha-blocker ก่อน TWOC

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-09.s: During urethral catheterization of an anxious 28-year-old man after appendicectomy, the catheter advances smoothly to about 16 cm and then meets firm resistance. He is tense and grimacing. What is the most likely cause and the best response?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-09.a: Contraction of the external urethral sphincter; pause, ask him to breathe slowly and strain gently as if voiding while maintaining gentle steady pressure
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-09.p: ติดที่ sphincter → ผ่อนคลาย/เบ่งเหมือนปัสสาวะ ไม่ใช่ดัน

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-10.s: Why is the penis held perpendicular to the body with gentle upward traction during male urethral catheterization?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-10.a: It straightens the mobile prepubic (penoscrotal) curve so that only the fixed subpubic curve remains

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-11.s: A 30-year-old man is brought in after a motorcycle crash. BP 86/50 mmHg, HR 128/min. Pelvic X-ray shows wide pubic symphysis diastasis. There is blood at the urethral meatus and a scrotal haematoma; the prostate cannot be palpated on rectal examination. Hourly urine output monitoring is needed. What is the most appropriate approach?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-11.a: Retrograde urethrogram and urological drainage by suprapubic catheter if urethral injury is confirmed
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-11.p: Blood at meatus + high-riding prostate → RUG/suprapubic

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-12.s: An 82-year-old bedbound man has had an indwelling urethral catheter for 2 years because of a hypocontractile bladder. The ventral meatus has eroded, splitting the glans down to the coronal sulcus. He still needs continuous drainage and cannot perform intermittent catheterization. What is the best option?

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-13.s: A 68-year-old man returns from transurethral resection of the prostate (TURP). His urine is heavily blood-stained with clots. Which catheter is most appropriate?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-13.a: 20–24 Fr 3-way catheter with continuous bladder irrigation
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-13.p: เลือดมาก ต้องล้าง → 20–24 Fr 3-way

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-14.s: A 45-year-old woman with spina bifida needs an indwelling catheter for about 8 weeks while awaiting reconstructive surgery. She reports lip swelling after dental procedures with rubber dams. Which catheter material is most appropriate?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-14.p: แพ้ latex/ใช้นาน → silicone

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-15.s: An intern inserts a 16 Fr Foley catheter in a 74-year-old man with a large prostate. After about 14 cm, urine appears in the tubing, so he inflates the balloon with 10 mL. The patient cries out in severe pain and blood appears at the meatus. What is the most likely explanation?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-15.a: The balloon was inflated in the prostatic urethra because the catheter had not been advanced to the bifurcation
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-15.p: ผู้ชาย: เห็นปัสสาวะยังไม่พอ ต้องดันถึง bifurcation

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-16.s: Why is sterile water, rather than 0.9% saline, recommended for inflating the balloon of a standard Foley catheter?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-16.a: Saline can crystallise in the narrow inflation channel, so the balloon may fail to deflate
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-16.p: Sterile water เติมบอลลูน — NSS ตกผลึกจนแฟบไม่ลง

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-17.s: In women with a short-term indwelling urethral catheter, by which route do most bacteria that cause catheter-associated bacteriuria reach the bladder?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-17.a: Extraluminally, ascending from the perineum along the outside of the catheter in the mucous film between catheter and urethra
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-17.p: CAUTI ส่วนใหญ่มาทางผิวนอกสาย

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-18.s: An 81-year-old man with BPH has had an indwelling urethral catheter for 3 weeks. He develops fever 38.8 °C, rigors and right costovertebral-angle tenderness. Chest X-ray and other examination show no alternative source. The catheter is still needed. What is the best management?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-18.a: Replace the catheter, send urine for culture from the newly placed catheter, then start empirical antibiotics
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-18.p: CAUTI + สาย > 2 สัปดาห์ → เปลี่ยนสาย เพาะเชื้อจากสายใหม่

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-19.s: A hospital infection-control team wants to reduce catheter-associated UTI on its medical wards. Which intervention is supported by CDC/HICPAC 2009 guidance?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-19.a: A daily review of catheter necessity with a nurse-driven removal protocol
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-19.p: ป้องกัน CAUTI = ไม่ใส่ + ถอดเร็ว

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-20.s: A 79-year-old man with BPH (prostate ~80 mL) is in acute urinary retention. A 14 Fr straight Foley catheter passes 16 cm and then stops; a second attempt with more lidocaine gel and the penis held at 90° also fails. There is no blood at the meatus. What is the most appropriate next step?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-20.a: Use a 16–18 Fr coudé (Tiemann) catheter with the tip pointing at 12 o'clock
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-20.p: BPH ใส่ไม่เข้า → 16–18 Fr coudé ชี้ 12 นาฬิกา

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-21.s: While catheterizing an obese 72-year-old woman, you cannot see the urethral meatus clearly. The catheter enters the vagina and no urine drains. What should you do?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-21.a: Leave the catheter in the vagina as a landmark and insert a new sterile catheter just above it, using a finger in the vagina to guide if needed
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-21.p: สายเข้าช่องคลอด → ทิ้งไว้เป็นจุดสังเกต ใช้สายใหม่ใส่ด้านบน

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-22.s: A 66-year-old man has persistent blood-stained urine with small clots 6 hours after a traumatic catheterization. He is haemodynamically stable and the catheter is draining. Which management should be avoided?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-22.a: Give systemic tranexamic acid to stop the bleeding
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-22.p: เลือดออกจากทางเดินปัสสาวะล่าง: ห้าม antifibrinolytic

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-23.s: An 80-year-old uncircumcised man with delirium had a urinary catheter inserted in the emergency department. The next morning the glans is swollen, purple and tender, with a tight band of oedematous foreskin proximal to it. What caused this and what is the immediate management?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-23.a: Retracted foreskin left behind the glans formed a constricting ring that obstructed venous and lymphatic return; reduce it manually after analgesia and compression, with urology help if this fails
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-23.p: ใส่สายในชายไม่ขลิบ → รูดหนังหุ้มกลับเสมอ

NEPH-CATH-MCQ-24.s: A 72-year-old man with chronic urinary retention from BPH has 2.4 L drained after catheterization. Creatinine is 3.4 mg/dL (baseline 1.1). Over the next 4 hours his urine output is 450–500 mL/h; BP falls from 150/90 to 104/62 mmHg and serum sodium rises from 138 to 147 mmol/L. Which statement best explains and manages this?
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-24.a: Pathologic post-obstructive diuresis from impaired tubular concentrating ability (reduced aquaporin-2, medullary washout); replace part of the hourly output (about one-half to three-quarters) with hypotonic saline and monitor electrolytes closely
NEPH-CATH-MCQ-24.p: POD pathologic: ทดแทนบางส่วน + เฝ้า electrolytes

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-01.s: Which renal imaging study primarily provides functional rather than anatomical information, such as split renal function and drainage?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-01.p: อยากรู้การทำงานแยกข้าง → nuclear

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-02.s: In the ACR Appropriateness Criteria, an imaging procedure rated 7–9 for a clinical scenario is classified as:
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-02.p: ACR 7–9 usually · 4–6 may be · 1–3 usually not

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-03.s: A plain abdominal radiograph of a febrile diabetic patient shows that the right psoas shadow, clearly visible on an old film, can no longer be seen. What is the best explanation?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-03.a: Fluid such as pus or blood replacing retroperitoneal fat and removing the fat–muscle interface
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-03.p: ขอบหาย = ไขมันถูกแทนที่ด้วยของเหลว

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-04.s: On a KUB radiograph, a small round calcification with a smooth margin and a radiolucent centre is seen in the lateral pelvis below the level of the ischial spines. It most likely represents:
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-04.p: กลม เรียบ กลางโปร่ง = phlebolith

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-05.s: During an intravenous urogram, the film taken about 1 minute after contrast injection (nephrographic phase) is mainly used to assess:
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-05.a: The renal parenchyma, contour and size

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-06.s: A patient with acute left ureteric obstruction undergoes an IVU. Which appearance of the left kidney is most typical?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-06.a: A delayed nephrogram that becomes increasingly dense, with delayed excretion into the collecting system
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-06.p: อุดกั้นเฉียบพลัน = delayed, increasingly dense nephrogram

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-07.s: On an IVU, the interpapillary line is no longer parallel to the renal outline: the cortex is focally thinned over a clubbed upper-pole calyx while the rest of the kidney is normal. The most likely diagnosis is:
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-07.a: Focal cortical scarring from chronic pyelonephritis / reflux nephropathy
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-07.p: เนื้อไตบางเฉพาะที่เหนือ calyx clubbed = แผลเป็น

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-08.s: A 68-year-old smoker with painless gross haematuria undergoes CT urography. In which phase is a small urothelial carcinoma of the renal pelvis best seen as a filling defect?

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-09.s: Why is a non-contrast series always obtained before contrast when CT is used to look for urinary tract stones?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-09.a: Excreted contrast has an attenuation similar to stones and can mask them
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-09.p: หานิ่ว: CT ไม่ฉีดสี

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-10.s: According to the 2020 ACR–NKF consensus, prophylactic IV volume expansion before intravenous iodinated contrast is indicated in which patient (assuming no contraindication to fluids)?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-10.a: A 70-year-old with eGFR 24 mL/min/1.73 m² who is not on dialysis
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-10.p: IV fluid ป้องกันเมื่อ eGFR < 30 หรือ AKI

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-11.s: A 60-year-old man with type 2 diabetes takes metformin. His eGFR is 55 mL/min/1.73 m² and stable. He needs a contrast-enhanced CT abdomen. What should be done with metformin?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-11.a: Continue it; no need to withhold
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-11.p: Metformin: eGFR ≥ 30 ไม่ต้องหยุด

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-12.s: Which statement about gadolinium-based contrast agents (GBCA) is correct?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-12.a: Nephrogenic systemic fibrosis has been linked mainly to group I (linear) agents given to patients with eGFR < 30 or on dialysis
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-12.p: NSF = Gd³⁺ หลุดจาก linear chelate ใน eGFR < 30

MOCK-171.s: 65yo CKD patient requires contrast CT scan. Preventive measure indicated to minimize Contrast-Induced Nephropathy (CIN)?
MOCK-171.a: Intravenous 0.9% Normal Saline hydration before and after contrast administration

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-13.s: In a normal adult kidney on grey-scale ultrasound, which structure is the most echogenic (brightest)?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-13.p: sinus fat สว่างที่สุด

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-14.s: On renal ultrasound, a round anechoic lesion with an imperceptible wall shows increased brightness of the tissue directly behind it. What is the physical basis of this 'posterior acoustic enhancement'?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-14.a: Fluid attenuates sound less than surrounding tissue, so more energy reaches the tissue behind it
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-14.p: ด้านหลังสว่าง = ของเหลว

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-15.s: A 4-mm echogenic focus in a lower-pole calyx shows no definite acoustic shadow on grey-scale ultrasound, but colour Doppler shows a rapidly alternating red-blue signal immediately behind it. This finding is best explained by:

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-16.s: A 24-year-old man has incidental moderate left hydronephrosis on ultrasound with normal renal function. A MAG3 renogram shows tracer pooling in the dilated left pelvis, but after IV furosemide the tracer clears rapidly with a half-time of 6 minutes. What is the best interpretation?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-16.a: Dilated but non-obstructed left collecting system
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-16.p: ล้างออกเร็วหลัง furosemide = ไม่อุดกั้น

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-17.s: A 5-year-old girl recovered from a febrile urinary tract infection 6 months ago. Which nuclear medicine study is best for detecting renal cortical scarring?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-17.p: แผลเป็นในไต = DMSA

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-18.s: A 28-year-old woman at 24 weeks of gestation presents with acute right flank pain and microscopic haematuria. What is the most appropriate initial imaging?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-18.p: ตั้งครรภ์ → US ก่อน

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-19.s: A 35-year-old woman who has never smoked has 5 RBC/HPF on a single urinalysis with no proteinuria, no dysmorphic red cells and no other risk factors. Under the AUA/SUFU microhaematuria guideline, what is the recommended next step?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-19.a: Repeat urinalysis within 6 months (or shared decision on cystoscopy and ultrasound)
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-19.p: Microhematuria ความเสี่ยงต่ำ → UA ซ้ำ

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-20.s: Which urinary finding most strongly indicates that haematuria originates from the glomerulus rather than from the collecting system or bladder?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-20.a: Red cell casts with dysmorphic red cells (acanthocytes)

N-OLD-081.s: A 65-year-old smoker has painless gross haematuria with normal renal function. Which investigation confirms the diagnosis?

N-OLD-082.s: Which approach is correct when evaluating haematuria?
N-OLD-082.a: Confirm true haematuria with microscopy, then classify as glomerular or non-glomerular before imaging or cystoscopy

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-21.s: A 40-year-old man has sudden severe right flank pain radiating to the groin, vomiting and microscopic haematuria. He has normal renal function and is afebrile. Which imaging study is most appropriate first?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-21.a: Low-dose non-contrast CT of the abdomen and pelvis (CT KUB)
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-21.p: สงสัยนิ่ว → CT KUB ไม่ฉีดสี

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-22.s: Why does pain from a stone in the ureter typically radiate from the flank to the groin and testis (or labium)?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-22.a: Visceral afferents from the ureter enter the spinal cord at T11–L2, the same segments that supply the skin of the flank and groin (including the genitofemoral nerve)
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-22.p: ปวดร้าวลงขาหนีบ = referred pain T11–L2

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-23.s: A 52-year-old woman has a 7-mm obstructing left proximal ureteric stone with moderate hydronephrosis on non-contrast CT. She has a temperature of 39.0 °C, BP 96/58 mmHg and pyuria. Besides resuscitation and IV antibiotics, what is the most important next step?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-23.a: Urgent decompression of the left collecting system (percutaneous nephrostomy or ureteric stent)
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-23.p: นิ่วอุด + ไข้ = ระบายด่วน

MOCK-174.s: 35yo male with severe flank pain radiating to groin, 4-mm stone in left distal ureter without hydronephrosis. Initial management strategy?
MOCK-174.a: Conservative management with analgesia (NSAIDs), fluid hydration, and alpha-blocker therapy (Tamsulosin)

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-24.s: A 45-year-old man with HIV taking an older protease-inhibitor regimen develops right renal colic. Non-contrast CT shows right hydronephrosis and hydroureter down to the vesicoureteric junction but no visible calculus. Which stone composition best explains this?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-24.p: นิ่วที่ CT ก็ไม่เห็น = indinavir

N-OLD-084.s: A KUB radiograph shows bilateral staghorn calculi filling the renal pelvis. Which urinary finding is most specific?
N-OLD-084.a: Coffin-lid shaped triple phosphate (struvite) crystals with alkaline urine

N-MCQ-28.s: A 54-year-old woman with recurrent urinary tract infections has a plain KUB radiograph showing a large branching radio-opaque stone filling the renal pelvis and calyces of both kidneys. Urine pH is 8.0 and urine culture grows a urease-producing organism. Which crystal would you most specifically expect to find on urine microscopy, and which organism is most likely responsible?
N-MCQ-28.a: Coffin-lid shaped triple phosphate (struvite) crystals; Proteus mirabilis
N-MCQ-28.p: เชื่อมโยงกับ OSCE: ข้อสอบ MED35 ให้ **KUB staghorn** แล้วถามว่า "ถ้าตรวจ UA จะเจออะไรที่จำเพาะที่สุด" → ตอบ **triple phosphate crystal**; และถามเชื้อ → **Proteus mirabilis**

N-OLD-080.s: A 29-year-old man with right flank pain radiating to the groin has urine RBC 100-200/HPF, uric acid 8.5 mg/dL and a normal plain KUB film. Which management is INAPPROPRIATE?
N-OLD-080.a: Giving probenecid to lower the serum uric acid

N-MCQ-27.s: A 29-year-old man presents with right-sided abdominal pain radiating to the back and lower abdomen. Urine analysis: specific gravity 1.020, albumin negative, glucose negative, RBC 100-200/HPF, WBC 0-1/HPF, urine pH 5.0. Laboratory results: BUN 12 mg/dL, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL, uric acid 8.5 mg/dL, sodium 138 mEq/L, potassium 4.2 mEq/L, bicarbonate 24 mEq/L. Plain KUB radiograph is normal. A non-contrast CT confirms a 4 mm radiolucent stone in the right distal ureter. Which of the following pieces of advice is INAPPROPRIATE for this patient?
N-MCQ-27.a: Take probenecid to lower the serum uric acid level
N-MCQ-27.p: สรุป urine pH กับชนิดนิ่ว: **กรด (pH<5.5) → uric acid, cystine**; **ด่าง (pH>7.2) → struvite (triple phosphate, จาก urease-producing organism) และ calcium phosphate**; **calcium oxalate เกิดได้ทุก pH**. ข้อห้ามของ probenecid (นิ่วยูริก, eGFR ต่ำ) เป็นจุดที่ออกสอบ

N-OLD-083.s: Which type of kidney stone is the most common overall?

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-25.s: A 65-year-old diabetic woman with E. coli acute pyelonephritis remains febrile with right flank pain after 72 hours of ceftriaxone to which the organism is susceptible. Her eGFR is 70 mL/min/1.73 m². What is the most appropriate next investigation?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-25.a: Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen and pelvis
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-25.p: APN ไข้ไม่ลง 72 ชม. → CT ฉีดสี

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-26.s: In a poorly controlled diabetic patient with pyelonephritis, renal ultrasound shows bright echogenic foci in the non-dependent part of the renal parenchyma with 'dirty' posterior shadowing. What is the most likely diagnosis?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-26.p: Non-dependent echo + dirty shadow = ก๊าซ (EPN)

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-27.s: A 58-year-old man has creatinine 2.5 mg/dL with no previous value. Renal ultrasound shows both kidneys measuring 8.2 and 8.4 cm with a cortical thickness of 6 mm, cortex brighter than the liver and loss of corticomedullary differentiation. No hydronephrosis. What is the best interpretation?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-27.p: เล็ก บาง สว่าง CMD หาย = CKD

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-28.s: In a patient with long-standing chronic kidney disease (eGFR 18 mL/min/1.73 m²), which underlying disease is most likely to be associated with normal-sized or enlarged kidneys on ultrasound?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-28.p: CKD ไตไม่เล็ก: DM amyloid HIVAN ADPKD

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-29.s: A 62-year-old man with rising creatinine has CT showing a periaortic soft-tissue mass encasing both ureters, consistent with retroperitoneal fibrosis. Renal ultrasound shows no hydronephrosis. What is the best explanation?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-29.a: The fibrotic tissue encasing the ureters and collecting system prevents them from dilating despite obstruction
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-29.p: RPF: อุดแต่ท่อขยายไม่ได้

MOCK-182.s: 65yo male with anuria for 24 hours, rising creatinine 4.5 mg/dL, ultrasound shows bilateral hydronephrosis and distended bladder. Immediate step?

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-30.s: A 30-year-old man has proximal weakness. K 2.0 mEq/L, HCO₃⁻ 12 mEq/L, anion gap 12, urine pH 7.0, urine net charge (Na + K − Cl) +30 and bilateral echogenic medullary pyramids on ultrasound. What is the most likely diagnosis?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-30.p: NAGMA + urine pH > 5.5 + UAG บวก + NC = dRTA

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-31.s: Which condition characteristically causes cortical rather than medullary nephrocalcinosis?

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-32.s: A 34-year-old woman with ADPKD has blood pressure 150/95 mmHg while her eGFR is still 95 mL/min/1.73 m². What is the main mechanism of hypertension at this stage?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-32.a: Expanding cysts compress intrarenal vessels, causing regional ischaemia and activation of the renin–angiotensin system
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-32.p: HT ใน ADPKD = ถุงกดหลอดเลือด → RAAS

NEPH-IMG-MCQ-33.s: A 4-cm well-defined renal mass is found incidentally. Non-contrast CT shows regions measuring −60 HU within the mass. What is the most likely diagnosis?
NEPH-IMG-MCQ-33.p: ไขมันในก้อนไต = AML

MOCK-175.s: 42yo man with hypertension, bilateral flank masses, ultrasound confirms large cysts bilaterally in kidneys and liver. Father died of ruptured cerebral aneurysm. Diagnosis?

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-01.s: A 66-year-old man is admitted with septic shock. On day 3 his creatinine has risen from 1.0 to 3.4 mg/dL and his urine output is 200 mL/day. Which of the following abnormalities is the most immediate threat to his life and reflects failure of the kidney's regulatory (homeostatic) function?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-01.a: Serum potassium 7.1 mEq/L with peaked T waves
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-01.p: ใน AKI ภัยเร่งด่วน = K สูง น้ำเกิน กรด

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-02.s: A 58-year-old woman is found to have a creatinine of 4.6 mg/dL during an emergency visit for vomiting. She has no prior laboratory results. Which additional finding would most strongly suggest that her kidney disease has been present for months rather than days?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-02.a: Normocytic anaemia with haemoglobin 8.2 g/dL and high parathyroid hormone
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-02.p: ซีด + PTH สูง + ไตเล็ก → เรื้อรัง

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-03.s: A 70-year-old man, height 165 cm, undergoes emergency laparotomy. His baseline creatinine 1 month ago was 0.9 mg/dL. Thirty-six hours after surgery his creatinine is 2.0 mg/dL, and his urine output has been 30 mL/h for the past 8 hours. Using KDIGO criteria (urine output calculated on ideal body weight of about 65 kg), what is his AKI stage?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-03.p: จัด stage ด้วยเกณฑ์ที่แย่กว่าระหว่าง Cr กับ UO

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-04.s: An 84-year-old bedridden woman weighing 36 kg is treated with intravenous vancomycin for MRSA osteomyelitis. Her serum creatinine is 0.7 mg/dL and her creatinine-based eGFR is reported as 78 mL/min/1.73 m². Which statement best explains why this result may be misleading?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-04.a: Low muscle mass reduces creatinine generation, so creatinine-based eGFR overestimates her true GFR; cystatin C or measured clearance is more reliable
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-04.p: ผอม แก่ ขาดอาหาร: Cr ต่ำหลอก → cystatin C

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-05.s: A 79-year-old woman is admitted with 3 days of vomiting. Her creatinine is 2.6 mg/dL (baseline 0.9). She receives intravenous isotonic saline and her blood pressure and jugular venous pressure normalise within 12 hours. After 72 hours of adequate volume repletion, her creatinine is 3.4 mg/dL, urine output is 400 mL/day and the urine sediment shows many muddy brown granular casts. Which of the following best explains the course?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-05.a: Prolonged renal hypoperfusion has progressed to ischaemic acute tubular necrosis
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-05.p: ให้น้ำพอแล้ว Cr ไม่ลง + granular cast = ATN

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-06.s: A 35-year-old man with two normally functioning kidneys presents with left renal colic. CT shows an 8-mm stone in the left mid-ureter with moderate left hydronephrosis. His creatinine is 0.9 mg/dL (baseline 0.8). Why is his creatinine nearly normal?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-06.a: The unobstructed right kidney maintains total GFR; post-renal AKI requires bilateral obstruction or obstruction of a single functioning kidney
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-06.p: Post-renal AKI = อุดสองข้าง หรือไตข้างเดียว

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-07.s: A 74-year-old man with hypertension takes lisinopril 20 mg and hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg daily. He started ibuprofen 400 mg three times daily for knee osteoarthritis 1 week ago, and has had watery diarrhoea for 2 days. BP 98/60 mmHg, PR 104/min, dry mucous membranes. Creatinine 2.6 mg/dL (baseline 1.0), BUN 64 mg/dL, K 5.7 mEq/L, urine sodium 11 mEq/L, bland urine sediment. Which is the most appropriate management?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-07.a: Stop ibuprofen, hold lisinopril and hydrochlorothiazide, give intravenous isotonic crystalloid and monitor creatinine and potassium
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-07.p: Triple whammy → หยุดยาทั้งสามกลุ่ม + ให้น้ำ
