NEPH-AKI-MCQ-08.s: A 69-year-old woman with poor oral intake for 5 days has BUN 60 mg/dL, creatinine 2.0 mg/dL, Na 140, K 4.0, Cl 96 and HCO3 31 mEq/L. Urine sodium is 10 mEq/L and urine osmolality 650 mOsm/kg. Which mechanism best explains her BUN-to-creatinine ratio of 30?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-08.a: Low tubular flow and ADH increase urea reabsorption, while creatinine is not reabsorbed
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-08.p: BUN/Cr > 20 = urea ถูกดูดกลับตามน้ำ

N-MCQ-35.s: A 74-year-old woman presents with 4 days of diarrhoea and poor oral intake. Vital signs: PR 108/min, BP 96/60 mmHg with a postural drop, dry mucous membranes, JVP not visible. Laboratory results: BUN 62 mg/dL, creatinine 2.2 mg/dL (baseline 0.9), sodium 142 mEq/L, urine sodium 12 mEq/L, urine osmolality 680 mOsm/kg, fractional excretion of sodium 0.4 percent, urine specific gravity 1.028. Urine microscopy shows occasional hyaline casts only. She takes no diuretics. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis and most appropriate management?
N-MCQ-35.a: Prerenal azotaemia; intravenous isotonic crystalloid with reassessment of volume status
N-MCQ-35.p: ภาวะที่ให้ **FENa <1% แต่ไม่ใช่ hypovolaemia**: **hepatorenal syndrome, cardiorenal syndrome (HF), contrast-induced nephropathy, rhabdomyolysis ระยะแรก, acute glomerulonephritis** — จึงต้องอ่าน FENa ร่วมกับบริบททางคลินิกเสมอ; และ **FENa ใช้ไม่ได้เมื่อได้ diuretic → ใช้ FEurea <35%**

N-MCQ-38.s: A 69-year-old man with chronic kidney disease stage 3, heart failure and hypertension takes enalapril and furosemide. He started diclofenac for back pain 5 days ago. His creatinine has risen from 1.5 to 2.9 mg/dL. He is clinically euvolaemic with bland urinary sediment and no eosinophiluria. Which of the following best explains the mechanism of his acute kidney injury?
N-MCQ-38.a: Loss of prostaglandin-mediated afferent arteriolar vasodilatation reducing glomerular filtration pressure
N-MCQ-38.p: "**Triple whammy**" = **NSAID + ACEI/ARB + diuretic** — ต้องถามหา **NSAID และยาสมุนไพร/ยาชุดที่ซื้อกินเอง** ทุกครั้งที่เจอ Cr ขึ้นโดยไม่มีคำอธิบาย เพราะผู้ป่วยมักไม่รายงานเองว่ากิน "ยาแก้ปวดข้อ"

N-OLD-105.s: A dehydrated patient has BUN/creatinine ratio above 20, urine sodium 12 mEq/L, FENa 0.5 percent and hyaline casts. What is the diagnosis?

N-OLD-107.s: A woman with 1 month of heavy menstrual bleeding has Hct 21 percent, BP 90/60 mmHg and creatinine rising to 2.2 mg/dL with FENa 0.4 percent. What is the mechanism of her acute kidney injury?

N-OLD-108.s: A woman with myoma uteri has heavy vaginal bleeding, hypotension and oliguria with rising creatinine. What is the most appropriate initial management?
N-OLD-108.a: Restore intravascular volume with fluid and blood transfusion while controlling the bleeding

N-OLD-113.s: What is the mechanism of NSAID-induced acute kidney injury?
N-OLD-113.a: Inhibition of prostaglandin-mediated afferent arteriolar vasodilatation reducing glomerular filtration

N-OLD-115.s: Which cause of reduced GFR is functional (haemodynamic) rather than structural?
N-OLD-115.a: Prerenal azotaemia from hypovolaemia, heart failure or cirrhosis

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-09.s: A 56-year-old man with alcohol-related cirrhosis and tense ascites is admitted with confusion. He takes spironolactone and furosemide. BP 102/64 mmHg. Creatinine has risen from 0.9 to 2.1 mg/dL over 4 days. Urine sodium 6 mEq/L, FENa 0.1%, no proteinuria or haematuria, and renal ultrasound is normal. There is no shock and no nephrotoxic drug exposure. What is the most appropriate next step?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-09.a: Stop diuretics and give intravenous albumin 1 g/kg/day for 2 days, then reassess
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-09.p: HRS: หยุด diuretic + albumin 1 g/kg × 2 วัน ก่อน

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-10.s: A 67-year-old woman with acute pyelonephritis is in septic shock. After 30 mL/kg of intravenous crystalloid her mean arterial pressure is 58 mmHg, lactate 4.1 mmol/L, and urine output 15 mL/h. Her lungs now have bibasal crackles. Which intervention is most likely to protect her kidney function?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-10.a: Start norepinephrine to achieve a mean arterial pressure of at least 65 mmHg
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-10.p: Septic shock + AKI: norepinephrine ให้ MAP ≥ 65 ไม่ใช่ dopamine

N-MCQ-39.s: A 72-year-old man with heart failure (LVEF 30%) is admitted with worsening dyspnoea and leg swelling. Vital signs: PR 96/min, BP 104/68 mmHg, JVP 12 cm above the sternal angle, bibasilar crepitations, hepatomegaly and 3+ pitting oedema. Extremities are warm with capillary refill of 2 seconds. Creatinine has risen from 1.2 to 2.3 mg/dL over 5 days, urine sodium is 14 mEq/L and urine output is 500 mL per day. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
N-MCQ-39.a: Intensify decongestion with intravenous loop diuretic and monitor the clinical response
N-MCQ-39.p: แยกผู้ป่วย HF ด้วย 2 มิติที่ bedside: **"wet vs dry" (congestion) และ "warm vs cold" (perfusion)** → **wet-warm = ขับน้ำ (diuretic ± vasodilator)**; **wet-cold = inotrope + diuretic**; **dry-cold = ให้สารน้ำอย่างระวัง ± inotrope**; **dry-warm = ปรับยาผู้ป่วยนอก**

N-OLD-116.s: A patient with warm extremities, wide pulse pressure, rising creatinine and preserved ejection fraction most likely has which problem?
N-OLD-116.a: Inadequate effective organ perfusion in a high-output vasodilated state (e.g. sepsis, cirrhosis)

N-OLD-117.s: In cardiorenal syndrome type 1, which factor most drives the fall in renal function?
N-OLD-117.a: Venous congestion with raised central venous pressure

N-OLD-118.s: A patient in the ICU has confusion, T 38.5 C, BP 80/50 mmHg, PR 140/min, Na 122, K 3.9, HCO3 21, BUN 45 and Cr 1.7 mg/dL with pyuria. What is the most likely diagnosis?
N-OLD-118.a: Sepsis from acute pyelonephritis with sepsis-associated acute kidney injury

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-11.s: A 26-year-old woman presents with 3 days of fever, headache and intermittent confusion. Hb 7.8 g/dL with many schistocytes, platelets 18,000/mm³, LDH 1,450 U/L, haptoglobin undetectable, direct Coombs test negative, PT and aPTT normal. Creatinine 2.1 mg/dL, urine shows protein 2+ and 5–10 RBC/HPF without casts. ANA is positive at 1:640. What is the most appropriate immediate management?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-11.a: Send ADAMTS13 activity and start urgent plasma exchange with corticosteroids
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-11.p: MAHA + PLT ต่ำ + สมอง → plasma exchange ด่วน

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-12.s: A 45-year-old woman with diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis diagnosed 1 year ago was started on prednisolone 40 mg/day for myositis 3 weeks ago. She now has headache and blurred vision. BP 196/112 mmHg (previously 118/74). Creatinine 2.4 mg/dL (baseline 0.8), platelets 96,000/mm³ with occasional schistocytes, urine protein 1+ with no casts. What is the most appropriate treatment?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-12.a: Start an ACE inhibitor such as captopril and titrate rapidly
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-12.p: SRC: steroid ขนาดสูงกระตุ้น · ACEi รักษา

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-13.s: A 62-year-old man has 3 weeks of malaise, arthralgia and intermittent haemoptysis. Creatinine has risen from 1.0 to 4.5 mg/dL over 3 weeks. Urinalysis shows protein 2+, 30–50 RBC/HPF that are mostly dysmorphic, and RBC casts. Chest radiograph shows bilateral patchy alveolar opacities. What is the most appropriate next step?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-13.a: Urgent ANCA, anti-GBM antibody and complement levels with early kidney biopsy, considering empirical pulse methylprednisolone
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-13.p: AKI + RBC cast + ไอเป็นเลือด → ANCA/anti-GBM + biopsy ด่วน

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-14.s: A 54-year-old man with longstanding uncontrolled hypertension presents with BP 230/140 mmHg, retinal haemorrhages and papilloedema. Creatinine is 3.0 mg/dL. Which urine sediment finding would most strongly suggest a primary glomerulonephritis rather than malignant hypertension as the cause of his AKI?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-14.p: Malignant HT มี dysmorphic RBC ได้ แต่ไม่มี RBC cast

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-15.s: A 58-year-old man is receiving intravenous cloxacillin for cellulitis. On day 10 he develops fever and a diffuse maculopapular rash. Creatinine has risen from 0.9 to 2.8 mg/dL. Blood eosinophils 12%. Urinalysis: protein 1+, WBC 20–30/HPF, WBC casts, RBC 2–3/HPF, no RBC casts; urine culture negative; Hansel's stain shows 8% eosinophils. What is the most appropriate management?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-15.a: Stop cloxacillin and switch to a non-beta-lactam antibiotic, adding corticosteroid if kidney function does not improve
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-15.p: AIN จากยา: หยุดยา ± steroid

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-16.s: A 42-year-old rice farmer in north-eastern Thailand presents after 5 days of high fever, severe calf pain and conjunctival suffusion. Total bilirubin 6.8 mg/dL with mildly raised transaminases, platelets 62,000/mm³, creatinine 3.2 mg/dL, potassium 3.0 mEq/L. Urine output is 1.8 L/day. Which description best fits the renal involvement?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-16.a: Non-oliguric AKI from tubulointerstitial nephritis with renal potassium wasting
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-16.p: Leptospirosis: non-oliguric AKI + K ต่ำ + ตับ

N-OLD-114.s: Which additional renal complication can NSAIDs cause besides reduced glomerular filtration?
N-OLD-114.a: Acute interstitial nephritis with or without minimal change disease

N-OLD-120.s: A patient on high-dose steroid for minimal change disease develops acute kidney injury with sterile pyuria, WBC casts, rash and eosinophilia after starting a new antibiotic. What is the diagnosis?

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-17.s: A 71-year-old man had a prolonged episode of hypotension (BP 70/40 mmHg for about 2 hours) during emergency repair of a ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm. On day 2 his blood pressure is normal, but urine output is 250 mL/day and creatinine has risen from 1.1 to 3.9 mg/dL. Urine shows numerous muddy brown granular casts and renal tubular epithelial cells. Which mechanism best explains the persistently low GFR despite restored blood pressure?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-17.a: Tubular obstruction by casts, backleak of filtrate across denuded tubules and tubuloglomerular feedback-mediated afferent vasoconstriction
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-17.p: ความดันกลับแล้ว GFR ยังต่ำ = cast + backleak + TGF

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-18.s: A 60-year-old woman with ischaemic ATN after septic shock was oliguric for 10 days. On day 12 her urine output increases to 4.5 L/day. Creatinine has started to fall (5.2 to 4.6 mg/dL). Serum K 3.1 mEq/L, Mg 1.4 mg/dL, phosphate 2.0 mg/dL, Na 141 mEq/L. She is euvolaemic. What is the most appropriate management?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-18.a: Replace potassium, magnesium and phosphate and give maintenance fluid guided by daily balance and weight, tapering as urine output falls
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-18.p: ATN ระยะฟื้น: polyuria → ทดแทน K Mg PO4 และน้ำตาม balance

N-OLD-106.s: What is the main mechanism of drug-induced acute tubular necrosis?
N-OLD-106.a: Ischaemic and direct toxic injury to tubular epithelial cells

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-19.s: A 72-year-old woman receives intravenous gentamicin 5 mg/kg once daily with ampicillin for enterococcal pyelonephritis. On day 8 her creatinine rises from 0.8 to 2.1 mg/dL. Urine output is 1.6 L/day. Serum magnesium 1.2 mg/dL and potassium 3.2 mEq/L. Which feature is most characteristic of this type of kidney injury?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-19.a: Non-oliguric acute tubular necrosis appearing after several days of therapy, with renal magnesium and potassium wasting
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-19.p: Aminoglycoside: non-oliguric ATN วันที่ 5–10 + Mg/K ต่ำ

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-20.s: A 64-year-old man with type 2 diabetes and CKD (eGFR 26 mL/min/1.73 m²) needs a contrast-enhanced CT for suspected pancreatic cancer. He takes metformin 500 mg twice daily. Which is the most appropriate plan for his metformin?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-20.a: Withhold metformin at the time of the contrast scan and for 48 hours afterwards, restarting only after kidney function is rechecked and stable
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-20.p: Metformin + contrast: งดเมื่อ eGFR < 30/AKI ตรวจไตซ้ำ 48 ชม.

N-MCQ-37.s: A 68-year-old man with chronic kidney disease stage 4 (eGFR 24 mL/min/1.73 m2) and diabetes requires a contrast-enhanced CT scan of the abdomen to evaluate a suspected malignancy. He is euvolaemic and takes metformin, enalapril and furosemide. Which of the following is the most evidence-based strategy to reduce his risk of contrast-associated acute kidney injury?
N-MCQ-37.a: Intravenous isotonic crystalloid before and after the procedure, use of the lowest possible iso-osmolar or low-osmolar contrast volume, and temporary withholding of nephrotoxic drugs
N-MCQ-37.p: ปัจจัยเสี่ยงของ CA-AKI: **CKD (เสี่ยงเพิ่มชัดเมื่อ eGFR <30), เบาหวานที่มีโรคไตร่วม, hypovolaemia, HF, multiple myeloma, อายุมาก, ปริมาณสารทึบรังสีมาก, การฉีดเข้าหลอดเลือดแดง และการฉีดซ้ำในเวลาใกล้กัน**

N-OLD-112.s: A patient with CKD needs a contrast CT. What is the best evidence-based prophylaxis against contrast-associated acute kidney injury?
N-OLD-112.a: Intravenous isotonic saline before and after the scan with the lowest possible contrast dose and withholding nephrotoxic drugs

N-OLD-122.s: A 64-year-old man on lithium for 20 years has polyuria with low urine osmolality that does not rise after desmopressin. What is the diagnosis?

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-21.s: A 24-year-old man is brought in after a prolonged generalised seizure. His urine is reddish-brown. Dipstick: blood 3+; microscopy: 0–2 RBC/HPF. After centrifugation the urine supernatant remains red-brown and the patient's plasma is clear (not pink). Which pigment is most likely present and why?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-21.a: Myoglobin, because it is small and rapidly filtered so it does not accumulate in plasma
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-21.p: พลาสมาใส + heme บวก = myoglobin

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-22.s: A 30-year-old man is extracted after his legs were trapped under rubble for 6 hours. CK is 48,000 U/L, creatinine 2.4 mg/dL, K 5.4 mEq/L, phosphate 7.6 mg/dL and corrected calcium 6.9 mg/dL. He has no tetany or seizures, and ECG shows a normal QT interval without peaked T waves. Which of the following is the most appropriate management of his hypocalcaemia?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-22.a: Do not give intravenous calcium now; treat the rhabdomyolysis with aggressive isotonic fluid and monitor calcium
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-22.p: Rhabdo + Ca ต่ำไม่มีอาการ → ไม่ให้ Ca

N-MCQ-36.s: A 58-year-old man with hypertension and dyslipidaemia presents with 3 days of severe generalised muscle pain and dark brown urine. He was recently started on gemfibrozil in addition to his simvastatin. Vital signs: PR 96/min, BP 138/84 mmHg. Examination shows diffuse proximal muscle tenderness with power grade 4 and no rash. Laboratory results: creatinine 5.5 mg/dL (baseline 1.0), BUN 25 mg/dL, potassium 6.0 mEq/L, phosphate 7.2 mg/dL, calcium 7.0 mg/dL, bicarbonate 16 mEq/L, uric acid 11 mg/dL. Urine dipstick is strongly positive for blood but microscopy shows only 1-2 RBC per high power field. Which of the following investigations will best confirm the diagnosis, and what is the key initial treatment?
N-MCQ-36.a: Serum creatine kinase; aggressive intravenous isotonic fluid resuscitation
N-MCQ-36.p: สาเหตุ rhabdomyolysis ที่ต้องนึกถึง: **ยา (statin ± fibrate/macrolide/azole/colchicine), crush injury, การออกกำลังกายหนักเกิน, ชักนาน, heat stroke, ไฟฟ้าดูด, การนอนทับตัวเองนาน (ผู้ป่วยหมดสติ/เมา), hypokalaemia และ hypophosphataemia รุนแรง, การติดเชื้อ (influenza, leptospirosis), neuroleptic malignant syndrome, serotonin syndrome, สารพิษ**

N-OLD-109.s: A patient on simvastatin and gemfibrozil develops severe muscle pain, dark urine, CK 45,000 U/L and creatinine 3.5 mg/dL. What is the diagnosis?
N-OLD-109.a: Rhabdomyolysis with myoglobinuric acute kidney injury

N-OLD-123.s: A patient with statin-fibrate rhabdomyolysis has K 6.8 mEq/L, phosphate 8 mg/dL, creatinine 4.2 mg/dL and CK 60,000 U/L. What is the management priority?
N-OLD-123.a: Stop the offending drugs, give aggressive intravenous isotonic fluid and treat hyperkalaemia, with dialysis if refractory

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-23.s: A 46-year-old woman with HSV encephalitis receives intravenous acyclovir 10 mg/kg every 8 hours as a rapid infusion. Her oral intake is poor. On day 3 creatinine rises from 0.8 to 2.3 mg/dL. Urine microscopy shows needle-shaped birefringent crystals and a few WBC. What is the most appropriate management?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-23.a: Give intravenous isotonic fluid, infuse acyclovir slowly over 1–2 hours and reduce the dose according to kidney function
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-23.p: Acyclovir AKI: ให้น้ำ หยดช้า ปรับขนาด — ไม่หยุดยาที่จำเป็น

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-24.s: A 55-year-old woman with CKD stage 3 (baseline creatinine 1.6 mg/dL) drank about 1 litre of fresh star fruit juice daily for 3 days as a herbal remedy. She now has nausea, persistent hiccups and oliguria; creatinine is 5.8 mg/dL. Urine microscopy shows many envelope-shaped crystals. What is the most likely mechanism of her AKI?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-24.a: Acute oxalate nephropathy from calcium oxalate crystal deposition in the tubules
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-24.p: มะเฟือง/ตะลิงปลิง → CaOx crystal (envelope)

N-OLD-111.s: A patient develops acute kidney injury with hyperkalaemia, hyperphosphataemia and hyperuricaemia 2 days after starting chemotherapy. What is the mechanism of the renal injury?
N-OLD-111.a: Uric acid and calcium phosphate crystal deposition in the tubules from tumour lysis

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-25.s: A 52-year-old woman with stage IIIB carcinoma of the cervix presents with 2 days of very low urine output. Creatinine 6.1 mg/dL (baseline 0.8), K 6.0 mEq/L. Bladder scan shows 40 mL residual urine. Ultrasound shows bilateral moderate hydronephrosis with dilated ureters down to the pelvis. After initial treatment of hyperkalaemia, what is the most appropriate intervention to relieve the obstruction?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-25.a: Bilateral percutaneous nephrostomy or ureteric stenting
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-25.p: อุดที่ท่อไต → ระบายเหนือจุดอุด (nephrostomy/stent)

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-26.s: A 48-year-old man had liquid paraffin injected into his penis several years ago. He now presents with 18 hours of inability to pass urine, a tender palpable bladder and creatinine 2.4 mg/dL (baseline 1.0). Two attempts to pass a 14 Fr Foley catheter meet firm resistance in the penile urethra. What is the most appropriate next step?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-26.a: Insert a suprapubic catheter (or ask urology for urgent drainage) rather than forcing a urethral catheter
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-26.p: ใส่สายผ่าน stricture ไม่ได้ → suprapubic

N-MCQ-40.s: A 76-year-old man with benign prostatic hyperplasia presents with 2 days of anuria and lower abdominal discomfort. Vital signs: PR 92/min, BP 158/92 mmHg. Examination shows a tender, palpable suprapubic mass that is dull to percussion. Laboratory results: creatinine 6.8 mg/dL (baseline 1.1), potassium 6.1 mEq/L, bicarbonate 17 mEq/L. Which of the following is the most appropriate immediate intervention, and what complication should be anticipated afterwards?
N-MCQ-40.a: Urethral catheterisation to relieve the obstruction; anticipate post-obstructive diuresis with electrolyte losses
N-MCQ-40.p: AKI ต้องไล่ 3 ตำแหน่งเสมอ: **prerenal (ประเมิน volume/perfusion) → postrenal (คลำกระเพาะปัสสาวะ + ultrasound) → intrinsic (อ่าน urine sediment)** — สองข้อแรกแก้ได้เร็วและถูก จึงต้องทำก่อน

N-OLD-121.s: An elderly man with benign prostatic hyperplasia has anuria, a palpable bladder and rising creatinine. What is the first management step?
N-OLD-121.a: Bladder catheterisation to relieve the obstruction

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-27.s: A 38-year-old man with HIV infection is started on high-dose trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole for Pneumocystis pneumonia. On day 3 his creatinine has risen from 1.0 to 1.3 mg/dL. BUN is unchanged at 12 mg/dL, urine output is 1.8 L/day, urinalysis is bland, and potassium is 5.6 mEq/L. What is the best explanation for the change in creatinine?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-27.a: Trimethoprim inhibits tubular secretion of creatinine, raising serum creatinine without a true fall in GFR
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-27.p: Cr ขึ้นเล็กน้อย BUN คงที่ หลัง trimethoprim = แย่งการหลั่ง

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-28.s: A 58-year-old woman presents with fatigue and is found to have creatinine 4.8 mg/dL; no previous results are available. Hb 8.5 g/dL (normocytic), phosphate 6.8 mg/dL, calcium 7.8 mg/dL and intact PTH 480 pg/mL. Ultrasound shows a right kidney of 8.1 cm and left kidney of 8.4 cm, both with increased cortical echogenicity, thin cortex and poor corticomedullary differentiation. Which finding most strongly indicates chronic rather than acute kidney disease?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-28.a: Bilateral small echogenic kidneys with thin cortex
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-28.p: ไตเล็ก ขาว cortex บาง = CKD

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-29.s: A 66-year-old man becomes oliguric after cardiac surgery complicated by 3 hours of hypotension. He has received no diuretics. Plasma Na 136 mEq/L, plasma creatinine 4.0 mg/dL; urine Na 68 mEq/L, urine creatinine 40 mg/dL, urine osmolality 310 mOsm/kg. Urine sediment shows granular casts. What is his fractional excretion of sodium (FENa) and its interpretation?

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-30.s: A 78-year-old woman with heart failure on furosemide 80 mg/day presents with poor intake and vomiting. Creatinine 2.0 mg/dL (baseline 1.0), BUN 60 mg/dL. Urine: Na 45 mEq/L, creatinine 100 mg/dL, urea nitrogen 300 mg/dL; FENa is 3%. Urine sediment shows only hyaline casts. Calculate her fractional excretion of urea (FEurea) and interpret it.
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-30.a: FEurea 10% — supports pre-renal azotaemia despite the high FENa

N-OLD-119.s: Which urinary index favours acute tubular necrosis over prerenal azotaemia?
N-OLD-119.a: FENa above 2 percent with urine osmolality below 350 mOsm/kg

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-31.s: A 70-year-old man with oliguric AKI has a serum potassium of 7.2 mEq/L. ECG shows peaked T waves, absent P waves and a QRS duration of 160 ms. Blood pressure is 128/70 mmHg. Which should be given first?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-31.a: Intravenous 10% calcium gluconate 10 mL over 2–3 minutes
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-31.p: ECG เปลี่ยน → Ca gluconate ก่อนทุกอย่าง

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-32.s: A 61-year-old man with type 2 diabetes and AKI has potassium 6.6 mEq/L with peaked T waves. Calcium gluconate has been given. His capillary blood glucose is 320 mg/dL. What is the most appropriate way to shift potassium into cells?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-32.a: Regular insulin 10 units intravenously without dextrose, with hourly glucose monitoring
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-32.p: ✍️ น้ำตาล > 250: ให้ RI IV อย่างเดียว

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-33.s: A 68-year-old man with ischaemic ATN is on day 4 of oliguria (urine output 300 mL/day). He has received furosemide 200 mg intravenously without any increase in urine output. He is now dyspnoeic with bibasal crackles to the mid-zones and SpO₂ 88% on 6 L/min oxygen. BP 160/90 mmHg. K 5.4 mEq/L, HCO3 19 mEq/L, BUN 86 mg/dL, creatinine 6.4 mg/dL. What is the most appropriate next step?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-33.a: Urgent dialysis (ultrafiltration) for diuretic-resistant volume overload
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-33.p: น้ำเกินที่ดื้อ diuretic = dialysis ด่วน

NEPH-AKI-MCQ-34.s: A 65-year-old man has AKI stage 3 from contrast and sepsis. On day 4 he is alert and comfortable, BP 132/76 mmHg, lungs clear, no oedema. Urine output has increased from 400 to 1,000 mL/day. K 5.2 mEq/L, HCO3 20 mEq/L, BUN 92 mg/dL, creatinine 7.4 mg/dL (non-catabolic). There is no pericardial rub or confusion. What is the most appropriate plan?
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-34.a: Continue conservative management with daily monitoring because there is currently no indication for dialysis
NEPH-AKI-MCQ-34.p: ไม่มี AEIOU + ปัสสาวะเพิ่ม → รอได้

N-OLD-124.s: Which is an indication for dialysis in rhabdomyolysis-associated acute kidney injury?
N-OLD-124.a: Refractory hyperkalaemia, severe acidosis or fluid overload not responding to medical therapy

NEURO-07-01-Q1.s: A 58-year-old man has sudden right-sided weakness. Which of the following statements about distinguishing ischaemic from haemorrhagic stroke is correct?
NEURO-07-01-Q1.a: They cannot be reliably distinguished clinically, so non-contrast computed tomography is required in every patient
NEURO-07-01-Q1.p: ไม่มีอาการใดแยกขาดเลือดออกจากเลือดออกได้ — CT ก่อนตัดสินใจรักษาเสมอ

NEURO-07-02-Q1.s: In acute ischaemic stroke, which statement best describes the ischaemic penumbra?
NEURO-07-02-Q1.a: Hypoperfused but still viable tissue that can recover if blood flow is restored in time
NEURO-07-02-Q1.p: Penumbra = ขาดเลือดแต่ยังไม่ตาย กู้ได้ถ้าเปิดหลอดเลือดทัน — เป็นเป้าหมายเดียวของการรักษาเฉียบพลัน

NEU-MCQ-01.s: A 65-year-old woman is watching television when she suddenly develops right-sided weakness and numbness, and speaks in short broken phrases. She follows simple commands only after repeated prompting. Vital signs: BP 180/100 mmHg, PR 100/min irregularly irregular. Examination shows a grade 3 apical murmur, gaze preference to the left, right upper motor neuron facial weakness, right arm power grade 3 and right leg power grade 4, and an extensor plantar response on the right. Which vascular territory is most likely involved?
NEU-MCQ-01.p: อ่อนแรงซีกขวา + aphasia + ตามองไปทางซ้าย = MCA ซ้าย · ตามองไปทางเดียวกับรอยโรคเสมอ

NEU-MCQ-03.s: A 68-year-old man with long-standing hypertension and diabetes develops weakness of the left face, arm and leg over a few hours. He is fully alert with normal speech comprehension and expression, no visual field defect, no neglect, and completely normal sensation. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis and expected outcome?
NEU-MCQ-03.a: Lacunar (pure motor) stroke from small vessel disease, with an excellent prognosis for recovery
NEU-MCQ-03.p: อ่อนแรงหน้า แขน ขา เท่ากัน โดยไม่มี aphasia neglect หรือลานสายตาผิดปกติ = pure motor lacunar stroke พยากรณ์โรคดี

NEU-MCQ-04.s: A 58-year-old man develops sudden vertigo, double vision and difficulty swallowing. Examination shows nystagmus, a left sixth nerve palsy, right-sided limb weakness and left-sided limb ataxia. Which of the following best explains this combination of findings?
NEU-MCQ-04.a: A brainstem lesion producing ipsilateral cranial nerve signs with contralateral long tract signs
NEU-MCQ-04.p: เส้นประสาทสมองเสียข้างเดียวกับรอยโรค + แขนขาอ่อนแรงด้านตรงข้าม = ก้านสมอง

NEU-MCQ-05.s: A 70-year-old woman presents with global aphasia, a right homonymous hemianopia, and dense right-sided weakness affecting the face, arm and leg. According to the Oxford Community Stroke Project (OCSP) classification, which subtype of cerebral infarction does she have?
NEU-MCQ-05.p: TACI = สมองระดับสูงผิดปกติ + ลานสายตาผิดปกติ + อ่อนแรง/ชาอย่างน้อย 2 ใน 3 ส่วน — ครบสามข้อ

NEU-MCQ-06.s: A 62-year-old man with type 2 diabetes on insulin is found confused with right-sided weakness and slurred speech. Blood pressure is 150/90 mmHg. A point-of-care glucose reading is 38 mg/dL. Which of the following is the most appropriate immediate action?
NEU-MCQ-06.a: Give 50 mL of 50% glucose intravenously and reassess the neurological deficit
NEU-MCQ-06.p: เจาะน้ำตาลปลายนิ้วในคนที่สงสัย stroke ทุกราย — น้ำตาลต่ำเลียนแบบ stroke ได้เหมือนจริงและแก้ได้ทันที

NEU-MCQ-17.s: A public stroke-awareness campaign uses the mnemonic BEFAST. Which of the following correctly describes what the letters B and E add to the older FAST mnemonic?
NEU-MCQ-17.a: B for balance problems and E for visual disturbance, which capture posterior circulation strokes missed by FAST
NEU-MCQ-17.p: BEFAST — B คือทรงตัวผิดปกติ E คือการมองเห็นผิดปกติ เพิ่มเข้ามาเพื่อจับ stroke ของระบบไหลเวียนด้านหลัง

NEU-MCQ-19.s: A 68-year-old man with hypertension had 20 minutes of right arm weakness and slurred speech yesterday, which resolved completely. He is now neurologically normal. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
NEU-MCQ-19.a: Urgent evaluation and start of secondary prevention now, because the risk of completed stroke is highest in the first few days
NEU-MCQ-19.p: TIA คือ stroke ที่ยังไม่เกิด — เสี่ยงสูงสุดในไม่กี่วันแรก ต้องสืบค้นและเริ่มป้องกันทันที ไม่ใช่นัดทีหลัง

NEU-MCQ-02.s: A 72-year-old man develops maximal left-sided weakness instantly while eating breakfast. He had a transient episode of right-sided visual loss 2 months ago and an episode of left arm numbness last year. His pulse is irregularly irregular. Computed tomography of the brain 6 hours later shows a wedge-shaped cortical infarct in the right middle cerebral artery territory. Which TOAST subtype does this presentation best fit?
NEU-MCQ-02.p: ทันทีทันใด + รุนแรงสุดตั้งแต่แรก + TIA คนละแขนง + AF = cardioembolic

NEU-MCQ-16.s: A 69-year-old man with diabetes and a 40 pack-year smoking history has had three episodes over 2 weeks of transient right arm weakness and slurred speech, each lasting about 10 minutes and resolving completely. He now has a persistent mild right hemiparesis that worsened in a stepwise fashion over 2 days. A bruit is audible over the left carotid artery. Magnetic resonance imaging shows a 2.5 cm infarct in the left corona radiata. Which TOAST subtype is most likely?
NEU-MCQ-16.p: เป็นขั้นบันได + TIA ซ้ำในแขนงเดียวกัน + เสียงฟู่ที่คอ + รอยโรคเกิน 1.5 ซม. = large artery atherosclerosis

NEU-MCQ-23.s: A 34-year-old woman develops left-sided neck pain and headache after a chiropractic neck manipulation, followed 2 days later by vertigo, ataxia and right-sided numbness. She has no vascular risk factors. Which of the following is the most likely mechanism of her stroke?
NEU-MCQ-23.a: Vertebral artery dissection with artery-to-artery embolism
NEU-MCQ-23.p: Stroke ในคนอายุน้อย + ปวดคอหรือศีรษะนำมาก่อน + มีเหตุกระตุ้นทางกล = หลอดเลือดฉีกขาด

NEU-MCQ-07.s: A 66-year-old woman was last seen normal at 22:00 when she went to bed. She woke at 05:00 unable to move her left arm and was brought to hospital at 06:00. Which time should be used as the onset time when deciding eligibility for intravenous thrombolysis?
NEU-MCQ-07.a: 22:00, the time she was last seen well
NEU-MCQ-07.p: ใช้ last seen well เป็นเวลาเริ่มอาการเสมอ ไม่ใช่เวลาที่พบว่าผิดปกติ

NEU-MCQ-08.s: A patient with acute ischaemic stroke has an initial National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS) score of 8. Four hours later the score is 11. Which of the following statements is correct?
NEU-MCQ-08.a: A rise of 2 points or more on serial NIHSS indicates stroke progression and should be reported
NEU-MCQ-08.p: NIHSS 0−42 · เพิ่มขึ้น ≥ 2 คะแนน = โรคดำเนินแย่ลง ต้องรายงานและส่งภาพถ่ายซ้ำ

NEU-MCQ-09.s: A 59-year-old man presents 2 hours after the sudden onset of right hemiparesis and aphasia. Non-contrast computed tomography of the brain shows loss of grey-white differentiation, obscuration of the left lentiform nucleus and loss of the left insular ribbon. What is the correct interpretation?
NEU-MCQ-09.a: These are early ischaemic changes of an acute left middle cerebral artery infarct
NEU-MCQ-09.p: สูญเสีย gray-white differentiation · insular ribbon หาย · lentiform เบลอ · hyperdense MCA = สัญญาณ stroke ระยะแรก ไม่ใช่ CT ปกติ

NEU-MCQ-10.s: The Alberta Stroke Program Early CT Score (ASPECTS) is applied to a non-contrast computed tomography scan of a patient with a left middle cerebral artery syndrome. Early ischaemic change is seen in the insular cortex, the lentiform nucleus and the M1, M2 and M3 cortical regions. What is the ASPECTS score?
NEU-MCQ-10.p: ASPECTS เริ่มที่ 10 หัก 1 ต่อบริเวณที่ขาดเลือด จาก 10 เขต — M1−M6, caudate, lentiform, internal capsule, insula

NEU-MCQ-11.s: A 61-year-old man arrives 90 minutes after the onset of right hemiparesis and aphasia. Computed tomography shows no haemorrhage and he has no other contraindication to thrombolysis. His blood pressure is persistently 196/118 mmHg. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
NEU-MCQ-11.a: Lower the blood pressure to 185/110 mmHg or below with intravenous labetalol or nicardipine, then give alteplase
NEU-MCQ-11.p: ก่อนให้ rtPA ต้องคุมความดันให้ ≤ 185/110 · หลังให้แล้วคุม ≤ 180/105 · ลดไม่ลงคือห้ามให้

NEU-MCQ-12.s: Which of the following is an ABSOLUTE contraindication to intravenous alteplase in a patient who is otherwise within 4.5 hours of stroke onset?
NEU-MCQ-12.a: Computed tomography showing hypodensity involving more than one-third of the cerebral hemisphere
NEU-MCQ-12.p: CT ที่มีเนื้อสมองตายเกินหนึ่งในสามของซีกสมอง หรือมีเลือดออก = ข้อห้ามเด็ดขาด · ตั้งครรภ์ ชักตอนเริ่ม และผ่าตัดใน 14 วัน เป็นข้อห้ามสัมพัทธ์

NEU-MCQ-13.s: A 70 kg man with acute ischaemic stroke is eligible for intravenous alteplase. Which of the following dosing regimens is correct?
NEU-MCQ-13.a: 0.9 mg/kg, with 10% given as a bolus over 1 minute and the remainder infused over 60 minutes, to a maximum of 90 mg
NEU-MCQ-13.p: Alteplase 0.9 mg/kg สูงสุด 90 mg — bolus 10% ใน 1 นาที ที่เหลือหยด 60 นาที · tenecteplase คือ 0.25 mg/kg สูงสุด 25 mg bolus เดียว

NEU-MCQ-14.s: Thirty minutes into an alteplase infusion, a patient develops a severe headache, acute hypertension and vomiting, and his National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale score rises by 4 points. Which of the following is the most appropriate immediate action?
NEU-MCQ-14.a: Stop the infusion and obtain an emergency computed tomography scan of the brain
NEU-MCQ-14.p: ระหว่างหยด rtPA ถ้าปวดศีรษะรุนแรง อาเจียน ความดันพุ่ง หรืออาการแย่ลง — หยุดยาทันทีและส่ง CT ฉุกเฉิน

NEU-MCQ-20.s: Twelve hours after receiving alteplase, a patient's National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale score has risen from 12 to 19 and he has become drowsy. Repeat computed tomography shows blood within the infarcted territory with mass effect. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
NEU-MCQ-20.a: Stop all antithrombotic agents, correct the coagulopathy with cryoprecipitate or fibrinogen concentrate, and consult neurosurgery
NEU-MCQ-20.p: อาการแย่ลงหลัง rtPA = สงสัยเลือดออกแทรก — หยุดยาต้านลิ่มเลือด แก้การแข็งตัวด้วย cryoprecipitate และปรึกษาศัลยแพทย์

NEU-MCQ-15.s: A 64-year-old woman presents 5 hours after the onset of a dense left hemiparesis, left neglect and a forced gaze to the right. Her National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale score is 18. Non-contrast computed tomography shows no haemorrhage with an ASPECTS of 8, and computed tomography angiography shows occlusion of the right middle cerebral artery M1 segment. She is outside the window for intravenous thrombolysis. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
NEU-MCQ-15.p: อาการรุนแรง + สัญญาณ LVO (ตาเบน neglect เรียกชื่อไม่ได้) + CTA พบ M1 อุด + ASPECTS ดี = ส่งลากลิ่มเลือด ได้ถึง 24 ชั่วโมง

NEU-MCQ-18.s: A 74-year-old woman has a cortical infarct in the right middle cerebral artery territory. Electrocardiography and telemetry show persistent atrial fibrillation. Her computed tomography at 24 hours shows no haemorrhagic transformation and the infarct is small. Which of the following is the most appropriate secondary prevention?
NEU-MCQ-18.p: เลือกการป้องกันตามกลไก — AF ให้ยาต้านการแข็งตัวของเลือด · หลอดเลือดแข็งให้ยาต้านเกล็ดเลือดกับ statin

NEU-MCQ-21.s: A 52-year-old woman with a complete left middle cerebral artery infarct becomes progressively drowsy on day 2. Computed tomography shows infarction of more than two-thirds of the middle cerebral artery territory with 8 mm of midline shift. Which intervention has been shown to reduce mortality in this situation?
NEU-MCQ-21.p: Malignant MCA infarction ตายจากสมองบวมและ herniation — การผ่าตัดเปิดกะโหลกลดความดันลดอัตราตาย ส่วนสเตียรอยด์ไม่ช่วย

NEU-MCQ-22.s: A 70-year-old man had a right hemispheric transient ischaemic attack 5 days ago and has recovered fully. Carotid duplex and computed tomography angiography show 80 percent stenosis of the right internal carotid artery. He is otherwise fit for surgery. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
NEU-MCQ-22.a: Carotid endarterectomy within the next 2 weeks, in addition to antiplatelet therapy and a statin
NEU-MCQ-22.p: Carotid ตีบ 70−99% และมีอาการข้างเดียวกัน = ผ่าตัดภายใน 2 สัปดาห์ ควบคู่กับยาต้านเกล็ดเลือดและ statin

NEU-MCQ-24.s: A 75-year-old woman admitted with an acute middle cerebral artery infarct is alert but has slurred speech. Her daughter asks whether she can have her usual breakfast. Which of the following is the most appropriate action before allowing oral intake?
NEU-MCQ-24.a: Perform a bedside swallowing screen, and keep her nil by mouth until it is passed
NEU-MCQ-24.p: ประเมินการกลืนก่อนให้กินทุกราย — รู้สึกตัวดีไม่ได้แปลว่ากลืนได้ และ silent aspiration ไม่แสดงอาการ

NEU-EP-MCQ-01.s: A 24-year-old man is brought to the emergency department after a witnessed generalized tonic-clonic seizure lasting 2 minutes. He has never had a seizure before. He denies alcohol or drug use. Capillary glucose 98 mg/dL, serum sodium 139 mEq/L, calcium normal. MRI of the brain shows a left mesial temporal lesion consistent with hippocampal sclerosis, and EEG shows left temporal epileptiform discharges. Which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion?
NEU-EP-MCQ-01.a: He has epilepsy and antiseizure medication may be started now
NEU-EP-MCQ-01.p: MRI มีรอยโรค + EEG มี epileptiform discharge หลังชักครั้งแรก = วินิจฉัยโรคลมชักได้เลยตามเกณฑ์ข้อ 2 ไม่ต้องรอครั้งที่สอง

NEU-EP-MCQ-02.s: A 55-year-old man with type 2 diabetes on glipizide is found unresponsive with generalized convulsions. Capillary glucose is 28 mg/dL. He recovers fully after intravenous dextrose and has no further events over 6 months. Which of the following best classifies this event?
NEU-EP-MCQ-02.a: Acute symptomatic (provoked) seizure — this is not epilepsy
NEU-EP-MCQ-02.p: แก้เหตุแล้วไม่ชักอีก = provoked seizure ไม่ใช่โรคลมชัก — เจาะน้ำตาลปลายนิ้วทุกรายที่มาด้วยชัก

NEU-EP-MCQ-03.s: A 19-year-old woman has recurrent episodes of bilateral limb shaking lasting 8–15 minutes. During episodes her eyes are tightly closed and resist passive opening, the movements are irregular and wax and wane, and she sometimes cries afterwards. She is fully oriented immediately after each episode. Serum lactate measured 10 minutes after an episode is normal. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
NEU-EP-MCQ-03.p: หลับตาแน่น + นานเกิน 5 นาที + รู้ตัวทันที + lactate ปกติ = PNES จนกว่าจะพิสูจน์เป็นอย่างอื่น

NEU-EP-MCQ-04.s: A 20-year-old man collapsed while standing in a hot queue. Bystanders report he became pale and sweaty, then fell and had about 10 seconds of irregular limb jerking. He was fully alert within 20 seconds of the event. Which feature most strongly favours syncope over an epileptic seizure?
NEU-EP-MCQ-04.a: Immediate return to full alertness without post-ictal confusion
NEU-EP-MCQ-04.p: รู้ตัวทันที = เป็นลม · สับสนหลังเหตุการณ์ = ชักจริง — และปัสสาวะราดใช้แยกไม่ได้

NEU-EP-MCQ-05.s: A 32-year-old woman describes episodes beginning with a rising sensation in the epigastrium and an intense feeling of familiarity, after which bystanders note she stares blankly and performs repetitive lip-smacking for about 60 seconds. She does not recall this part. How should this seizure be classified?
NEU-EP-MCQ-05.p: Epigastric rising + déjà vu + lip-smacking automatism = mesial temporal lobe seizure แบบ focal impaired awareness

NEU-EP-MCQ-06.s: Which of the following statements about an aura in epilepsy is correct?
NEU-EP-MCQ-06.a: It is itself a focal aware seizure and helps localize the epileptogenic zone
NEU-EP-MCQ-06.p: Aura คือการชักแล้ว ไม่ใช่ก่อนชัก — ถามรายละเอียด aura ให้ละเอียดเพราะมันชี้ตำแหน่งรอยโรค

NEU-EP-MCQ-07.s: A 28-year-old man is witnessed to have a convulsion described by his wife as 'whole body shaking'. On detailed questioning she recalls that his head and eyes first turned forcibly to the right for several seconds before the shaking began. After the event his right arm was weak for about 40 minutes. Which of the following is the most accurate classification and implication?
NEU-EP-MCQ-07.a: Focal onset seizure evolving to bilateral tonic-clonic; brain MRI is indicated
NEU-EP-MCQ-07.p: หันหน้าไปข้างหนึ่งก่อน + Todd's paralysis = focal onset เสมอ → สั่ง MRI และเลือกยาแบบ focal

NEU-EP-MCQ-08.s: A 35-year-old woman has brief nocturnal episodes lasting 20–30 seconds in which she suddenly sits up, makes bicycling movements of the legs and vocalizes, then returns to sleep with minimal confusion. Episodes occur up to 8 times per night. Interictal scalp EEG is normal. Which lobe is most likely involved?
NEU-EP-MCQ-08.p: ชักกลางคืน สั้น ถี่ ท่าทางแปลก EEG ปกติ = frontal lobe epilepsy ไม่ใช่ฝันผวาหรือ PNES

NEU-EP-MCQ-09.s: An 8-year-old girl is referred for 'daydreaming' at school. Her teacher reports she stops mid-sentence, stares for about 8 seconds with slight eyelid fluttering, then immediately continues what she was doing without any confusion. This happens dozens of times daily. Three minutes of hyperventilation in clinic reproduces an episode. Which EEG finding is expected?
NEU-EP-MCQ-09.p: เหม่อสั้น ๆ วันละหลายสิบครั้ง + hyperventilation กระตุ้นได้ = CAE, EEG 3 Hz spike-wave

NEU-EP-MCQ-10.s: A 6-year-old boy with developmental delay has multiple seizure types including sudden falls from loss of muscle tone, tonic stiffening during sleep, and atypical staring spells. EEG shows generalized slow spike-and-wave at 2 Hz. Which of the following is the most likely syndrome?
NEU-EP-MCQ-10.p: Drop attack + ชักหลายชนิด + พัฒนาการช้า + slow spike-wave < 2.5 Hz = Lennox-Gastaut

NEU-EP-MCQ-11.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the four defining characteristics used to identify an epilepsy syndrome?
NEU-EP-MCQ-11.a: Response to a therapeutic trial of benzodiazepine
NEU-EP-MCQ-11.p: สี่องค์ประกอบคือ ชนิดการชัก · อายุที่เริ่ม · EEG · MRI และพันธุกรรม — การตอบสนองต่อยาไม่ใช่เกณฑ์

NEU-EP-MCQ-12.s: A 16-year-old student is brought in after his first generalized tonic-clonic seizure, which occurred at 7 a.m. after a night of studying without sleep. On direct questioning he admits that for the past 3 years he has had brief jerks of both arms shortly after waking, occasionally spilling his morning drink. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
NEU-EP-MCQ-12.p: วัยรุ่น + GTC หลังอดนอน + สะดุ้งตอนเช้า = JME — และ jerk มาก่อน GTC เฉลี่ย 3.3 ปี

NEU-EP-MCQ-13.s: Which single lifestyle factor is described as the most potent and consistent seizure trigger in juvenile myoclonic epilepsy?
NEU-EP-MCQ-13.p: คุมการนอนคือการรักษา JME ที่ไม่ต้องสั่งยา — ถามเรื่องการนอนทุกครั้งที่ติดตามอาการ

NEU-EP-MCQ-14.s: A 14-month-old previously healthy infant has had several prolonged febrile seizures, some with unilateral clonic activity, often triggered by warm baths. Genetic testing reveals an SCN1A mutation. Which of the following medications is contraindicated?
NEU-EP-MCQ-14.p: Dravet + carbamazepine = ชักแย่ลง — จำคู่นี้ให้แม่น รวมถึง phenytoin, oxcarbazepine, lamotrigine

NEU-EP-MCQ-15.s: A 26-year-old woman has had three witnessed unprovoked convulsions over 8 months. Her routine 30-minute interictal EEG is normal and MRI of the brain is normal. Which of the following is the most appropriate interpretation?
NEU-EP-MCQ-15.a: She has epilepsy; normal EEG and MRI do not exclude the diagnosis
NEU-EP-MCQ-15.p: EEG ปกติไม่เคยตัดโรคลมชักออก — วินิจฉัยด้วยประวัติ แล้วใช้ EEG/MRI เพื่อจำแนกและหาสาเหตุ

NEU-EP-MCQ-16.s: Approximately what proportion of epilepsy cases are classified as having an unknown cause?
NEU-EP-MCQ-16.p: 1/3 = สาเหตุไม่ทราบ · 2/3 = คุมได้ด้วยยา · 1/3 = ดื้อยา — สามตัวเลขนี้ห้ามสลับกัน

NEU-EP-MCQ-17.s: A 17-year-old girl with juvenile myoclonic epilepsy is started on carbamazepine by a non-specialist. Two weeks later her morning myoclonic jerks have become much more frequent and she has had a new absence seizure. What is the most likely explanation?
NEU-EP-MCQ-17.a: Carbamazepine can aggravate generalized seizure types including myoclonic and absence seizures
NEU-EP-MCQ-17.p: JME ห้าม carbamazepine — ยา sodium channel blocker ทำให้ myoclonic และ absence แย่ลง

NEU-EP-MCQ-18.s: According to the ILAE 2013 evidence levels shown in the lecture, which statement about initial monotherapy for generalized tonic-clonic seizures in adults is correct?
NEU-EP-MCQ-18.a: No agent reaches Level A or Level B; several are Level C
NEU-EP-MCQ-18.p: Focal onset ผู้ใหญ่มี Level A สี่ตัว แต่ GTC ผู้ใหญ่ไม่มี Level A เลย — ต้องอ่าน ILAE คู่กับ NICE

NEU-EP-MCQ-19.s: A 30-year-old man with focal epilepsy continues to have seizures on carbamazepine monotherapy at a modest dose. He reports no side effects. Before concluding that the drug has failed, which of the following should be done FIRST?
NEU-EP-MCQ-19.a: Systematically exclude pseudoresistance, including adherence, correct diagnosis, correct drug choice and adequate dosing
NEU-EP-MCQ-19.p: ก่อนเรียกว่าดื้อยา ต้องแน่ใจว่า กินยาครบ · วินิจฉัยถูก · ยาถูกชนิด · ขนาดพอ

NEU-EP-MCQ-20.s: A woman of childbearing potential has focal epilepsy that is completely uncontrolled on her first ASM, which she also tolerates poorly. According to the framework presented, which strategy is preferred?
NEU-EP-MCQ-20.a: Replacement monotherapy with a different agent
NEU-EP-MCQ-20.p: ทนยาไม่ได้ + ไม่ได้ผลเลย + วัยเจริญพันธุ์ = เปลี่ยนตัวยาแบบ monotherapy ไม่ใช่เพิ่มยา

NEU-EP-MCQ-21.s: Which of the following best describes the proportion of people with active epilepsy who achieve satisfactory seizure control with antiseizure medication?
NEU-EP-MCQ-21.p: 2/3 คุมได้ด้วยยา · 1/3 ดื้อยา และ 1/3 (คนละชุด) หาสาเหตุไม่พบ

NEU-EP-MCQ-22.s: Which of the following is a recognised MODIFIABLE risk factor for sudden unexpected death in epilepsy (SUDEP)?
NEU-EP-MCQ-22.a: Poorly controlled seizures, particularly nocturnal seizures
NEU-EP-MCQ-22.p: ลดความเสี่ยง SUDEP = คุมการชักให้ได้ โดยเฉพาะชักกลางคืน — และต้องพูดเรื่องนี้กับผู้ป่วยตรง ๆ

NEU-EP-MCQ-23.s: A 29-year-old man has drug-resistant focal epilepsy. MRI shows a well-defined right mesial temporal sclerosis and video-EEG confirms all seizures arise from the same region. Neuropsychological testing suggests resection would not impair critical function. Which option offers the greatest chance of seizure freedom?
NEU-EP-MCQ-23.p: ดื้อยา + focus ชัดเจนข้างเดียว + ตัดออกได้ปลอดภัย = ส่งประเมินผ่าตัด อย่ารอเพิ่มยาไปเรื่อย ๆ

NEU-CNS-MCQ-01.s: A 45-year-old man develops a solitary frontal lobe abscess. He has had chronic purulent nasal discharge for 2 months. Which route of CNS invasion is most likely?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-01.a: Direct extension from an adjacent focus
NEU-CNS-MCQ-01.p: ฝีสมองกลีบหน้า → หาไซนัสและฟัน · กลีบขมับหรือสมองน้อย → หาหูชั้นกลาง

NEU-CNS-MCQ-02.s: A 68-year-old man presents with fever, headache and confusion. Examination shows neck stiffness and a right hemiparesis. Which of the following is the most appropriate sequence of management?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-02.a: Blood cultures, dexamethasone and empiric antibiotics first, then CT brain, then lumbar puncture
NEU-CNS-MCQ-02.p: สงสัย bacterial meningitis = ให้ยาก่อน อย่ารอภาพหรือผลเพาะเชื้อ — hemoculture → dexamethasone → ยา → CT → LP

NEU-CNS-MCQ-03.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the features listed in the lecture that should prompt CT brain before lumbar puncture?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-03.p: คอแข็งคืออาการของโรค ไม่ใช่เหตุผลให้ทำ CT — จำห้าข้อจริง: อายุ ภูมิคุ้มกัน ชัก รู้ตัวเปลี่ยน focal deficit

NEU-CNS-MCQ-04.s: A 30-year-old man has fever, headache and neck stiffness. CSF shows opening pressure 28 cmH2O, WBC 2,400/mm3 with 92% neutrophils, protein 240 mg/dL, CSF glucose 18 mg/dL with simultaneous serum glucose 110 mg/dL. Which is the most likely diagnosis?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-04.p: PMN เด่น + น้ำตาลต่ำมาก + โปรตีนสูงมาก = bacterial — อย่าลืมคำนวณอัตราส่วน CSF/serum glucose

NEU-CNS-MCQ-05.s: A 24-year-old woman has 3 days of fever and headache. CSF shows WBC 120/mm3 with 88% lymphocytes, protein 52 mg/dL, CSF glucose 62 mg/dL with serum glucose 96 mg/dL. Which pattern does this represent and what is the most likely group of pathogens?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-05.a: Viral pattern — enterovirus, HSV-2 or VZV
NEU-CNS-MCQ-05.p: Lymphocyte เด่น + น้ำตาลปกติ + โปรตีนเกือบปกติ = viral — HSV-2 และ VZV ให้ acyclovir 14–21 วัน

NEU-CNS-MCQ-06.s: A patient with advanced HIV has 3 weeks of headache. CSF opening pressure is 42 cmH2O, WBC 45/mm3 (lymphocyte predominant), protein 88 mg/dL, CSF glucose 34 mg/dL (serum 98 mg/dL). Which additional CSF test is most likely to confirm the diagnosis rapidly?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-06.a: India ink stain and cryptococcal antigen
NEU-CNS-MCQ-06.p: HIV + ปวดศีรษะเรื้อรัง + opening pressure สูงมาก = cryptococcus → India ink + CryptoAg และต้องระบายความดันด้วย

NEU-CNS-MCQ-07.s: Regarding adjunctive dexamethasone in bacterial meningitis, which statement matches the lecture?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-07.a: It should be initiated before or with the first dose of antibiotics, and shows benefit mainly in streptococcal meningitis
NEU-CNS-MCQ-07.p: Dexamethasone: ให้ก่อนหรือพร้อมยาโดสแรก และได้ผลกับ streptococcal เป็นหลัก

NEU-CNS-MCQ-08.s: A 35-year-old man has 3 weeks of progressive headache, low-grade fever and new left sixth nerve palsy. CSF shows 220 WBC/mm3 (lymphocyte predominant), protein 190 mg/dL, glucose ratio 0.28. Which treatment regimen matches the lecture?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-08.a: 2 months of isoniazid, rifampin, pyrazinamide and ethambutol, then 10 months of isoniazid and rifampin, with tapering dexamethasone
NEU-CNS-MCQ-08.p: TB meningitis = 2 IRZE/10 IR รวม 12 เดือน + dexamethasone ลดขนาด 6–8 สัปดาห์

NEU-CNS-MCQ-09.s: A 52-year-old man presents with 3 days of fever, confusion and a witnessed seizure. MRI shows asymmetric FLAIR hyperintensity with restricted diffusion in the right temporal lobe, insula and cingulate gyrus. What is the most appropriate immediate action?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-09.p: MRI ขมับไม่สมมาตร + สับสน + ชัก = HSE → acyclovir ทันที อย่ารอ PCR

NEU-CNS-MCQ-10.s: A 12-year-old boy from a rural rice-farming area develops fever, headache and altered consciousness in the rainy season. MRI shows symmetric FLAIR hyperintensity of both thalami. Which pathogen is most likely?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-10.p: ทาลามัสสองข้างสมมาตร = JE · ขมับไม่สมมาตร = HSV — แต่ยังให้ acyclovir ไปก่อนจนกว่าจะตัด HSV ออก

NEU-CNS-MCQ-11.s: A 40-year-old man has 2 weeks of worsening headache, mild left arm weakness and one seizure. He is afebrile. CT with contrast shows a ring-enhancing hypodense lesion in the right frontal lobe. Which of the following should NOT be performed?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-11.p: เห็น ring-enhancing lesion อย่าเจาะหลัง — ส่ง blood culture และปรึกษาประสาทศัลยแพทย์เพื่อดูดหนอง

NEU-CNS-MCQ-12.s: On MRI, which feature best distinguishes a pyogenic brain abscess from a cystic or necrotic brain tumour?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-12.a: Marked restricted diffusion in the centre of the lesion
NEU-CNS-MCQ-12.p: ใจกลาง restrict diffusion = ฝี · ถุงน้ำของเนื้องอกไม่ restrict

NEU-CNS-MCQ-13.s: According to the lecture, antimicrobial therapy alone (without surgery) may be appropriate for a brain abscess in which situation?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-13.a: A small abscess less than 2.5 cm in diameter in the early cerebritis stage
NEU-CNS-MCQ-13.p: ยาอย่างเดียวได้เฉพาะ ฝีเล็กกว่า 2.5 ซม. + ระยะ early cerebritis — พ้นจากนั้นต้องระบายหนอง

NEU-CNS-MCQ-14.s: A 58-year-old man with diabetes has 10 days of severe thoracic back pain and fever, and today developed leg weakness and urinary retention. Tenderness is elicited on spinal percussion. Which is the most appropriate immediate investigation and why?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-14.a: MRI of the spine with contrast, because it demonstrates epidural abscess and cord compression
NEU-CNS-MCQ-14.p: ปวดหลัง + ไข้ + neuro deficit = สั่ง MRI spine with contrast ทันที และอย่าเจาะหลัง

NEU-CNS-MCQ-15.s: Which organism is the most common cause of pyogenic spondylodiscitis and spinal epidural abscess?
NEU-CNS-MCQ-15.p: S. aureus คือเชื้อหลัก → empiric ต้องมี vancomycin เสมอ · เบาหวานหรือเคยผ่าตัดหลังให้คลุม Pseudomonas ด้วย

NEU-LP-MCQ-01.s: A 44-year-old woman presents 8 hours after a sudden severe 'worst headache of my life'. Non-contrast CT brain is normal. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
NEU-LP-MCQ-01.a: Lumbar puncture to look for subarachnoid haemorrhage
NEU-LP-MCQ-01.p: Thunderclap headache + CT ปกติ = ต้องเจาะหลังหา xanthochromia อย่าให้กลับบ้าน

NEU-LP-MCQ-02.s: Which of the following is listed in the lecture as a THERAPEUTIC (rather than diagnostic) indication for lumbar puncture?
NEU-LP-MCQ-02.p: Therapeutic มีแค่สองอย่าง: spinal anesthesia และ intrathecal drug — ที่เหลือคือเพื่อวินิจฉัย

NEU-LP-MCQ-03.s: Which technique is recommended in the lecture to reduce the risk of post-lumbar-puncture headache?
NEU-LP-MCQ-03.a: Replacing the stylet before withdrawing the spinal needle
NEU-LP-MCQ-03.p: สี่ข้อของสไลด์: เข็มเล็กกว่า 22G · ไม่เกิน 40 mL · ห้ามดูด · ใส่ stylet ก่อนถอนเข็ม

NEU-LP-MCQ-04.s: Why does the lecture state that aspiration of CSF should not be attempted during lumbar puncture?
NEU-LP-MCQ-04.a: It may increase the risk of bleeding
NEU-LP-MCQ-04.p: ปล่อยให้ไหลเอง อย่าดูด — การดูดเพิ่มความเสี่ยงเลือดออกและ traumatic tap

NEU-LP-MCQ-05.s: Two days after a diagnostic lumbar puncture, a 26-year-old woman has a headache that is severe when she stands and resolves within minutes of lying flat. Which complication is this, and which technical factor most likely contributed?
NEU-LP-MCQ-05.a: Post-LP headache from CSF leak; use of a large-bore 22G needle
NEU-LP-MCQ-05.p: ปวดหัวตอนลุก หายตอนนอน = post-LP headache — ป้องกันด้วยเข็มเล็กและใส่ stylet ก่อนถอน

NEU-LP-MCQ-06.s: A patient with suspected carcinomatous meningitis has a lumbar puncture. Which CSF test listed in the lecture is specifically needed for this indication?
NEU-LP-MCQ-06.p: สงสัยมะเร็งแพร่สู่เยื่อหุ้มสมอง = ส่ง cytology ปริมาณมากและอาจต้องส่งซ้ำ

NEU-LP-MCQ-07.s: A 62-year-old man reports blurred vision in the right eye. Visual acuity is 20/100 in that eye and does not improve with a pinhole. Which conclusion is best supported?
NEU-LP-MCQ-07.a: The cause is likely in the ocular media, retina or optic nerve rather than refractive
NEU-LP-MCQ-07.p: Pinhole ไม่ช่วย = ปัญหาไม่ได้อยู่ที่ค่าสายตา ให้รีบหาสาเหตุที่สื่อนำแสง จอประสาทตา หรือเส้นประสาทตา

NEU-LP-MCQ-08.s: A bedbound patient cannot read the top line of the Snellen chart even at 5 feet, but can correctly count the examiner's fingers held at 2 feet. How should the visual acuity be recorded?
NEU-LP-MCQ-08.p: บันทึก CF/HM/LP พร้อมระยะทางเสมอ ไม่งั้นติดตามการเปลี่ยนแปลงไม่ได้

NEU-LP-MCQ-09.s: A 28-year-old obese woman has daily headaches and transient visual obscurations. Fundoscopy shows bilateral swollen optic discs with blurred margins. Which statement is most appropriate?
NEU-LP-MCQ-09.a: This is papilledema; raised intracranial pressure must be evaluated and imaging obtained before lumbar puncture
NEU-LP-MCQ-09.p: Papilledema สองข้าง = ความดันในกะโหลกสูง → ทำภาพก่อน แล้วค่อยเจาะหลังวัดความดัน

NEU-LP-MCQ-10.s: Which fundoscopic finding is classically associated with central retinal artery occlusion?
NEU-LP-MCQ-10.a: Cherry red spot at the macula
NEU-LP-MCQ-10.p: Cherry red spot = CRAO = stroke ของตา ต้องประเมินหาแหล่งลิ่มเลือดเหมือน stroke

NEU-LP-MCQ-11.s: A 34-year-old man with advanced HIV (CD4 40 cells/µL) has 2 weeks of headache and blurred vision. CT brain shows no mass or hydrocephalus. Lumbar puncture: opening pressure 38 cmH₂O, CSF cryptococcal antigen positive. Amphotericin B and flucytosine are started. What is the most appropriate way to manage his intracranial pressure?
NEU-LP-MCQ-11.a: Therapeutic lumbar puncture to drain CSF, repeated daily until the pressure is controlled
NEU-LP-MCQ-11.p: Cryptococcal meningitis + OP สูง → เจาะระบายซ้ำทุกวัน · ไม่ใช้ steroid หรือ acetazolamide

NEU-LP-MCQ-12.s: A 52-year-old man with acute myeloid leukaemia on induction chemotherapy develops fever, headache and neck stiffness. Platelet count is 15,000/mm³; PT and aPTT are normal. CT brain is normal. Lumbar puncture is needed. According to the handout thresholds, what is the most appropriate approach?
NEU-LP-MCQ-12.a: Start empirical antibiotics now and transfuse platelets before LP, aiming for a count above 50,000/mm³
NEU-LP-MCQ-12.p: Platelet < 20,000 ห้ามเจาะ · ควรแก้ให้ > 50,000 · อย่าชะลอยาปฏิชีวนะเพื่อรอเจาะ

NEU-LP-MCQ-13.s: A 45-year-old woman has 3 weeks of morning headache and vomiting. MRI shows markedly dilated lateral and third ventricles, a small fourth ventricle and a narrowed cerebral aqueduct. Which statement about lumbar puncture in this patient is correct?
NEU-LP-MCQ-13.a: It is absolutely contraindicated because CSF removal below the obstruction creates a pressure gradient that can cause herniation
NEU-LP-MCQ-13.p: Obstructive (non-communicating) hydrocephalus = ห้ามเจาะหลัง · ต้องระบายจากเหนือจุดอุด

NEU-LP-MCQ-14.s: A 68-year-old woman receiving therapeutic-dose enoxaparin for a deep-vein thrombosis needs a non-urgent diagnostic lumbar puncture for suspected Guillain-Barré syndrome. Her last dose was 8 hours ago; platelets are 210,000/mm³. Based on the handout, when should the LP be performed?
NEU-LP-MCQ-14.a: At least 24 hours after the last dose of low-molecular-weight heparin
NEU-LP-MCQ-14.p: UFH/LMWH ภายใน 24 ชม. = ห้ามเจาะ · aPTT ไม่บอกฤทธิ์ LMWH

NEU-LP-MCQ-15.s: A resident performs a lumbar puncture with the patient in the left lateral decubitus position. Which technique matches the handout's recommendations?
NEU-LP-MCQ-15.a: Enter at L3–L4 or L4–L5 with the stylet in place, bevel facing the ceiling, angled about 15° cephalad towards the umbilicus
NEU-LP-MCQ-15.p: LP: L3–4/L4–5 · stylet in · bevel ขึ้นเพดาน · 15° เล็งสะดือ · ไม่ดูด

NEU-LP-MCQ-16.s: Three days after a diagnostic lumbar puncture with a 20G cutting needle, a 24-year-old woman has a headache that appears within 15 minutes of sitting up and resolves when she lies flat, with neck stiffness and tinnitus. She is afebrile. Two days of rest, fluids, paracetamol and caffeine have not helped. What is the most appropriate next step?
NEU-LP-MCQ-16.p: PDPH ที่ไม่ดีขึ้นด้วยการประคับประคอง → epidural blood patch

NEU-LP-MCQ-17.s: A 48-year-old woman presents 2 hours after a sudden severe headache; CT brain is normal. Lumbar puncture yields bloody CSF. RBC counts are 12,000/mm³ in tube 1 and 300/mm³ in tube 4; the specimen forms a small clot and the supernatant is clear after immediate centrifugation. WBC in tube 1 is 18/mm³. Which interpretation is most appropriate?
NEU-LP-MCQ-17.a: A traumatic tap is most likely, and the WBC count is consistent with contamination from peripheral blood
NEU-LP-MCQ-17.p: Traumatic tap: จางลง แข็งตัว ส่วนบนใส · แก้ WBC 1 ต่อ RBC 500–1,000

NEU-LP-MCQ-18.s: A 30-year-old man with HIV presents with 3 weeks of headache. CSF: opening pressure 42 cmH₂O, clear appearance, WBC 30/µL (lymphocytes 85%), protein 90 mg/dL, glucose 35 mg/dL (serum 110 mg/dL), Gram stain negative. Which test on this CSF is most sensitive for the most likely diagnosis?
NEU-LP-MCQ-18.p: HIV + OP สูงมาก + lymphocyte เซลล์น้อย glucose ต่ำ → crypto → CrAg ไว > 95%

NEU-LP-MCQ-19.s: A 26-year-old woman has painful monocular visual loss followed 6 months later by numbness ascending from both legs. CSF: WBC 12/mm³ (lymphocytes), protein 52 mg/dL, glucose normal, Gram stain and PCR negative. Which CSF finding most strongly supports the most likely diagnosis?
NEU-LP-MCQ-19.a: Oligoclonal IgG bands present in CSF but absent in serum
NEU-LP-MCQ-19.p: MS: lymphocyte 5–50 · โปรตีนสูงเล็กน้อย · OCB เฉพาะใน CSF

NEU-ACS-MCQ-01.s: A 58-year-old man with a large left middle cerebral artery infarct is awake but globally aphasic and hemiplegic on day 1. On day 3 he becomes progressively drowsy and no longer opens his eyes to voice. Which of the following best explains the new depression of consciousness?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-01.a: Cerebral oedema from the infarct causing mass effect and brainstem compression
NEU-ACS-MCQ-01.p: Stroke ซีกเดียวที่ซึมลงในวันที่ 2–5 = สมองบวมจนเกิด herniation จนกว่าจะพิสูจน์เป็นอื่น

NEU-ACS-MCQ-02.s: Which combination of findings best suggests that a comatose patient has a diffuse metabolic or toxic cause rather than a structural lesion?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-02.a: Symmetrical examination with preserved pupillary light reflexes and roving eye movements
NEU-ACS-MCQ-02.p: สมมาตร + รูม่านตายังตอบสนอง = คิดถึงเมแทบอลิก/สารพิษ · ไม่สมมาตร = คิดถึงรอยโรคโครงสร้าง

NEU-ACS-MCQ-03.s: A 62-year-old hypertensive man is brought in unresponsive with quadriplegia. He does not respond to voice or pain, but the nurse notices he opens and closes his eyes and looks up when asked. Which lesion best explains this picture?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-03.a: Ventral pontine lesion, typically from basilar artery occlusion
NEU-ACS-MCQ-03.p: ดูเหมือนโคม่า + อัมพาตทั้งตัว + มองขึ้นลงและกะพริบตาได้ = locked-in จาก ventral pons ให้รีบหา basilar occlusion

NEU-ACS-MCQ-04.s: According to the AVPU scale used in the initial survey, a patient who withdraws his arm when the nail bed is compressed but does not open his eyes or respond to loud voice should be recorded as which level?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-04.p: AVPU ระดับ P ≈ GCS 8 = จุดที่ต้องคิดเรื่องป้องกันทางเดินหายใจ

NEU-ACS-MCQ-05.s: An intubated patient opens his eyes to painful stimulation only and brings his right hand across the midline to the supraorbital notch when pressure is applied there. How should his Glasgow Coma Scale be recorded?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-05.p: ข้ามเส้นกลางตัวมาหาจุดเจ็บ = M5 localize · แค่ดึงหนี = M4 · ใส่ท่อ = V1T

NEU-ACS-MCQ-06.s: Which statement about the Glasgow Coma Scale is emphasised as a limitation in this lecture?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-06.a: A GCS of 3 is compatible with entirely intact brainstem reflexes
NEU-ACS-MCQ-06.p: GCS 3 ≠ ก้านสมองตาย — ต้องตรวจรีเฟล็กซ์ก้านสมองเองเสมอก่อนพยากรณ์โรค

NEU-ACS-MCQ-07.s: A ventilated patient in the ICU opens his eyes to loud voice but does not track, shows flexion to pain, has absent corneal reflexes with reactive pupils, and triggers breaths above the set ventilator rate. What is his FOUR score?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-07.p: FOUR score: E ตามการลืมตา/มองตาม · M ตามท่าทาง · B ตามรีเฟล็กซ์ · R ตามการหายใจกับเครื่อง

NEU-ACS-MCQ-08.s: Which advantage of the FOUR score over the GCS is most relevant when following a deeply comatose, intubated patient from day to day?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-08.a: It avoids a floor effect and still discriminates change at the bottom of the scale
NEU-ACS-MCQ-08.p: จุดแข็งของ FOUR score คือยังแยกความต่างได้ที่ก้นสเกล ซึ่งเป็นจุดที่ GCS ตัน

NEU-ACS-MCQ-09.s: An unresponsive man is brought to the emergency department. He smells of alcohol, is malnourished, and the capillary glucose reads 38 mg/dL. Which is the most appropriate immediate management?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-09.a: Give 50 mL of 50% dextrose intravenously together with (or preceded by) intravenous thiamine
NEU-ACS-MCQ-09.p: น้ำตาลต่ำ + ดื่มสุรา/ขาดสารอาหาร = ให้ thiamine พร้อมกลูโคส อย่าให้กลูโคสเดี่ยว ๆ

NEU-ACS-MCQ-10.s: Which oxygen saturation target does the lecture specify during initial stabilisation of the comatose patient?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-10.p: เป้าหมาย SpO₂ ในผู้ป่วยโคม่าคือ 94–98% — ทั้งขาดและเกินออกซิเจนล้วนทำร้ายสมอง

NEU-ACS-MCQ-11.s: A comatose patient after a fall has a right pupil of 6 mm that does not react to light, while the left pupil is 3 mm and reactive. He has left-sided decerebrate posturing. What is the most likely mechanism and the most urgent action?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-11.a: Uncal herniation compressing the right third nerve — urgent CT brain and neurosurgical consultation
NEU-ACS-MCQ-11.p: รูม่านตาข้างเดียวขยายค้าง + ระดับความรู้สึกตัวลด = uncal herniation → CT ทันทีและปรึกษาผ่าตัด

NEU-ACS-MCQ-12.s: In an intubated comatose patient, which reflex is both the most practical to test repeatedly and, when lost, contributes to the lowest brainstem score on the FOUR scale?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-12.a: The cough reflex elicited by deep tracheal suctioning
NEU-ACS-MCQ-12.p: รีเฟล็กซ์ไอจากการดูดเสมหะ = ตรวจซ้ำได้จริงในผู้ใส่ท่อ และเป็นตัวที่ทำให้ B ตกถึง 0

NEU-ACS-MCQ-13.s: Ice-cold water is instilled into the right ear of a comatose patient whose head is elevated 30 degrees. Both eyes deviate slowly towards the right and remain there, with no fast corrective phase. What does this indicate?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-13.a: An intact brainstem with loss of cortical function
NEU-ACS-MCQ-13.p: Slow phase = ก้านสมอง · Fast phase = เปลือกสมอง · โคม่าที่มีแต่ slow phase แปลว่าก้านสมองยังดี

NEU-ACS-MCQ-14.s: Which spontaneous eye finding is described in the lecture as specific for an acute pontine lesion?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-14.p: Ocular bobbing = ลงเร็ว ขึ้นช้า = พอนส์เฉียบพลัน จนกว่าจะพิสูจน์เป็นอื่น

NEU-ACS-MCQ-15.s: A patient with a large intracerebral haemorrhage initially shows bilateral elbow and wrist flexion with leg extension in response to pain. Four hours later both arms extend and internally rotate with pain. What does this change signify?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-15.a: Rostro-caudal deterioration — the lesion is now affecting the midbrain or upper pons
NEU-ACS-MCQ-15.p: Decorticate → decerebrate ใน 4 ชั่วโมง = herniation กำลังดำเนินอยู่ ต้องลงมือทันที

NEU-ACS-MCQ-16.s: A comatose patient after cardiac arrest has subtle rhythmic twitching of the left corner of the mouth and intermittent eyelid fluttering. Which investigation is most likely to change management?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-16.p: กระตุกเล็ก ๆ เป็นจังหวะในผู้ป่วยโคม่า = ส่ง EEG หา non-convulsive status ทันที

NEU-ACS-MCQ-17.s: A 70-year-old woman is found unresponsive. CT brain is normal, glucose, electrolytes, renal and liver function are normal, and toxicology is negative. Her pupils are equal and reactive and she has intermittent right eyelid twitching. Which two diagnoses must remain highest on the list?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-17.a: Non-convulsive status epilepticus and basilar artery occlusion
NEU-ACS-MCQ-17.p: CT ปกติ + เลือดปกติ + ยังโคม่า = คิด non-convulsive status (ส่ง EEG) และ basilar occlusion (ส่ง CTA)

NEU-ACS-MCQ-18.s: A febrile, confused patient with neck stiffness is being worked up. CT brain must be done before lumbar puncture because of drowsiness and a focal deficit. What is the correct sequence?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-18.a: Blood cultures, then empirical antibiotics and dexamethasone, then CT, then lumbar puncture
NEU-ACS-MCQ-18.p: สงสัยเยื่อหุ้มสมองอักเสบ: เพาะเลือด → ยาปฏิชีวนะ + dexamethasone → CT → LP

NEU-ACS-MCQ-19.s: A comatose patient with raised intracranial pressure is awaiting neurosurgery. Which measure should be applied first because it is immediate, free and effective?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-19.a: Elevate the head of the bed to 30 degrees with the head in the midline
NEU-ACS-MCQ-19.p: ลด ICP เริ่มที่ยกหัวเตียง 30 องศา + ศีรษะตรงกลาง ก่อนยาใด ๆ

NEU-ACS-MCQ-20.s: Which of the following is listed by the lecture as part of routine supportive care for the comatose patient?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-20.a: Maintaining mean arterial pressure at or above 65 mmHg with DVT and stress ulcer prophylaxis
NEU-ACS-MCQ-20.p: Supportive care: MAP ≥ 65 · ป้องกัน DVT และแผลกระเพาะ · ควบคุมอุณหภูมิ · สมดุลสารน้ำ ไม่ใช่จำกัดสารน้ำ

NEU-ACS-MCQ-21.s: A 72-year-old man is referred as 'acutely confused'. He speaks fluently but his sentences are full of made-up words, he cannot follow 'close your eyes', and he cannot repeat a phrase. He is fully awake, attentive to the examiner and not drowsy. What is the most likely diagnosis?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-21.a: Wernicke aphasia from a left temporal stroke
NEU-ACS-MCQ-21.p: พูดคล่องแต่ไม่เป็นเรื่อง + ทำตามสั่งไม่ได้ + ตื่นดีและมีสมาธิ = aphasia ไม่ใช่ delirium

NEU-ACS-MCQ-22.s: Which cognitive domain should be tested FIRST when assessing a patient with an acute confusional state, and why?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-22.a: Attention, because impaired attention invalidates the interpretation of all other cognitive testing
NEU-ACS-MCQ-22.p: ตรวจสมาธิก่อนเสมอ — สมาธิเสียทำให้ผลทดสอบความจำและการรู้คิดอื่นเชื่อถือไม่ได้ทั้งหมด

NEU-ACS-MCQ-23.s: According to the lecture, which perceptual disturbance is the MOST COMMON in delirium?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-23.a: Decreased perceptions per unit of time — patients miss things going on around them
NEU-ACS-MCQ-23.p: ความผิดปกติของการรับรู้ที่พบบ่อยที่สุดใน delirium คือรับรู้ได้น้อยลง ไม่ใช่ประสาทหลอน

NEU-ACS-MCQ-24.s: The ward round at 09:00 finds an 80-year-old post-operative woman pleasant, oriented and cooperative. The night nurse reports that at 02:00 she was pulling at her intravenous line, shouting at people who were not there and did not know where she was. What is the correct interpretation?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-24.a: She has delirium — fluctuation with nocturnal worsening (sundowning) is characteristic and the daytime examination does not exclude it
NEU-ACS-MCQ-24.p: ปกติตอนเช้าแต่สับสนตอนกลางคืน = delirium ที่ผันผวน ต้องอ่านบันทึกเวรดึกเสมอ

NEU-ACS-MCQ-25.s: Using the Confusion Assessment Method, which combination of features is required to diagnose delirium?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-25.a: Acute onset with fluctuating course AND inattention, plus either disorganized thinking OR altered level of consciousness
NEU-ACS-MCQ-25.p: CAM = (1 และ 2) บวก (3 หรือ 4) — ข้อ 1 และ 2 ขาดไม่ได้

NEU-ACS-MCQ-26.s: Which subtype of delirium is the most common and carries the worst prognosis?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-26.p: Hypoactive delirium = พบบ่อยที่สุด มองข้ามบ่อยที่สุด แย่ที่สุด → ต้องคัดกรองเชิงรุกทุกวัน

NEU-ACS-MCQ-27.s: An 82-year-old woman becomes confused on the second night after hip fracture surgery. Her medications include diphenhydramine for sleep, meperidine for pain and cimetidine. Which single intervention is most likely to improve her delirium?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-27.a: Review and rationalise the medication list, replacing the deliriogenic drugs while still controlling her pain
NEU-ACS-MCQ-27.p: Delirium หลังผ่าตัด = ทบทวนยาก่อน แต่ต้องคุมความเจ็บต่อไป อย่าหยุดยาแก้ปวดทั้งหมด

NEU-ACS-MCQ-28.s: In the I WATCH DEATH mnemonic, which cause is represented by the letter W, and why is it particularly dangerous to miss in hospitalised patients?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-28.a: Withdrawal — from alcohol or benzodiazepines, which can progress to seizures and delirium tremens
NEU-ACS-MCQ-28.p: W = Withdrawal · ถอนสุรา/เบนโซเป็นเหตุเดียวที่รักษาด้วยเบนโซ ต่างจาก delirium ทั่วไป

NEU-ACS-MCQ-29.s: A 78-year-old man with Parkinson disease develops hyperactive delirium after pneumonia and is trying to climb out of bed. Non-pharmacological measures have failed and he is at risk of falling. Which drug choice is contraindicated?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-29.p: ห้าม haloperidol ในพาร์กินสันและ Lewy body dementia — ใช้ quetiapine ขนาดต่ำแทน

NEU-ACS-MCQ-30.s: Which statement best reflects the lecture's message about non-pharmacological management of delirium?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-30.a: Non-pharmacological interventions reduce both mortality and the duration of delirium
NEU-ACS-MCQ-30.p: มาตรการที่ไม่ใช้ยาลดทั้งอัตราตายและระยะเวลาของ delirium — ยาไม่ทำได้แบบนั้น และป้องกันได้ราว 1 ใน 3

NEU-ACS-MCQ-31.s: สาร neurotransmitter ใดต่อไปนี้ มีบทบาทสำคัญที่สุดในการเกิด delirium
NEU-ACS-MCQ-31.p: Delirium = ACh ขาด + dopamine เกิน · ยา anticholinergic จึงเป็นตัวการบ่อย

NEU-ACS-MCQ-32.s: Delirium type ใดพบบ่อยที่สุด
NEU-ACS-MCQ-32.p: Hypoactive พบบ่อยที่สุด — ต้องคัดกรองเชิงรุก ไม่รอให้ผู้ป่วยโวยวาย

NEU-ACS-MCQ-33.s: จากข้อมูลงานวิจัย อายุตั้งแต่เท่าใดขึ้นไป เพิ่มความเสี่ยงต่อการเกิด delirium
NEU-ACS-MCQ-33.p: อายุ ≥ 65 ปี + สมองเสื่อมเดิม + สะโพกหัก + ป่วยหนัก = กลุ่มเสี่ยง delirium ต้องคัดกรอง

NEU-ACS-MCQ-34.s: ผู้ป่วยหญิง 78 ปี ลูกสาวพามาโรงพยาบาลเนื่องจากมีอาการสับสนมา 2 วัน เดิมผู้ป่วยช่วยเหลือตนเองได้น้อย มีโรคประจำตัว DM, HT, DLP และ old ischemic stroke มีผู้ดูแลประจำ ลูกสาวอยู่บ้านติดกันและแวะมาเยี่ยมเป็นครั้งคราว ท่านเป็นแพทย์ที่ดูแล ควรซักประวัติจากใครเหมาะสมที่สุด
NEU-ACS-MCQ-34.a: ผู้ดูแลประจำ
NEU-ACS-MCQ-34.p: Delirium: ซักประวัติจากคนที่เห็นผู้ป่วยทุกวัน — baseline · onset · fluctuation · ยา

NEU-ACS-MCQ-35.s: การตรวจ digit span (ทวนตัวเลขไปข้างหน้า) ในผู้ใหญ่ที่สุขภาพและสมองปกติ จะพูดตามผู้ตรวจได้กี่ตัวเลข
NEU-ACS-MCQ-35.p: Digit span ไปข้างหน้า < 5 = inattention · ปกติ 7 ± 2

NEU-ACS-MCQ-36.s: ผู้ป่วยชาย 40 ปี ถูกนำส่งโรงพยาบาลเนื่องจากมีอาการสับสนเฉียบพลัน พูดจาไม่รู้เรื่อง มือสั่นทั้งสองข้าง เห็นภาพหลอน กระสับกระส่าย เหงื่อออกมาก มีประวัติหยุดดื่มสุรามาได้ 3 วัน ปฏิเสธโรคประจำตัวเนื่องจากไม่เคยตรวจร่างกาย ตรวจร่างกาย T 40 °C, PR 110/min, RR 25/min, BP 160/100 mmHg, disorientation to time, place, person, inattention, cannot follow simple command, normal extraocular movement, coarse tremor of both hands สาเหตุใดเป็นไปได้มากที่สุด
NEU-ACS-MCQ-36.p: หยุดสุรา 48–96 ชม. + delirium + ไข้ ชีพจรเร็ว BP สูง เหงื่อ = delirium tremens → BZD + thiamine

NEU-ACS-MCQ-37.s: An 82-year-old woman with CKD (creatinine clearance 20 mL/min) is treated for hospital-acquired pneumonia. On day 3 she becomes confused, inattentive and has multifocal myoclonic jerks. Glucose, sodium and calcium are normal; CT brain is unremarkable. Which current medication is the most likely cause?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-37.p: Delirium + myoclonus ในไตเสื่อมที่ได้ cefepime → นึกถึง cefepime neurotoxicity

NEU-ACS-MCQ-38.s: A 70-year-old man becomes acutely confused on a medical ward. Temperature is 38.6 °C and there is marked neck stiffness; there is no focal neurological sign. According to the laboratory evaluation algorithm in the handout, which investigation must be added to the basic metabolic, ECG, toxicology and infection work-up?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-38.a: Cerebrospinal fluid examination by lumbar puncture (after CT if indicated)
NEU-ACS-MCQ-38.p: Delirium + ไข้/คอแข็ง → CSF · + focal/ชัก → ภาพสมอง + EEG

NEU-ACS-MCQ-39.s: A 76-year-old man with hyperactive delirium from urosepsis is pulling at his intravenous line and has struck a nurse despite de-escalation and family presence. His QTc is 440 ms and he has no history of Parkinson's disease. Which pharmacological option best follows the handout?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-39.a: Low-dose haloperidol, with ECG monitoring for QT prolongation and observation for extrapyramidal signs
NEU-ACS-MCQ-39.p: จำเป็นต้องใช้ยา → haloperidol ขนาดต่ำ · ห้าม low-potency typical, BZD, antihistamine

NEU-ACS-MCQ-40.s: An 84-year-old woman admitted with a hip fracture is described by nurses as 'quiet and depressed'. She lies still, speaks little, falls asleep during the interview and cannot name the days of the week backwards; her daughter says she was independent and chatty until 3 days ago. What is the most appropriate interpretation?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-40.a: Hypoactive delirium, which should prompt a search for precipitating causes
NEU-ACS-MCQ-40.p: เงียบ ซึม หลับง่าย + สมาธิเสีย + เปลี่ยนเร็ว = hypoactive delirium ไม่ใช่ซึมเศร้า

NEU-ACS-MCQ-41.s: Suvorexant and lemborexant are used to treat insomnia, including sleep disturbance in delirium. Which mechanism explains how they promote sleep without the global CNS depression typical of benzodiazepines?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-41.a: They block orexin receptors, removing the hypothalamic drive that activates the arousal nuclei of the reticular activating system
NEU-ACS-MCQ-41.p: DORA = ต้าน orexin · melatonin/ramelteon = ตั้งนาฬิกา · BZD = กด GABA ทั้งสมอง

NEU-ACS-MCQ-42.s: A 79-year-old man on day 4 of treatment for pneumonia has delirium that is worse at night; he sleeps most of the day. Lights and monitor alarms are on all night. After optimising the environment (daylight, eye mask, earplugs, clustered care), sleep remains poor. Which medication has the strongest support in the handout for delirium-related sleep disturbance?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-42.a: Melatonin or ramelteon in the evening
NEU-ACS-MCQ-42.p: Delirium นอนไม่หลับ: แก้สิ่งแวดล้อมก่อน → melatonin/ramelteon · เลี่ยง BZD Z-drug antihistamine TCA

NEU-ACS-MCQ-43.s: A 58-year-old man is comatose after a cardiac arrest. Every few seconds both eyes drift slowly downward and then return rapidly to the midline. Horizontal doll's eye responses are present. Which pattern is this and what does it most likely indicate?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-43.a: Ocular dipping, indicating diffuse cortical injury such as hypoxic–ischaemic encephalopathy
NEU-ACS-MCQ-43.p: Bobbing ลงเร็ว = pons · Dipping ลงช้า = HIE/เปลือกสมองทั่ว

NEU-ACS-MCQ-44.s: When performing caloric testing (oculovestibular reflex) on a comatose patient, which procedure follows the handout?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-44.a: Elevate the head 30°, confirm intact tympanic membranes, instil 50 mL of cold water (≤ 30 °C) over 30 seconds, observe for 1 minute and wait 5 minutes before testing the other ear
NEU-ACS-MCQ-44.p: Caloric: 30° · TM intact · cold 50 mL/30 s · ดู 1 นาที · เว้น 5 นาที · สองหูพร้อมกัน = แนวดิ่ง

NEU-ACS-MCQ-45.s: A 45-year-old woman is brought in stuporous after a sudden severe headache. Pupils are equal and reactive, there is no hemiparesis and plantar responses are flexor, but she has marked neck stiffness. Fundoscopy shows a large haemorrhage in front of the retina with a flat upper border. Following the handout's algorithm, which group of causes should be considered first?
NEU-ACS-MCQ-45.p: ซึม + ไม่มี localizing sign + คอแข็ง = SAH หรือ meningitis · subhyaloid hemorrhage ชี้ SAH

END-MS-MCQ-01.s: Which of the following best explains why visceral (intra-abdominal) fat is more strongly linked to insulin resistance than subcutaneous fat?
END-MS-MCQ-01.a: Visceral adipocytes release free fatty acids directly into the portal circulation to the liver
END-MS-MCQ-01.p: Visceral fat → FFA → portal vein → ตับ = รากของน้ำตาลสูงและ TG สูงใน MetS

END-MS-MCQ-02.s: Compared with individuals without metabolic syndrome, patients with metabolic syndrome have approximately what increase in risk of developing type 2 diabetes?

END-MS-MCQ-03.s: A 48-year-old Thai man has waist circumference 92 cm, BP 128/82 mmHg (no treatment), fasting glucose 96 mg/dL, triglyceride 180 mg/dL and HDL-C 38 mg/dL. According to the harmonized criteria, how many components of metabolic syndrome does he have, and does he meet the definition?
END-MS-MCQ-03.p: นับให้ครบห้าข้อ ใช้รอบเอวเกณฑ์เอเชีย แล้วดูว่าถึง 3 ข้อหรือไม่

END-MS-MCQ-04.s: A 35-year-old woman is 160 cm tall. Using the waist-to-height ratio criterion shown in the lecture, above what waist circumference is she classified as having central obesity?
END-MS-MCQ-04.p: WHtR ≥0.5 → รอบเอวเกิน ส่วนสูง/2 = อ้วนลงพุง

END-MS-MCQ-05.s: Which technique for measuring waist circumference is correct?
END-MS-MCQ-05.a: Measure at the umbilicus (or midway between the lower rib margin and iliac crest) with the tape parallel to the floor at normal expiration
END-MS-MCQ-05.p: รอบเอว: ผ่านสะดือ · ขนานพื้น · หายใจออกปกติ · ไม่รัด

END-MS-MCQ-06.s: A 45-year-old man with metabolic syndrome (waist 98 cm, BP 142/90 mmHg, TG 220 mg/dL, HDL-C 36 mg/dL, FPG 110 mg/dL) asks what single intervention will improve all components of his condition. Which is the best answer?
END-MS-MCQ-06.a: Intensive lifestyle modification aiming for 5–10% weight loss and at least 150 minutes/week of moderate exercise
END-MS-MCQ-06.p: ลดไขมันในช่องท้อง = รักษาทุกองค์ประกอบของ MetS พร้อมกัน

END-MS-MCQ-07.s: In a patient with metabolic syndrome and newly diagnosed stage 1 hypertension without other compelling indications, which antihypertensive class is preferred according to the lecture?
END-MS-MCQ-07.p: ความดันใน MetS → ACEI/ARB เพราะเป็นกลางทางเมตาบอลิก

END-OB-MCQ-01.s: A 40-year-old Thai woman weighs 68 kg and is 1.60 m tall. Using the Asia-Pacific BMI classification, how is she classified?
END-OB-MCQ-01.p: คนไทย BMI ≥25 = อ้วนระดับ 1 ตามเกณฑ์ Asia-Pacific

END-OB-MCQ-02.s: A 25-year-old professional rugby player has BMI 31 kg/m², waist circumference 84 cm and body fat 12% by DEXA. Which statement best describes the limitation illustrated?
END-OB-MCQ-02.a: BMI overestimates adiposity because it cannot distinguish fat from lean mass
END-OB-MCQ-02.p: BMI สูงในคนกล้ามเยอะ ≠ อ้วน — ยืนยันไขมันด้วยรอบเอวหรือการวัดไขมันเสมอ

END-OB-MCQ-03.s: According to the 2025 Lancet Commission, which of the following distinguishes 'clinical obesity' from 'preclinical obesity'?
END-OB-MCQ-03.a: The presence of objective organ dysfunction or limitation of daily activities caused by excess adiposity
END-OB-MCQ-03.p: Clinical obesity = ไขมันเกิน + อวัยวะทำงานผิดปกติหรือจำกัดกิจวัตรแล้ว

END-OB-MCQ-04.s: A 52-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes (HbA1c 8.4%) and BMI 32 kg/m² is currently taking metformin and glipizide. Which add-on agent would best improve glycaemia while promoting weight loss?
END-OB-MCQ-04.p: เบาหวาน + อ้วน → เติม GLP-1RA หรือ SGLT2i ไม่เติม SU/TZD/insulin

END-OB-MCQ-05.s: A 30-year-old man with schizophrenia gained 14 kg in 6 months after starting an antipsychotic. Fasting glucose is now 118 mg/dL. Which antipsychotic is he most likely taking, and what is a lower-weight-gain alternative?
END-OB-MCQ-05.p: Olanzapine/clozapine = อ้วนที่สุด · ทางเลือก aripiprazole, ziprasidone, lurasidone
