END-OB-MCQ-06.s: Which clinical feature most reliably suggests Cushing's syndrome rather than simple obesity in a patient with central weight gain?
END-OB-MCQ-06.a: Proximal muscle weakness with wide (>1 cm) purple abdominal striae and easy bruising
END-OB-MCQ-06.p: ลายท้องสีม่วงกว้าง >1 cm + อ่อนแรงส่วนต้น + ฟกช้ำ → คิดถึง Cushing

END-OB-MCQ-07.s: Which of the following obesity-related complications is primarily caused by the mechanical (anatomical) effect of excess weight rather than by metabolic dysfunction of adipose tissue?
END-OB-MCQ-07.p: ผลเชิงกายภาพ = OSA, OHS, OA, GERD · ผลเชิงเมตาบอลิก = T2D, MASLD, DLP, PCOS

END-OB-MCQ-08.s: Based on the Prospective Studies Collaboration (Lancet 2009), by approximately how many years is median survival reduced in people with BMI 40–50 kg/m² compared with BMI 22.5–25 kg/m²?

END-OB-MCQ-09.s: A 44-year-old man, BMI 36 kg/m², neck circumference 44 cm, BP 146/92 mmHg, reports loud snoring and daytime sleepiness; his wife has seen him stop breathing at night. According to the lecture, what is the most appropriate next step?
END-OB-MCQ-09.a: Refer to a pulmonologist for evaluation of obstructive sleep apnea
END-OB-MCQ-09.p: STOP-BANG >4 → ส่งตรวจ sleep study · ห้ามให้ยานอนหลับในผู้ที่สงสัย OSA

END-OB-MCQ-10.s: A 38-year-old woman weighs 100 kg, height 165 cm (BMI 37 kg/m²), with prediabetes and knee pain. What is the most appropriate initial weight-loss goal?
END-OB-MCQ-10.a: Lose 3–10% of body weight (about 3–10 kg) over 6 months
END-OB-MCQ-10.p: เป้าแรกของการลดน้ำหนัก = 5–10% ใน 6 เดือน

END-OB-MCQ-11.s: Which set of laboratory tests should be considered for most patients presenting for obesity management according to the Canadian Adult Obesity CPG 2020 shown in the lecture?
END-OB-MCQ-11.a: Fasting glucose/HbA1c, lipid profile, ALT, electrolytes and renal function, CBC
END-OB-MCQ-11.p: แล็บพื้นฐานโรคอ้วน: glucose/HbA1c · lipid · ALT · ไต · CBC — TSH ส่งตามข้อบ่งชี้

END-OB-MCQ-12.s: A 34-year-old woman with obesity asks about orlistat. Which adverse effect or precaution is specific to its mechanism of action?
END-OB-MCQ-12.a: Oily spotting, steatorrhoea and deficiency of fat-soluble vitamins
END-OB-MCQ-12.p: Orlistat = lipase inhibitor → อุจจาระมัน + ขาดวิตามิน ADEK

END-OB-MCQ-13.s: A 29-year-old woman with BMI 33 kg/m² and a history of epilepsy on levetiracetam requests medication for weight loss. Which agent is contraindicated?
END-OB-MCQ-13.p: Bupropion ห้ามในลมชัก · naltrexone ห้ามในผู้ใช้ opioid

END-OB-MCQ-14.s: A patient on semaglutide 2.4 mg once weekly (scheduled every Monday) realises on Sunday that she forgot Monday's dose. What should she do?
END-OB-MCQ-14.a: Skip the missed dose and inject the next dose on Monday as scheduled
END-OB-MCQ-14.p: Semaglutide ลืมฉีด: ≤5 วันฉีดทันที · >5 วันข้าม ห้ามฉีดชดเชยสองเข็ม

END-OB-MCQ-15.s: A 46-year-old man (BMI 31 kg/m²) completed 3 months of lifestyle therapy and then started liraglutide 3.0 mg. After 4 months at the maintenance dose he has lost only 3% of body weight. What is the most appropriate action?
END-OB-MCQ-15.a: Consider stopping the drug and reassessing treatment options
END-OB-MCQ-15.p: AOM 3–5 เดือนแล้วลด <5% = ไม่ตอบสนอง → หยุดและทบทวนแผน

END-OB-MCQ-16.s: A 42-year-old Thai woman with BMI 38 kg/m² has no diabetes, hypertension or other obesity-related co-morbidities. She has tried supervised lifestyle therapy for 1 year without success. According to the Thai 2021 guideline, is she eligible for bariatric surgery?
END-OB-MCQ-16.a: Yes — BMI ≥37.5 kg/m² qualifies regardless of co-morbidities
END-OB-MCQ-16.p: ไทย: BMI ≥37.5 ผ่าตัดได้เลยโดยไม่ต้องมีโรคร่วม

END-OB-MCQ-17.s: A 50-year-old man with long-standing type 2 diabetes (HbA1c 9.1% despite three agents), severe erosive GERD, and BMI 36 kg/m² is referred for metabolic surgery. Which procedure is generally preferred for him?
END-OB-MCQ-17.a: Roux-en-Y gastric bypass, because it improves GERD and achieves higher diabetes remission rates
END-OB-MCQ-17.p: มี GERD → เลือก RYGB ไม่ใช่ sleeve · RYGB ทำให้เบาหวานสงบได้มากกว่า

END-DLP-MCQ-01.s: Which apolipoprotein is required to activate lipoprotein lipase and allow hydrolysis of triglyceride in chylomicrons and VLDL?
END-DLP-MCQ-01.p: ApoC-II กระตุ้น LPL — ขาดแล้ว chylomicron ค้าง TG สูงมาก

END-DLP-MCQ-02.s: Statins lower plasma LDL-C mainly by which mechanism?
END-DLP-MCQ-02.a: Inhibiting HMG-CoA reductase, lowering hepatocyte cholesterol and up-regulating LDL receptors
END-DLP-MCQ-02.p: Statin → คอเลสเตอรอลในตับลด → LDL receptor เพิ่ม → LDL ในเลือดลด

END-DLP-MCQ-03.s: A 38-year-old man has LDL-C 280 mg/dL, thickened Achilles tendons with nodules, and his father had a myocardial infarction at age 46. TSH, glucose, creatinine and liver tests are normal. Using the Dutch Lipid Clinic Network criteria, what is his score category?
END-DLP-MCQ-03.p: Tendon xanthoma (6) + LDL 250–329 (5) = definite FH ได้เลย

END-DLP-MCQ-04.s: A 55-year-old woman is found to have LDL-C 238 mg/dL on routine screening. Her previous LDL-C two years ago was 120 mg/dL. She reports fatigue, weight gain, constipation and cold intolerance. What is the most appropriate next step?
END-DLP-MCQ-04.p: LDL สูงขึ้นใหม่ + อาการ hypothyroid → ตรวจ TSH ก่อนเริ่ม statin

END-DLP-MCQ-05.s: A 45-year-old man has total cholesterol 390 mg/dL and triglyceride 420 mg/dL of roughly equal magnitude, with yellow-orange deposits in the palmar creases. Which genotype is most likely?

END-DLP-MCQ-06.s: A 58-year-old man is discharged after an NSTEMI. His LDL-C is 142 mg/dL and he has never taken lipid-lowering therapy. According to ESC/EAS guidance, what is the most appropriate lipid-lowering plan?
END-DLP-MCQ-06.a: High-intensity statin (e.g. atorvastatin 80 mg) aiming for LDL-C below 55 mg/dL and at least 50% reduction
END-DLP-MCQ-06.p: หลัง ACS → high-intensity statin ทันที เป้า LDL <55 และลด ≥50%

END-DLP-MCQ-07.s: Lipid profile: total cholesterol 240 mg/dL, HDL-C 40 mg/dL, triglyceride 250 mg/dL. What is the calculated LDL-C using the Friedewald equation?
END-DLP-MCQ-07.p: LDL = TC − HDL − TG/5 · ใช้ไม่ได้ถ้า TG >400

END-DLP-MCQ-08.s: A 64-year-old woman on atorvastatin 40 mg develops diffuse muscle pain and dark urine one week after starting clarithromycin. CK is 18 times the upper limit of normal. What is the most appropriate management?
END-DLP-MCQ-08.a: Stop atorvastatin (and clarithromycin), give IV fluids and monitor renal function
END-DLP-MCQ-08.p: CK >10× + ปัสสาวะเข้ม → หยุด statin · CYP3A4 inhibitor และ gemfibrozil เพิ่มความเสี่ยง

END-DLP-MCQ-09.s: A 60-year-old man with prior ischaemic stroke has LDL-C 84 mg/dL despite 3 months of rosuvastatin 40 mg with good adherence. What is the next step?
END-DLP-MCQ-09.p: Statin ขนาดสูงสุดแล้วยังไม่ถึงเป้า → + ezetimibe → + PCSK9 inhibitor

END-DLP-MCQ-10.s: A 42-year-old man with poorly controlled type 2 diabetes (HbA1c 11%) who drinks heavily presents with epigastric pain radiating to the back. Serum lipase is 5 times normal and the serum is milky; triglyceride is 2,400 mg/dL. Besides supportive care, which therapy lowers triglyceride most rapidly in this setting?
END-DLP-MCQ-10.p: TG-induced pancreatitis → insulin infusion กระตุ้น LPL · bile acid sequestrant ทำให้ TG สูงขึ้น

END-DLP-MCQ-11.s: A patient on rosuvastatin 20 mg has persistent triglyceride of 620 mg/dL despite diet, alcohol abstinence and good glycaemic control. A fibrate is to be added. Which choice is most appropriate?
END-DLP-MCQ-11.p: Statin + fibrate → fenofibrate เสมอ ไม่ใช้ gemfibrozil

END-TH-MCQ-01.s: A 68-year-old man in the ICU with septic shock has a TSH of 0.4 mIU/L (0.3–4.1), FT4 0.9 ng/dL (0.8–1.8) and a low total T3 with high reverse T3. He has no goitre and no history of thyroid disease. What is the most appropriate interpretation and action?
END-TH-MCQ-01.a: Non-thyroidal illness (euthyroid sick syndrome); do not treat, recheck after recovery
END-TH-MCQ-01.p: ICU + T3 ต่ำ rT3 สูง TSH ไม่สูง = euthyroid sick → ไม่รักษา

END-TH-MCQ-02.s: A 30-year-old woman with Graves' disease has been taking methimazole for 6 weeks. She feels much better. FT4 is now 1.2 ng/dL (0.8–1.8) and FT3 is normal, but TSH remains < 0.01 mIU/L. What should be done with her methimazole dose?
END-TH-MCQ-02.a: Adjust the dose according to FT4 and T3, recognising that TSH may remain suppressed for months
END-TH-MCQ-02.p: ช่วงรักษา Graves: ปรับยาตาม FT4/T3 ไม่ใช่ TSH

END-TH-MCQ-03.s: A 34-year-old woman has palpitations and tremor. FT4 2.6 ng/dL (0.8–1.8), FT3 7.0 pg/mL (1.6–4), TSH 3.8 mIU/L (0.3–4.1). She has headaches and bitemporal visual field loss. After excluding assay interference, what is the most likely diagnosis?
END-TH-MCQ-03.p: FT4 สูง + TSH ไม่ต่ำ + bitemporal hemianopia = TSH-oma

END-TH-MCQ-04.s: A 29-year-old woman had severe postpartum haemorrhage 1 year ago and has not menstruated since. She is fatigued and cold-intolerant. FT4 0.5 ng/dL (0.8–1.8), TSH 1.2 mIU/L (0.3–4.1). Before starting levothyroxine, what must be assessed?
END-TH-MCQ-04.p: Central hypothyroid → เช็ค cortisol ก่อนให้ LT4

END-TH-MCQ-05.s: A 26-year-old nurse has weight loss, palpitations and tremor. Her thyroid is not palpable. FT4 is high, TSH is suppressed, 24-hour radioiodine uptake is 1%, and serum thyroglobulin is undetectable. What is the most likely diagnosis?
END-TH-MCQ-05.p: RAIU ~0 + Tg ต่ำ + ต่อมเล็ก = กินฮอร์โมนเอง

END-TH-MCQ-06.s: Which cause of thyrotoxicosis is associated with an INCREASED radioactive iodine uptake?
END-TH-MCQ-06.p: hCG (molar pregnancy, hyperemesis) = hyperthyroidism จริง RAIU ไม่ต่ำ

END-TH-MCQ-07.s: A 78-year-old man is brought in for 3 months of apathy, poor appetite and 6 kg weight loss. He has no tremor or sweating. ECG shows new atrial fibrillation at 110/min. His family thinks he is depressed. Which investigation is most important?
END-TH-MCQ-07.p: ผู้สูงอายุ ซึม + ผอม + AF ใหม่ → TSH

END-TH-MCQ-08.s: A 32-year-old man with untreated Graves' disease develops bilateral tender breast enlargement. What is the mechanism?
END-TH-MCQ-08.a: Increased sex hormone-binding globulin and peripheral aromatisation of androgens to oestrogen
END-TH-MCQ-08.p: Gynecomastia ใน thyrotoxicosis = SHBG ↑ + aromatization ↑

END-TH-MCQ-09.s: A 33-year-old woman has had thyrotoxic symptoms for 5 weeks. Her thyroid is diffusely enlarged, firm and non-tender, without bruit. There is no proptosis. TSH is suppressed and FT4 is high. Which pair of results would best distinguish painless thyroiditis from Graves' disease?
END-TH-MCQ-09.a: Low radioactive iodine uptake and negative TSH receptor antibody
END-TH-MCQ-09.p: แยก Graves กับ silent: RAIU + TRAb

END-TH-MCQ-10.s: In a patient with thyrotoxicosis, which physical finding is specific for Graves' disease rather than other causes?
END-TH-MCQ-10.p: Specific for Graves: ตาโปน · pretibial myxedema · acropachy

END-TH-MCQ-11.s: A 42-year-old woman had a sore throat 2 weeks ago. She now has fever, palpitations and severe anterior neck pain radiating to both ears. The thyroid is firm and exquisitely tender. TSH < 0.01, FT4 high, ESR 85 mm/h, radioiodine uptake 2%. Ibuprofen 2,400 mg/day for 3 days has not relieved the pain. What is the next step?
END-TH-MCQ-11.a: Stop NSAID and start prednisolone 40 mg/day, with propranolol for palpitations
END-TH-MCQ-11.p: Subacute thyroiditis: NSAID → ไม่ดีใน 2–3 วัน → prednisolone 40

END-TH-MCQ-12.s: A woman recovering from subacute thyroiditis asks how her thyroid function will change. Which sequence is expected?
END-TH-MCQ-12.a: Thyrotoxic for 3–6 weeks, then hypothyroid for up to 6 months, then recovery in most patients
END-TH-MCQ-12.p: Subacute: พิษ 3–6 wk → ขาด ≤ 6 เดือน → หาย (5–15% ถาวร)

END-TH-MCQ-13.s: A 35-year-old woman with newly diagnosed Graves' disease has FT4 3.4 ng/dL (ULN 1.8) and FT3 9.0 pg/mL (ULN 4). She is not pregnant and has no liver disease. What is the most appropriate initial antithyroid regimen?
END-TH-MCQ-13.p: FT4 1.5–2× ULN → MMI 10–20 mg วันละครั้ง

END-TH-MCQ-14.s: A woman with Graves' disease has taken methimazole for 18 months. She is clinically euthyroid on 2.5 mg/day. TSH is normal but TSH receptor antibody remains elevated. What is the most appropriate plan?
END-TH-MCQ-14.a: Continue methimazole for another 12 months and reassess, or consider radioiodine or thyroidectomy
END-TH-MCQ-14.p: TRAb ยังบวกที่ 18 เดือน → ต่อยาอีก 12 เดือน หรือ RAI/ผ่าตัด

END-TH-MCQ-15.s: A 28-year-old woman started methimazole 20 mg/day 6 weeks ago for Graves' disease. She now has fever 39 °C and a painful sore throat with oral ulcers. What is the most appropriate immediate action?
END-TH-MCQ-15.a: Stop methimazole and obtain an urgent complete blood count with differential
END-TH-MCQ-15.p: ATD + ไข้เจ็บคอ → หยุดยา เจาะ CBC · ห้ามสลับยา

END-TH-MCQ-16.s: A 30-year-old woman with Graves' disease controlled on methimazole 10 mg/day finds she is 6 weeks pregnant. What is the most appropriate change?
END-TH-MCQ-16.a: Switch to PTU for the first trimester, then consider switching back to methimazole after about 16 weeks
END-TH-MCQ-16.p: ตั้งครรภ์ไตรมาสแรก → PTU แล้วกลับ MMI หลัง ~16 wk

END-TH-MCQ-17.s: A 38-year-old woman who smokes has Graves' disease with active moderate-to-severe orbitopathy (proptosis, diplopia, eyelid swelling). Which definitive treatment should be AVOIDED?
END-TH-MCQ-17.p: Graves + ตาโปน active → ATD หรือผ่าตัด ไม่ใช่ RAI

END-TH-MCQ-18.s: A 25-year-old woman with newly diagnosed Graves' disease has a grade III goitre, FT4 55 pmol/L, and TRAb 24 IU/L. Using the GREAT score, what is her predicted risk of relapse after a standard course of antithyroid drugs?
END-TH-MCQ-18.p: GREAT: อายุ < 40, FT4 ≥ 40, TRAb, goiter → class III = 68%

END-TH-MCQ-19.s: A 60-year-old woman has subclinical hyperthyroidism and a single 3-cm palpable thyroid nodule. Thyroid scintigraphy shows intense uptake in the nodule with suppressed uptake in the rest of the gland. What is the next step?
END-TH-MCQ-19.a: Radioactive iodine or lobectomy as definitive therapy
END-TH-MCQ-19.p: Hot nodule → ไม่ต้อง FNA → RAI หรือ lobectomy

END-TH-MCQ-20.s: A 40-year-old woman with Graves' disease stopped methimazole 2 weeks ago. She now has temperature 40 °C, AF at 160/min, agitation and vomiting. Burch–Wartofsky score is 70. Propranolol and PTU have been given. Which statement about the next medication is correct?
END-TH-MCQ-20.a: Give iodine at least 1 hour after the thionamide
END-TH-MCQ-20.p: Storm: iodine ให้หลัง thionamide ≥ 1 ชม. · ห้าม aspirin

END-TH-MCQ-21.s: A 72-year-old man with stable angina is newly diagnosed with primary hypothyroidism (TSH 38 mIU/L, FT4 0.4 ng/dL). Weight 70 kg. What is the most appropriate levothyroxine regimen?
END-TH-MCQ-21.a: 12.5–25 mcg/day, increased gradually every 4–6 weeks according to TSH and symptoms
END-TH-MCQ-21.p: สูงอายุ/โรคหัวใจ: LT4 เริ่ม 12.5–25 mcg

END-TH-MCQ-22.s: A 45-year-old woman on levothyroxine 100 mcg/day for Hashimoto's thyroiditis has a TSH that rose from 2.0 to 9.5 mIU/L after she started iron and calcium supplements, which she takes with her levothyroxine at breakfast. What is the best next step?
END-TH-MCQ-22.a: Advise taking levothyroxine on an empty stomach 30–60 minutes before breakfast, separated from iron and calcium by at least 4 hours, and recheck TSH in 6 weeks
END-TH-MCQ-22.p: LT4 ท้องว่าง แยกจากเหล็ก/แคลเซียม ≥ 4 ชม.

END-TH-MCQ-23.s: A 70-year-old man has taken amiodarone for 2.5 years for ventricular tachycardia. He develops weight loss and palpitations. TSH < 0.01, FT4 high. He has no goitre and no prior thyroid disease. Colour-flow Doppler shows absent vascularity and radioiodine uptake is suppressed. What is the most appropriate treatment?
END-TH-MCQ-23.p: AIT 2: ต่อมปกติ Doppler ไม่เพิ่ม onset ช้า → prednisone

END-TH-MCQ-24.s: A 66-year-old woman with Hashimoto's thyroiditis (positive anti-TPO) develops fatigue and a TSH of 18 mIU/L 4 months after starting amiodarone for atrial fibrillation. Amiodarone is controlling her arrhythmia well. What is the best management?
END-TH-MCQ-24.p: Hypothyroid จาก amiodarone → LT4 + ใช้ amiodarone ต่อ

END-TH-MCQ-25.s: A 45-year-old man has an 8-month right neck mass with normal TSH, FT4 and FT3. Ultrasound shows a 1.3-cm solid hypoechoic nodule with irregular margins, microcalcifications and a taller-than-wide shape. What is the next step?
END-TH-MCQ-25.p: TSH ปกติ + high-suspicion pattern ≥ 1 cm → FNA

END-TH-MCQ-26.s: FNA of a 2.5-cm thyroid nodule is reported as Bethesda category IV (follicular neoplasm). Why can FNA not distinguish follicular adenoma from follicular carcinoma, and what is the usual next step?
END-TH-MCQ-26.a: Because carcinoma is defined by capsular or vascular invasion, which requires histology of the whole nodule; diagnostic lobectomy (or molecular testing)
END-TH-MCQ-26.p: Bethesda IV → lobectomy เพราะต้องดูการทะลุ capsule

END-DM-MCQ-01.s: In a patient with type 2 diabetes, which mechanism contributes most to an elevated fasting (pre-breakfast) plasma glucose?
END-DM-MCQ-01.a: Excess hepatic glucose output overnight from glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis
END-DM-MCQ-01.p: FPG = ตับ · PPG = กล้ามเนื้อ

END-DM-MCQ-02.s: A 45-year-old man with newly recognized hyperglycemia (random glucose 320 mg/dL) complains that his distance vision has fluctuated for 3 weeks and asks for new glasses. What is the best explanation and advice?
END-DM-MCQ-02.a: Osmotic swelling of the lens from glucose and sorbitol; defer new glasses until glucose is stable
END-DM-MCQ-02.p: ตามัวขึ้นลงตอนน้ำตาลสูง = เลนส์บวม → ไม่ตัดแว่นจนน้ำตาลคงที่

END-DM-MCQ-03.s: A 30-year-old woman has polyuria, polydipsia and 6 kg weight loss. Plasma glucose is 360 mg/dL. Which mechanism best explains her polyuria?
END-DM-MCQ-03.a: Filtered glucose exceeding proximal tubular reabsorptive capacity, causing osmotic diuresis
END-DM-MCQ-03.p: glucose > 180 → glucosuria → osmotic diuresis → polyuria → polydipsia

END-DM-MCQ-04.s: A 42-year-old asymptomatic man has a fasting plasma glucose of 131 mg/dL on a routine check-up. What is the most appropriate next step?
END-DM-MCQ-04.a: Repeat a diagnostic test (FPG or HbA1c) on another day to confirm
END-DM-MCQ-04.p: ไม่มีอาการ → ยืนยันซ้ำอีกวันเสมอ

END-DM-MCQ-05.s: A 50-year-old woman has FPG 112 mg/dL and a 2-hour glucose of 168 mg/dL on a 75-g OGTT. How should she be classified?
END-DM-MCQ-05.a: Both impaired fasting glucose and impaired glucose tolerance (prediabetes)

END-DM-MCQ-06.s: Which statement about the natural history of autoimmune type 1 diabetes is correct?
END-DM-MCQ-06.a: Symptoms typically appear only after more than about 80% of beta-cell mass has been destroyed
END-DM-MCQ-06.p: T1: อาการเกิดเมื่อ β cell หาย > 80% — T cell เป็นผู้ทำลาย

END-DM-MCQ-07.s: A 55-year-old man treated with high-dose prednisolone for 2 months for autoimmune hepatitis now has FPG 168 mg/dL on two occasions. How is his diabetes best classified?

MOCK-192.s: 28yo woman with T1DM over 3 years develops Hashimoto thyroiditis and vitiligo. Entity encompassing combination of organ-specific autoimmune disorders?

END-DM-MCQ-08.s: A 24-year-old woman has been on insulin since diabetes was diagnosed 6 months ago. Her physician wants to know whether she still produces endogenous insulin. Which test is most appropriate?
END-DM-MCQ-08.p: ผู้ป่วยฉีด insulin อยากรู้ว่าสร้างเองได้ไหม → C-peptide

END-DM-MCQ-09.s: Over the 10 years before type 2 diabetes is diagnosed, which pattern is typically seen?
END-DM-MCQ-09.a: Insulin resistance and compensatory hyperinsulinemia precede the rise in glucose, and post-meal glucose rises before fasting glucose
END-DM-MCQ-09.p: T2: ดื้อ insulin + insulin สูงชดเชย → PPG ขึ้นก่อน FPG

END-DM-MCQ-10.s: A baby born at 38 weeks to a mother with poorly controlled gestational diabetes weighs 4.4 kg. At 2 hours of age the baby is jittery with a capillary glucose of 28 mg/dL. What is the mechanism of the hypoglycemia?
END-DM-MCQ-10.a: Persistent fetal hyperinsulinemia after the maternal glucose supply stops at birth
END-DM-MCQ-10.p: ทารกแม่ GDM: ตัวโต + น้ำตาลต่ำหลังคลอด = fetal hyperinsulinemia

END-DM-MCQ-11.s: A 30-year-old woman at 26 weeks has a 100-g OGTT: fasting 98, 1-hour 186, 2-hour 150 and 3-hour 128 mg/dL. Using the Carpenter–Coustan thresholds from the lecture, what is the interpretation?
END-DM-MCQ-11.a: Gestational diabetes — two values meet or exceed the thresholds
END-DM-MCQ-11.p: 100-g OGTT: ผิดปกติ ≥ 2 ค่า = GDM

END-DM-MCQ-12.s: A 22-year-old man with DKA has Na 128 mEq/L and glucose 700 mg/dL. What is his corrected sodium, and what does it imply?
END-DM-MCQ-12.a: About 138 mEq/L — the low measured sodium is dilutional from hyperglycemia
END-DM-MCQ-12.p: Corrected Na = Na + 1.6 ต่อ glucose ทุก 100 ที่เกิน 100

END-DM-MCQ-13.s: A 76-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes has been increasingly drowsy for 5 days. Glucose 980 mg/dL, Na 140 mEq/L, pH 7.36, HCO3 23 mEq/L, serum beta-hydroxybutyrate 0.8 mmol/L. Why is ketoacidosis absent despite severe hyperglycemia?
END-DM-MCQ-13.a: Residual insulin is enough to suppress lipolysis but not enough to control glucose
END-DM-MCQ-13.p: HHS = insulin น้อยพอหยุดสลายไขมัน แต่ไม่พอคุมน้ำตาล

END-DM-MCQ-14.s: During treatment of DKA, the urine ketone dipstick changes from 2+ to 3+ while the patient is clinically improving and the anion gap is narrowing. What is the best explanation?
END-DM-MCQ-14.a: The nitroprusside test detects acetoacetate but not beta-hydroxybutyrate, which is being converted to acetoacetate
END-DM-MCQ-14.p: ติดตาม DKA ด้วย AG/β-OHB ในเลือด ไม่ใช่ urine ketone

MOCK-190.s: 68yo T2DM male with confusion, glucose 980 mg/dL, serum osmolality 345 mOsm/kg, pH 7.35, HCO3 22, urine ketones negative. Primary diagnosis?

END-DM-MCQ-15.s: A 19-year-old with DKA (pH 7.10, glucose 520 mg/dL) has received 1 L of 0.9% saline. Serum potassium is 3.0 mEq/L. What is the most appropriate next step?
END-DM-MCQ-15.a: Give IV potassium and delay insulin until potassium is at least 3.3 mEq/L
END-DM-MCQ-15.p: DKA: K < 3.3 → ให้ K ก่อน ยังไม่เริ่ม insulin

END-DM-MCQ-16.s: Six hours into DKA treatment, glucose is 190 mg/dL but bicarbonate is 12 mEq/L and the anion gap is 20. What should be done with the insulin infusion?
END-DM-MCQ-16.a: Continue insulin (reduced dose) and add dextrose to the IV fluid until the ketoacidosis resolves
END-DM-MCQ-16.p: น้ำตาลลงแล้วแต่ AG ยังกว้าง → ลด insulin + เติม dextrose ห้ามหยุด

MOCK-189.s: 22yo T1DM male with severe nausea, Kussmaul breathing, glucose 420, pH 7.18, HCO3 11, anion gap 22, urine ketones positive. Initial management step?

END-DM-MCQ-17.s: A 74-year-old man with CKD (eGFR 25) taking glibenclamide is found confused with glucose 38 mg/dL. He wakes up after 50 mL of 50% glucose. What is the most appropriate disposition?
END-DM-MCQ-17.a: Admit for continuous dextrose infusion and monitoring for recurrent hypoglycemia over the next 24–72 hours
END-DM-MCQ-17.p: SU + ไตเสื่อม + hypoglycemia = admit เฝ้าระวัง 24–72 ชม.

END-DM-MCQ-18.s: A patient with type 1 diabetes started propranolol for migraine prophylaxis. During a hypoglycemic episode, which symptom is most likely still preserved?
END-DM-MCQ-18.p: β-blocker บัง adrenergic แต่ไม่บังเหงื่อ (cholinergic)

END-DM-MCQ-19.s: Which mechanism directly drives the formation of new fragile vessels in proliferative diabetic retinopathy?
END-DM-MCQ-19.a: Retinal ischemia from capillary closure stimulating VEGF release
END-DM-MCQ-19.p: PDR = ขาดเลือด → VEGF → หลอดเลือดใหม่

END-DM-MCQ-20.s: When should retinal screening start in a 12-year-old diagnosed with type 1 diabetes today, compared with a 50-year-old diagnosed with type 2 diabetes today?
END-DM-MCQ-20.a: Type 1: 5 years after diagnosis; type 2: at diagnosis
END-DM-MCQ-20.p: ตรวจตา: T2 ตั้งแต่วินิจฉัย · T1 หลัง 5 ปี

END-DM-MCQ-21.s: A 58-year-old man with type 2 diabetes and UACR 420 mg/g is started on losartan. Two weeks later creatinine rises from 1.20 to 1.40 mg/dL and potassium is 4.8 mEq/L. What is the best action?
END-DM-MCQ-21.a: Continue losartan; a rise in creatinine of up to about 30% reflects reduced intraglomerular pressure
END-DM-MCQ-21.p: Cr ขึ้น ≤ 30% หลัง ACEi/ARB/SGLT2i = แรงดันใน glomerulus ลด → ให้ยาต่อ

END-DM-MCQ-22.s: A woman with type 2 diabetes has a single spot UACR of 64 mg/g on a routine visit; urinalysis shows pyuria and nitrite positive and she has dysuria. What is the most appropriate approach?
END-DM-MCQ-22.a: Treat the urinary tract infection and repeat the UACR later; confirm with 2 of 3 abnormal samples
END-DM-MCQ-22.p: UACR ผิดปกติ: ตัด UTI/ไข้/ออกกำลัง แล้วยืนยัน 2 ใน 3 ครั้ง

MOCK-191.s: Diabetic with CKD (eGFR 40) and microalbuminuria requires therapy adjustment. Oral agent class providing proven renoprotection and slowing CKD progression?

MOCK-124.s: 50yo diabetic with CKD (eGFR 45), BP 148/92, albuminuria 180 mg/g. First-line antihypertensive to slow renal disease progression?
MOCK-124.a: ACE inhibitor (e.g., Enalapril) or ARB (e.g., Losartan)

END-DM-MCQ-23.s: A 62-year-old man with long-standing diabetes has sudden diplopia and ptosis of the left eye with the eye deviated down and out. The left pupil is equal and reactive. What is the most likely mechanism?
END-DM-MCQ-23.a: Ischemia of the central core of the third nerve with sparing of the peripheral pupillomotor fibers
END-DM-MCQ-23.p: CN III palsy + รูม่านตาปกติ ในเบาหวาน = ischemic core

END-DM-MCQ-24.s: A 55-year-old woman with diabetic neuropathy has a warm, swollen, red right foot without fever; she reports little pain. Pulses are bounding, and the midfoot looks flattened. What is the most likely diagnosis?
END-DM-MCQ-24.p: เท้าเบาหวาน บวมแดงอุ่น เจ็บน้อย ชีพจรแรง = Charcot

MOCK-188.s: Diabetic patient screened for early detection of peripheral sensory neuropathy. Most sensitive standardized bedside clinical test?

END-DM-MCQ-25.s: An 84-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes for 25 years, heart failure, CKD stage 4 and two recent hypoglycemic falls has HbA1c 7.1% on insulin. What is the most appropriate glycemic approach?
END-DM-MCQ-25.a: Relax the HbA1c target to about 7.5–8% and reduce insulin to avoid hypoglycemia
END-DM-MCQ-25.p: สูงอายุมาก + ภาวะแทรกซ้อน + hypo บ่อย → เป้า A1c ผ่อน ≥ 7.5

END-DM-MCQ-26.s: A 67-year-old man with type 2 diabetes and heart failure with reduced ejection fraction develops worsening leg edema and dyspnea after a new oral agent was added. Which drug is most likely responsible?
END-DM-MCQ-26.p: TZD = น้ำคั่ง HF แย่ลง · SGLT2i = ช่วย HF

END-DM-MCQ-27.s: A patient taking acarbose and gliclazide develops symptomatic hypoglycemia (glucose 52 mg/dL) but is awake. Which treatment is most appropriate?
END-DM-MCQ-27.a: Oral glucose tablets or glucose solution
END-DM-MCQ-27.p: ใช้ acarbose แล้วน้ำตาลต่ำ → แก้ด้วย glucose ไม่ใช่ sucrose

END-DM-MCQ-28.s: A 52-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes on empagliflozin presents 2 days after laparoscopic cholecystectomy with nausea and abdominal pain. Glucose 186 mg/dL, pH 7.21, HCO3 12 mEq/L, anion gap 22, serum beta-hydroxybutyrate 4.8 mmol/L. What is the diagnosis?
END-DM-MCQ-28.a: Euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis associated with SGLT2 inhibitor
END-DM-MCQ-28.p: SGLT2i + ป่วย/ผ่าตัด + กรด ketone น้ำตาลไม่สูง = euglycemic DKA

END-DM-MCQ-29.s: A 60-year-old man with type 2 diabetes (HbA1c 8.2% on metformin) has heart failure with reduced ejection fraction and eGFR 52. According to the Thai 2020 algorithm in the lecture, which add-on is preferred?
END-DM-MCQ-29.p: T2 + HF หรือ CKD → SGLT2i

END-DM-MCQ-30.s: A woman with type 1 diabetes injects regular insulin before meals and NPH before dinner. She has recurrent sweating and nightmares around 2–3 a.m. with capillary glucose 50 mg/dL. What is the best adjustment?
END-DM-MCQ-30.a: Move the NPH injection from before dinner to bedtime (or switch to glargine)
END-DM-MCQ-30.p: NPH ก่อนอาหารเย็น → hypo ตี 2–3 → ย้ายไปก่อนนอนหรือใช้ glargine

END-DM-MCQ-31.s: A 38-year-old man has newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes with polyuria, 7 kg weight loss, FPG 380 mg/dL and HbA1c 12.5%; ketones are negative. Based on the lecture's starting thresholds, what is the most appropriate initial treatment?
END-DM-MCQ-31.p: วินิจฉัยใหม่ A1c > 8.5 + อาการมาก/FPG > 350 → insulin

ID-SEP-MCQ-01.s: A 66-year-old woman with pyelonephritis remains hypotensive after 30 mL/kg of balanced crystalloid and requires norepinephrine to keep MAP at 65 mmHg. Lactate is 3.8 mmol/L. How should this be classified?
ID-SEP-MCQ-01.p: Septic shock = vasopressor (MAP ≥ 65) + lactate > 2 หลังให้น้ำพอ

ID-SEP-MCQ-02.s: A hospital wants a bedside tool for nurses to screen ward patients for possible sepsis. According to the Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2026, which approach is recommended?
ID-SEP-MCQ-02.a: NEWS/NEWS2, MEWS or SIRS rather than qSOFA
ID-SEP-MCQ-02.p: คัดกรอง sepsis = NEWS/MEWS/SIRS · qSOFA ไม่ใช่ตะแกรง

ID-SEP-MCQ-03.s: In early septic shock, a patient has warm extremities, bounding pulses and a wide pulse pressure despite hypotension. Which mediator is chiefly responsible for the vasodilation?
ID-SEP-MCQ-03.a: Nitric oxide produced by inducible nitric oxide synthase

ID-SEP-MCQ-04.s: A septic patient on norepinephrine has a normal cardiac output and adequate oxygen saturation, yet lactate remains 4 mmol/L. Which statement about lactate in sepsis is correct?
ID-SEP-MCQ-04.a: Lactate can be raised by β2-adrenergic stimulation of glycolysis and mitochondrial dysfunction; follow its trend rather than chasing a normal value
ID-SEP-MCQ-04.p: Lactate สูง ≠ ขาด O₂ เสมอ — ดูแนวโน้ม อย่าให้น้ำไล่

ID-SEP-MCQ-05.s: An 84-year-old nursing-home resident has 1 day of new confusion and a temperature of 37.9 °C. There is no obvious source. BP 124/66 mmHg, lactate 2.3 mmol/L. Dehydration, stroke and hyponatraemia are also being considered. According to SSC 2026, what is the most appropriate antimicrobial strategy?
ID-SEP-MCQ-05.a: Take blood cultures and perform rapid, time-limited investigations; if infection is still suspected, start antimicrobials within 3 hours
ID-SEP-MCQ-05.p: Possible + ไม่ช็อก → สืบค้นเร็ว → ยาภายใน 3 ชม.

ID-SEP-MCQ-06.s: A 45-year-old man with heavy alcohol use has severe epigastric pain radiating to the back after a party. Lipase is 12 times the upper limit, temperature 37.8 °C, WBC 14,500/µL, blood pressure normal. Which approach is most appropriate?
ID-SEP-MCQ-06.a: Classify as unlikely sepsis (inflammation from acute pancreatitis); give fluids and analgesia, defer antibiotics and monitor closely
ID-SEP-MCQ-06.p: Pancreatitis + SIRS ไม่ช็อก = unlikely sepsis → ชะลอยา

ID-SEP-MCQ-07.s: A 60-year-old man with community-acquired pneumonia is hypotensive (BP 82/50 mmHg). The phlebotomist cannot obtain blood cultures after two attempts over 30 minutes. What should be done?
ID-SEP-MCQ-07.a: Give the first dose of antibiotics now and continue attempts to obtain cultures
ID-SEP-MCQ-07.p: ช็อก: อย่าให้การเก็บเพาะเชื้อทำให้ยาช้า

ID-SEP-MCQ-08.s: A patient admitted for urinary sepsis grows coagulase-negative staphylococci in 1 of 2 blood culture sets after 48 hours. He has no intravascular catheter or prosthetic device and is improving on ceftriaxone. What is the most likely interpretation?
ID-SEP-MCQ-08.a: Probable skin contaminant; no anti-staphylococcal therapy is needed
ID-SEP-MCQ-08.p: CoNS 1 ใน 2 ชุด ไม่มีอุปกรณ์ = ปนเปื้อน

ID-SEP-MCQ-09.s: A 70-kg woman with septic shock from cholangitis has received 1 L of 0.9% saline. Which fluid plan best follows SSC 2026?
ID-SEP-MCQ-09.a: Continue to a total of at least about 2.1 L of crystalloid in the first 3 hours, preferring a balanced crystalloid such as Ringer's lactate, with frequent reassessment
ID-SEP-MCQ-09.p: 30 mL/kg × น้ำหนัก ใน 3 ชม. · balanced crystalloid

ID-SEP-MCQ-10.s: A 72-year-old woman with septic shock remains hypotensive (MAP 55 mmHg) after 30 mL/kg of crystalloid. Central venous access is not yet available. What is the most appropriate next step?
ID-SEP-MCQ-10.a: Start norepinephrine through a large proximal peripheral cannula, targeting MAP about 60–65 mmHg
ID-SEP-MCQ-10.p: Septic shock + MAP ต่ำหลังให้น้ำ → NE ทางส่วนปลายได้เลย

ID-SEP-MCQ-11.s: A patient with septic shock requires norepinephrine at a steadily escalating dose to maintain MAP 65 mmHg. What does SSC 2026 suggest adding next?
ID-SEP-MCQ-11.p: NE ขึ้นเรื่อย ๆ → เติม vasopressin

ID-SEP-MCQ-12.s: Blood cultures from a septic patient with a cellulitis-associated abscess grow Gram-positive cocci in clusters at 18 hours. The patient has had multiple hospital admissions and haemodialysis via a catheter. Pending identification, which empirical agent should be included?
ID-SEP-MCQ-12.p: GPC clusters + เสี่ยง MRSA → vancomycin → MSSA ค่อยเปลี่ยน cloxacillin

ID-SEP-MCQ-13.s: Which statement about empirical versus definitive antimicrobial therapy is correct?
ID-SEP-MCQ-13.a: Empirical therapy should be narrowed (de-escalated) once the pathogen and susceptibilities are known
ID-SEP-MCQ-13.p: Empirical เต็มขนาด → de-escalate เมื่อรู้เชื้อ

ID-SEP-MCQ-14.s: Why does SSC 2026 recommend administering beta-lactam antibiotics as a prolonged infusion (after a loading dose) rather than as intermittent boluses?
ID-SEP-MCQ-14.a: Beta-lactam killing depends on the time that free drug concentration remains above the MIC
ID-SEP-MCQ-14.p: Beta-lactam: %T > MIC → หยดนาน

ID-SEP-MCQ-15.s: A 68-year-old man with septic shock from pneumonia has creatinine 3.2 mg/dL (baseline 1.0). Meropenem is to be started. How should the first dose be chosen?
ID-SEP-MCQ-15.a: Give a full (loading) first dose, then adjust subsequent doses to renal function
ID-SEP-MCQ-15.p: ไตวายใน sepsis: dose แรกเต็ม ปรับทีหลัง

ID-SEP-MCQ-16.s: A 55-year-old man with septic shock from community-acquired pneumonia has no recent hospitalisation or antibiotic exposure. Which addition to ceftriaxone plus azithromycin is NOT recommended by SSC 2026?
ID-SEP-MCQ-16.p: Pneumonia/UTI ไม่ต้องคลุม anaerobe

ID-SEP-MCQ-17.s: A woman with pyelonephritis-related sepsis improves on ceftriaxone. On day 3, blood and urine cultures grow E. coli susceptible to ceftriaxone, ciprofloxacin and co-trimoxazole. She is afebrile, eating, and haemodynamically stable. What is the best plan?
ID-SEP-MCQ-17.a: Switch to an appropriate oral agent (e.g. ciprofloxacin or co-trimoxazole) to complete about 7 days in total
ID-SEP-MCQ-17.p: รู้เชื้อ + อาการคงที่ → แคบลง + ยากิน + ระยะสั้น

ID-SEP-MCQ-18.s: A 52-year-old rice farmer from north-eastern Thailand with poorly controlled diabetes presents in the rainy season with fever, cough and hypotension. CT shows multiple small hypodense lesions in the liver and spleen. Gram stain of blood culture shows Gram-negative bacilli with bipolar ('safety-pin') staining. Which empirical regimen is most appropriate?
ID-SEP-MCQ-18.a: Meropenem (or ceftazidime), followed later by oral co-trimoxazole eradication therapy
ID-SEP-MCQ-18.p: ชาวนาเบาหวาน + ฝีตับม้าม → melioidosis → ceftazidime/meropenem → co-trimoxazole

ID-SEP-MCQ-19.s: A 35-year-old man cleaned his flooded house 10 days ago. He now has high fever, severe calf pain, conjunctival suffusion, jaundice, oliguria and haemoptysis. BP 88/50 mmHg. Which antimicrobial is most appropriate for this severe illness?
ID-SEP-MCQ-19.p: Lepto รุนแรง (เหลือง ไตวาย ปอดเลือดออก) → PGS/ceftriaxone IV

ID-SEP-MCQ-20.s: On day 2 of septic shock, a patient's blood glucose readings are 190–230 mg/dL. Haemoglobin is 8.2 g/dL without bleeding or ischaemia. Which combination of management follows SSC 2026?
ID-SEP-MCQ-20.a: Start insulin when glucose is ≥ 180 mg/dL (target about 144–180) and avoid transfusion at this haemoglobin
ID-SEP-MCQ-20.p: Sepsis: insulin เมื่อ ≥ 180 · ให้เลือดเมื่อ Hb < 7

ID-HIV-MCQ-01.s: A man from West Africa is diagnosed with HIV-2 infection. Which drug class should NOT be relied on in his regimen?
ID-HIV-MCQ-01.p: HIV-2 → ห้ามพึ่ง NNRTI

ID-HIV-MCQ-02.s: Dolutegravir blocks which step of the HIV replication cycle?
ID-HIV-MCQ-02.a: Integration of viral DNA into the host genome
ID-HIV-MCQ-02.p: INSTI (DTG, BIC, CAB, RAL) ยับยั้ง integrase

ID-HIV-MCQ-03.s: Which single factor most strongly determines the risk of sexual transmission of HIV from an infected partner?
ID-HIV-MCQ-03.a: The partner's plasma HIV viral load
ID-HIV-MCQ-03.p: ปัจจัยแพร่ทางเพศที่สำคัญที่สุด = viral load

ID-HIV-MCQ-04.s: A man living with HIV has taken ART consistently for 2 years, with all viral loads below 50 copies/mL. He asks whether he can transmit HIV to his HIV-negative partner through condomless sex. What is the correct counselling?
ID-HIV-MCQ-04.a: No: sustained plasma HIV RNA below 200 copies/mL prevents sexual transmission (U=U)
ID-HIV-MCQ-04.p: U=U: VL < 200 ต่อเนื่อง = ไม่แพร่ทางเพศ

ID-HIV-MCQ-05.s: A 22-year-old man has 5 days of fever, sore throat with painful oral ulcers, a generalised maculopapular rash and cervical lymphadenopathy. He was treated for gonorrhoea 4 weeks ago. Monospot is negative. Which test is most appropriate to detect his most likely diagnosis?
ID-HIV-MCQ-05.a: Fourth-generation HIV antigen/antibody test with HIV RNA if negative or indeterminate
ID-HIV-MCQ-05.p: Acute HIV → 4th gen Ag/Ab ± HIV RNA

ID-HIV-MCQ-06.s: Which definition best fits a long-term nonprogressor (LTNP) with HIV?
ID-HIV-MCQ-06.a: CD4 above 500 and viral load below 5,000 copies/mL for at least 8 years without ART
ID-HIV-MCQ-06.p: LTNP: CD4 > 500 + VL < 5,000 ≥ 8 ปี ไม่มียา

ID-HIV-MCQ-07.s: A man with newly diagnosed HIV has oral candidiasis and has lost 12% of his body weight over 4 months. He has no other illnesses. Under WHO clinical staging, which stage is he?
ID-HIV-MCQ-07.p: Oral candida + น้ำหนักลด > 10% = stage 3 · esophageal candida = stage 4

ID-HIV-MCQ-08.s: At which CD4 count does disseminated Mycobacterium avium complex infection typically occur?

ID-HIV-MCQ-09.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the WHO '5C' principles of HIV testing used in the Thai guideline?
ID-HIV-MCQ-09.a: Compulsory testing of all hospital admissions

ID-HIV-MCQ-10.s: Which patient group is specifically listed in the Thai 2025 guideline as requiring HIV testing even without symptoms of HIV?
ID-HIV-MCQ-10.p: ผู้ป่วยวัณโรคทุกรายต้องตรวจ HIV

ID-HIV-MCQ-11.s: Why does the Thai HIV testing algorithm use the most sensitive assay (A1) first and progressively more specific assays (A2, A3) afterwards?
ID-HIV-MCQ-11.a: To avoid missing infections at screening and then exclude false positives before giving a diagnosis
ID-HIV-MCQ-11.p: คัดกรองด้วยชุดไว → ยืนยันด้วยชุดจำเพาะ

ID-HIV-MCQ-12.s: A woman's HIV result is 'inconclusive' (A1 positive, A2 negative). She had condomless sex 3 weeks ago. What is the next step according to the Thai guideline?
ID-HIV-MCQ-12.a: Repeat testing in 2 weeks, and consider HIV RNA (NAT or viral load) because she may be in the window period
ID-HIV-MCQ-12.p: Inconclusive → ซ้ำ 2 สัปดาห์ ± NAT ถ้าสงสัย window

ID-HIV-MCQ-13.s: A patient starting rilpivirine-based ART asks how to take the tablet. Which advice is correct?
ID-HIV-MCQ-13.a: Take it with a meal of at least about 400 kcal, at the same time each day
ID-HIV-MCQ-13.p: RPV = พร้อมอาหาร · EFV = ก่อนนอนท้องว่าง

ID-HIV-MCQ-14.s: Why does tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) 25 mg cause less renal toxicity than tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) 300 mg while remaining equally effective?
ID-HIV-MCQ-14.a: TAF produces about 90% lower plasma tenofovir while maintaining effective intracellular tenofovir-diphosphate in target cells
ID-HIV-MCQ-14.p: TAF: พลาสมาต่ำ 90% · ในเซลล์ยังพอ → พิษไตน้อย

ID-HIV-MCQ-15.s: A man on TDF/3TC/DTG has a normal blood glucose but urine dipstick shows 2+ glucose and 2+ protein on two occasions, with eGFR 96 and normal serum phosphate. According to the Thai criteria, what should be done?
ID-HIV-MCQ-15.a: He meets 2 of 4 criteria for TDF proximal tubular dysfunction: monitor closely and consider switching to a regimen without TDF
ID-HIV-MCQ-15.p: Glycosuria ที่น้ำตาลปกติในผู้ใช้ TDF = tubulopathy

ID-HIV-MCQ-16.s: A patient on TDF/3TC/dolutegravir 50 mg once daily is diagnosed with pulmonary TB and starts a rifampicin-containing regimen. What adjustment is required?
ID-HIV-MCQ-16.a: Increase dolutegravir to 50 mg twice daily during and for 2 weeks after rifampicin
ID-HIV-MCQ-16.p: Rifampicin + DTG → DTG 50 มก. วันละ 2 ครั้ง

ID-HIV-MCQ-17.s: A pregnant woman with HIV started ART at 14 weeks. Her viral load at 36 weeks is below 50 copies/mL. Approximately what is the risk of perinatal transmission with continued suppression?
ID-HIV-MCQ-17.p: แม่ VL < 50 ใกล้คลอด → ติดสู่ลูก 0.1–0.5%

ID-HIV-MCQ-18.s: A man with HIV and CD4 count 60 cells/µL has 6 weeks of fever and weight loss. Chest radiograph shows right lower-lobe infiltrate without cavitation and mediastinal lymphadenopathy. Which statement is most accurate?
ID-HIV-MCQ-18.a: This atypical pattern is typical of TB at low CD4 counts, and extrapulmonary disease should be sought
ID-HIV-MCQ-18.p: CD4 ต่ำ: วัณโรคไม่มีโพรง กลีบล่าง และนอกปอด

ID-HIV-MCQ-19.s: A patient with HIV on a dolutegravir-based ART regimen is being considered for the 4-month rifapentine–moxifloxacin TB regimen (2HPZM/2HPM). According to the lecture, what limits its use?
ID-HIV-MCQ-19.a: It can be combined only with efavirenz-based ART
ID-HIV-MCQ-19.p: 2HPZM/2HPM + ART ได้เฉพาะ EFV

ID-HIV-MCQ-20.s: A patient with HIV and newly diagnosed TB meningitis is not yet on ART. When should ART generally be started?
ID-HIV-MCQ-20.a: After about 4–8 weeks of TB treatment
ID-HIV-MCQ-20.p: TB meningitis + HIV → ART หลัง 4–8 สัปดาห์

ID-HIV-MCQ-21.s: A man with HIV (CD4 35 cells/µL) not on ART has 2 months of fever, night sweats, weight loss, chronic diarrhoea and hepatosplenomegaly. Labs show pancytopenia and markedly raised alkaline phosphatase. Which test is most likely to confirm the diagnosis?
ID-HIV-MCQ-21.a: Mycobacterial blood culture (or bone marrow culture)
ID-HIV-MCQ-21.p: CD4 < 50 + ไข้ ท้องเสีย ตับม้ามโต ALP สูง = MAC → blood culture

ID-HIV-MCQ-22.s: A woman with HIV (CD4 90 cells/µL) has 3 weeks of progressive dyspnoea and dry cough. SpO2 falls from 95% to 86% on walking. Chest radiograph shows bilateral perihilar ground-glass opacities. ABG on room air: PaO2 62 mmHg. Besides trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, what should be given?
ID-HIV-MCQ-22.a: Prednisone 40 mg twice daily for 5 days, then tapering to complete 21 days
ID-HIV-MCQ-22.p: PCP + PaO₂ < 70 หรือ A–a ≥ 35 → prednisone

ID-HIV-MCQ-23.s: A man with untreated HIV develops a sudden right pneumothorax. Which opportunistic infection should be strongly suspected?
ID-HIV-MCQ-23.p: Pneumothorax เองในผู้ติด HIV → PCP

ID-HIV-MCQ-24.s: A 30-year-old man from Chiang Mai with untreated HIV (CD4 22 cells/µL) has fever, hepatomegaly and multiple papules with central umbilication on the face. Skin scraping with Giemsa stain shows oval intracellular yeasts with a central transverse septum. Culture at 25°C grows a mould producing a red diffusible pigment. What is the diagnosis?

ID-HIV-MCQ-25.s: A man with HIV (CD4 80 cells/µL) who explores caves has fever, pancytopenia, AST higher than ALT, raised alkaline phosphatase, hepatosplenomegaly and diffuse miliary infiltrates. Which test offers rapid, sensitive support for the most likely diagnosis?

ID-HIV-MCQ-26.s: A man with HIV (CD4 40 cells/µL) has 3 weeks of worsening headache and blurred vision but no neck stiffness. Lumbar puncture shows an opening pressure of 38 cmH2O, and CSF India ink is positive. In addition to antifungal induction therapy, what is the most important immediate measure?
ID-HIV-MCQ-26.a: Repeated therapeutic lumbar punctures to lower CSF pressure
ID-HIV-MCQ-26.p: Crypto meningitis + ICP สูง → therapeutic LP ซ้ำ

ID-HIV-MCQ-27.s: A newly diagnosed man with HIV has CD4 160 cells/µL, no symptoms and a normal chest radiograph. Which opportunistic-infection prophylaxis is indicated now?

GI-HEP-MCQ-01.s: A 30-year-old man has AST 1,850 U/L and ALT 210 U/L after a prolonged generalised seizure. Bilirubin is normal. What is the most likely source of the raised AST?
GI-HEP-MCQ-01.p: AST >> ALT + CK สูง = กล้ามเนื้อ ไม่ใช่ตับ

GI-HEP-MCQ-02.s: Hepatitis D virus can infect only which patients?
GI-HEP-MCQ-02.p: HDV ติดได้เฉพาะคนที่ HBsAg บวก

GI-HEP-MCQ-03.s: A 26-year-old man has jaundice, ALT 2,400 U/L and suspected acute hepatitis B. HBsAg is negative. Which test is most important to send next?
GI-HEP-MCQ-03.p: HBsAg ลบไม่ตัด acute HBV → anti-HBc IgM

GI-HEP-MCQ-04.s: A health-care worker's results: HBsAg negative, anti-HBc negative, anti-HBs 150 IU/L. What is the interpretation?
GI-HEP-MCQ-04.p: anti-HBs + และ anti-HBc − = ภูมิจากวัคซีน

MOCK-149.s: 28yo man with acute fatigue, fever, jaundice, AST 1,250, ALT 1,480, IgM anti-HAV positive. Diagnosis?

GI-HEP-MCQ-05.s: A previously healthy 34-year-old woman with acute hepatitis B has bilirubin 14 mg/dL and INR 1.9 but is fully alert. What is the most appropriate management?
GI-HEP-MCQ-05.a: Start a nucleos(t)ide analogue such as tenofovir and monitor closely for liver failure
GI-HEP-MCQ-05.p: Acute HBV รุนแรง (INR > 1.5) → ยาต้านไวรัส

GI-HEP-MCQ-06.s: A 48-year-old man who drinks a bottle of spirits daily has jaundice, fever and tender hepatomegaly. AST 1,250 U/L and ALT 980 U/L. What should you conclude?
GI-HEP-MCQ-06.a: Look for an additional cause such as viral hepatitis, paracetamol toxicity or ischaemia, because AST rarely exceeds about 400 U/L in alcoholic hepatitis
GI-HEP-MCQ-06.p: AST > 400 ในคนดื่มเหล้า → มีสาเหตุอื่นร่วม

MOCK-153.s: 45yo heavy drinker with RUQ pain, fever, jaundice, AST 180, ALT 65 (AST:ALT > 2:1), bilirubin 8.2, WBC 14k. Diagnosis?

GI-HEP-MCQ-07.s: Three weeks after starting allopurinol, a man develops fever, rash, eosinophilia and ALT 640 U/L. Which mechanism of drug-induced liver injury is most likely?
GI-HEP-MCQ-07.p: DILI + ผื่น + eosinophil = immunoallergic

GI-HEP-MCQ-08.s: A 72-year-old man in the ICU after cardiac arrest has ALT 8,900 U/L and AST 11,200 U/L on day 2 with bilirubin 1.6 mg/dL. Two days later ALT is 2,100 U/L. What is the diagnosis?
GI-HEP-MCQ-08.p: ALT เป็นหมื่น + ลดเร็วใน 72 ชม. + ไม่ค่อยเหลือง = ischemic

GI-HEP-MCQ-09.s: A 24-year-old woman has acute severe hepatitis with Coombs-negative haemolytic anaemia, a tremor and an alkaline phosphatase of 25 U/L. Total bilirubin is 18 mg/dL. Which diagnosis must be considered?
GI-HEP-MCQ-09.p: ตับอักเสบรุนแรง + hemolysis + ALP ต่ำ = Wilson

GI-HEP-MCQ-10.s: A 52-year-old man with type 2 diabetes has ALT persistently 70 U/L. Fibroscan shows CAP 310 dB/m and liver stiffness 6.1 kPa (valid measurement). What is the best interpretation?
GI-HEP-MCQ-10.a: Steatosis present; advanced fibrosis is unlikely
GI-HEP-MCQ-10.p: CAP ≥ 250–288 = fatty · stiffness < 8 = ไม่มี advanced fibrosis

GI-HEP-MCQ-11.s: A 45-year-old man is HBsAg-positive, HBeAg-negative, HBV DNA 18,000 IU/mL and ALT 52 U/L on repeated testing over 6 months. Fibroscan is 6.5 kPa. According to current (WHO 2024, EASL/AASLD 2025) criteria, what is appropriate?
GI-HEP-MCQ-11.a: Start tenofovir (e.g., TAF) because HBV DNA ≥ 2,000 IU/mL with ALT above the ULN of 35 U/L
GI-HEP-MCQ-11.p: HBV DNA ≥ 2,000 + ALT > ULN (35/25) → ให้ยา

GI-HEP-MCQ-12.s: A 50-year-old man who received a blood transfusion in 1988 is anti-HCV positive. What is the next step?
GI-HEP-MCQ-12.a: Measure HCV RNA to confirm current infection
GI-HEP-MCQ-12.p: anti-HCV + → HCV RNA ก่อนรักษา

GI-HEP-MCQ-13.s: Why can hepatitis C be cured with direct-acting antivirals, whereas hepatitis B usually cannot?
GI-HEP-MCQ-13.a: HCV has no nuclear reservoir such as cccDNA; HBV persists as cccDNA in hepatocyte nuclei
GI-HEP-MCQ-13.p: HCV ไม่มี reservoir → หายขาด · HBV มี cccDNA

GI-HEP-MCQ-14.s: A 46-year-old woman with MASH (biopsy F2) and BMI 31 asks how much weight she needs to lose to reduce liver fibrosis. What is the best answer?
GI-HEP-MCQ-14.a: At least 7%, which resolves MASH, but ≥ 10% is associated with fibrosis regression
GI-HEP-MCQ-14.p: พังผืดถอยต้องลดน้ำหนัก ≥ 10%

GI-ABD-MCQ-01.s: Why does early appendicitis cause dull periumbilical pain before the pain localises to the right lower quadrant?
GI-ABD-MCQ-01.a: Early pain is visceral from a midgut organ, felt in the periumbilical region; later inflammation irritates the parietal peritoneum, producing localised sharp pain
GI-ABD-MCQ-01.p: ไส้ติ่ง: visceral รอบสะดือ → parietal ขวาล่าง

GI-ABD-MCQ-02.s: A patient with severe abdominal pain lies completely still, and pain worsens when the bed is bumped. Percussion over the abdomen is painful. Which type of pain is this?
GI-ABD-MCQ-02.p: นอนนิ่ง + ขยับแล้วปวด + เคาะเจ็บ = peritonitis

GI-ABD-MCQ-03.s: A 35-year-old woman has recurrent upper and left-sided abdominal pain for months, unrelated to meals, with alternating constipation and diarrhoea and relief after defecation. Which organ is the most likely source?
GI-ABD-MCQ-03.p: ปวดสัมพันธ์การถ่าย + เปลี่ยนนิสัยการถ่าย = ลำไส้ใหญ่ แม้ปวดท้องบน

GI-ABD-MCQ-04.s: A 56-year-old man has 4 months of lower abdominal cramping relieved by defecation and a change to looser stools. He has lost 5 kg and Hb is 10.2 g/dL. What is the next step?
GI-ABD-MCQ-04.p: IBS-like + alarm (> 50, น้ำหนักลด, ซีด) → colonoscopy

MOCK-154.s: 24yo woman with bloody diarrhea, sigmoidoscopy shows continuous uniform mucosal inflammation extending from rectum proximally, crypt abscesses without granulomas. Diagnosis?

MOCK-155.s: 28yo male with non-bloody diarrhea, RLQ pain, weight loss, colonoscopy shows transmural skip lesions in terminal ileum, cobblestoning, non-caseating granulomas. Diagnosis?

GI-ABD-MCQ-05.s: A 55-year-old woman has 3 days of epigastric pain with fullness, nausea after meals, belching and poor intake. Which feature, if present, is an alarm feature requiring prompt endoscopy according to the Thai GI society?
GI-ABD-MCQ-05.p: Alarm: dysphagia · bleed/IDA · weight loss · persistent vomiting

GI-ABD-MCQ-06.s: Which feature best distinguishes biliary colic from dyspepsia in a patient with epigastric pain?
GI-ABD-MCQ-06.a: Pain occurs after meals, never before meals, is steady and lasts more than an hour, and occurs episodically
GI-ABD-MCQ-06.p: Biliary colic: หลังอาหาร คงที่ > 1 ชม. เป็นครั้งคราว

GI-ABD-MCQ-07.s: A 32-year-old Thai man has 2 months of epigastric pain and postprandial fullness. He has no alarm features. According to the algorithm in the lecture, what is the most appropriate initial approach?
GI-ABD-MCQ-07.a: Test for H. pylori and treat if positive
GI-ABD-MCQ-07.p: อายุน้อย ไม่มี alarm ในพื้นที่ H. pylori ชุก → test-and-treat

GI-ABD-MCQ-08.s: A patient with dyspepsia has been taking omeprazole daily for 6 weeks. A urea breath test is planned. What is the correct preparation?
GI-ABD-MCQ-08.a: Stop the PPI for at least 2 weeks before the test
GI-ABD-MCQ-08.p: หยุด PPI 2 สัปดาห์ก่อน UBT/stool Ag

MOCK-161.s: 35yo male with postprandial epigastric pain, urea breath test positive for H. pylori. Appropriate eradication regimen?
MOCK-161.a: Bismuth quadruple therapy (PPI, Bismuth, Metronidazole, Tetracycline) or Triple therapy (PPI, Amoxicillin, Clarithromycin)

MOCK-160.s: 40yo woman presents with chronic heartburn and acid regurgitation without alarm symptoms. Recommended initial management approach?
MOCK-160.a: Empower lifestyle modifications and initiate an 8-week trial of daily oral Proton Pump Inhibitor (PPI)

GI-ABD-MCQ-09.s: A 62-year-old woman has fever 39 °C, jaundice and RUQ pain. BP 84/50 mmHg and she is confused. US shows a dilated common bile duct. After fluids and IV antibiotics, what is the key definitive step?
GI-ABD-MCQ-09.p: Reynolds pentad → ERCP ด่วน

GI-ABD-MCQ-10.s: A 45-year-old man has painless jaundice for 1 week with dark urine. No fever. ALP 480 U/L, total bilirubin 6.5 mg/dL, AST/ALT mildly raised, amylase normal, WBC normal. US shows gallstones and a dilated CBD. What is the most likely diagnosis?
GI-ABD-MCQ-10.p: เหลือง ไม่มีไข้ ALP สูง ท่อขยาย = CBD stone

MOCK-157.s: 48yo woman with RUQ pain, fever, arrest of inspiration on deep RUQ palpation (Murphy sign+), gallbladder wall 4.5 mm, impacted cystic duct stone. Diagnosis?

GI-ABD-MCQ-11.s: A 38-year-old man with heavy alcohol use has epigastric pain radiating to the back for 4 days. Serum amylase is 1.5 times the upper limit of normal. Which test is most useful to confirm acute pancreatitis now?
GI-ABD-MCQ-11.p: มาช้า → lipase ดีกว่า amylase

GI-ABD-MCQ-12.s: A 50-year-old woman has mild gallstone pancreatitis without cholangitis. Which management is recommended by current guidelines?
GI-ABD-MCQ-12.a: Moderate goal-directed lactated Ringer's, early oral feeding, and cholecystectomy during the same admission
GI-ABD-MCQ-12.p: Mild gallstone AP → ผ่าตัดถุงน้ำดีก่อนกลับบ้าน

MOCK-156.s: 42yo woman with epigastric pain radiating to back, lipase 1,200 U/L, ultrasound shows gallstones without CBD dilation. Immediate initial management?
MOCK-156.a: Aggressive intravenous fluid resuscitation with isotonic crystalloids (e.g., Lactated Ringer’s)

MOCK-152.s: 50yo male with chronic calcific pancreatitis presents with elevated HbA1c 6.7%, negative GAD/IA-2 antibodies. Diabetes category?
MOCK-152.a: Pancreatogenic Diabetes Mellitus (Type 3c DM / Other specific types)

GI-ABD-MCQ-13.s: A 72-year-old hypertensive smoker presents with sudden severe abdominal and back pain, BP 80/50 mmHg and a pulsatile periumbilical mass. What is the most likely diagnosis?
GI-ABD-MCQ-13.p: ปวดท้อง + หลัง + pulsatile mass + ช็อก = ruptured AAA

GI-ABD-MCQ-14.s: A 58-year-old man with previous appendicectomy has colicky periumbilical pain, repeated vomiting and no flatus for 1 day. Bowel sounds are high-pitched. X-ray shows dilated small-bowel loops with multiple air-fluid levels. No fever, no peritonism, lactate normal. What is the initial management?
GI-ABD-MCQ-14.a: Nil by mouth, nasogastric decompression and IV fluids with electrolyte correction
GI-ABD-MCQ-14.p: SBO ไม่มี strangulation → NPO + NG + IV fluid

GI-ABD-MCQ-15.s: A 74-year-old woman with atrial fibrillation not on anticoagulation develops sudden severe periumbilical pain and diarrhoea. She is writhing in pain, but the abdomen is soft with only mild tenderness. Lactate is 4.2 mmol/L. What is the most likely diagnosis and next investigation?
GI-ABD-MCQ-15.a: Acute mesenteric arterial embolism — CT angiography
GI-ABD-MCQ-15.p: AF + pain out of proportion = AMAE → CTA

GI-ABD-MCQ-16.s: A patient with sudden generalised abdominal pain and board-like rigidity has free air under the diaphragm on an erect chest X-ray. Which statement is correct?
GI-ABD-MCQ-16.a: This is secondary peritonitis from a perforated viscus and needs surgical source control
GI-ABD-MCQ-16.p: Free air = secondary peritonitis → ผ่าตัด

GI-DIA-MCQ-01.s: An 84-year-old bedridden woman on regular tramadol has had small amounts of liquid stool leaking several times a day for one week. She had not passed a formed stool for 10 days before that. The abdomen is mildly distended. What is the most appropriate next step?
GI-DIA-MCQ-01.a: Digital rectal examination to look for faecal impaction
GI-DIA-MCQ-01.p: ท้องผูกนาน + น้ำซึมครั้งละน้อย = overflow → PR ก่อน

GI-DIA-MCQ-02.s: A 30-year-old man reports going to the toilet 6–8 times a day with urgency, but each time passes only a small amount of formed or soft stool. A 72-hour collection shows stool weight of 150 g/day. Which term best describes this?
GI-DIA-MCQ-02.p: ถี่แต่ไม่หนัก = pseudodiarrhea

GI-DIA-MCQ-03.s: Approximately how much fluid enters the small intestine each day in a healthy adult, and how much is normally excreted in stool?
GI-DIA-MCQ-03.a: About 10 L enters; about 0.1 L is excreted
GI-DIA-MCQ-03.p: 10 L เข้า → 0.1 L ออก · 1.5 L ผ่าน ileocecal valve

GI-DIA-MCQ-04.s: A patient underwent resection of 150 cm of terminal ileum with an intact colon. Months later he develops a calcium oxalate kidney stone. What is the mechanism?
GI-DIA-MCQ-04.a: Unabsorbed fatty acids bind luminal calcium, leaving oxalate free to be absorbed in the colon
GI-DIA-MCQ-04.p: ตัด ileum + มี colon → enteric hyperoxaluria

GI-DIA-MCQ-05.s: A 25-year-old man has frequent small-volume stools containing mucus and blood, with lower abdominal cramps and tenesmus for 3 days. Where is the disease most likely located?
GI-DIA-MCQ-05.p: น้อย ถี่ ปวดเบ่ง มูกเลือด = rectosigmoid

GI-DIA-MCQ-06.s: Two hours after eating leftover fried rice from a buffet, several office workers develop profuse vomiting and abdominal cramps with little diarrhoea and no fever. What is the most likely cause?
GI-DIA-MCQ-06.a: Preformed emetic toxin of Bacillus cereus
GI-DIA-MCQ-06.p: อาเจียนภายในไม่กี่ชั่วโมงหลังข้าวผัด = B. cereus (preformed toxin)

GI-DIA-MCQ-07.s: A previously well 70-year-old woman develops watery diarrhoea 6 days after starting ceftriaxone for pneumonia. Which organism should be tested for first?
GI-DIA-MCQ-07.p: นอนโรงพยาบาล + ยาปฏิชีวนะ + ท้องเสีย = C. difficile

GI-DIA-MCQ-08.s: Which feature best distinguishes diarrhoea caused by an invasive organism such as Shigella from diarrhoea caused by an enterotoxin such as that of Vibrio cholerae?
GI-DIA-MCQ-08.a: High fever with small-volume bloody stools and faecal leukocytes
GI-DIA-MCQ-08.p: Invasive = ไข้ + มูกเลือด + WBC ในอุจจาระ

GI-DIA-MCQ-09.s: A 45-year-old woman develops bloody diarrhoea 4 days after eating an undercooked hamburger. Five days later she becomes oliguric with a platelet count of 40,000/µL and schistocytes on the blood smear. Which toxin explains these findings?
GI-DIA-MCQ-09.a: Shiga toxin acting on vascular endothelium
GI-DIA-MCQ-09.p: เนื้อบด → ถ่ายเลือด → HUS = Shiga toxin (EHEC) · ห้ามยาปฏิชีวนะ

GI-DIA-MCQ-10.s: A family of four develops vomiting followed by watery diarrhoea 36 hours after a shared meal. All recover within 2 days. What is the most likely cause?
GI-DIA-MCQ-10.p: อาเจียนนำ หายใน 1–3 วัน ระบาดในกลุ่ม = norovirus

GI-DIA-MCQ-11.s: A healthy 28-year-old office worker has had 5 watery stools a day for 2 days without blood or fever. She has not travelled and has taken no antibiotics. She is drinking well and her vital signs are normal. What is the most appropriate management?
GI-DIA-MCQ-11.a: Oral rehydration and loperamide as needed, without stool testing
GI-DIA-MCQ-11.p: ไม่มี red flag + < 7 วัน → ORS ± loperamide ไม่ต้องตรวจ

GI-DIA-MCQ-12.s: A 35-year-old man has fever of 39 °C, abdominal cramps and frequent small stools with visible blood for 2 days. Which drug should be avoided as monotherapy?
GI-DIA-MCQ-12.p: เลือด + ไข้ → ห้าม loperamide เดี่ยว

GI-DIA-MCQ-13.s: Why does oral rehydration solution remain effective in cholera even though the cholera toxin causes massive intestinal secretion?
GI-DIA-MCQ-13.a: Sodium-glucose cotransport through SGLT1 is not affected by the toxin, so coupled Na and glucose absorption pulls water back
GI-DIA-MCQ-13.p: ORS ได้ผลเพราะ SGLT1 ยังทำงาน

GI-DIA-MCQ-14.s: Compared with the original WHO ORS (311 mOsm/L), what is the main advantage of the reduced-osmolarity ORS (245 mOsm/L)?
GI-DIA-MCQ-14.a: Less stool output and vomiting and fewer unscheduled intravenous infusions
GI-DIA-MCQ-14.p: ORS 245: ถ่ายน้อยลง อาเจียนน้อยลง IV น้อยลง

GI-DIA-MCQ-15.s: A 30-year-old Thai man has fever, abdominal cramps and bloody mucoid stools for 2 days. Stool microscopy shows many leukocytes and no trophozoites. Stool culture has been sent. Which empirical antibiotic is most appropriate in Thailand today?
GI-DIA-MCQ-15.p: Dysentery ในไทยตอนนี้ → azithromycin (quinolone ดื้อ)

GI-DIA-MCQ-16.s: Stool microscopy of a man with 5 days of bloody diarrhoea shows motile trophozoites containing ingested red blood cells. After a course of metronidazole, what additional treatment is recommended?
GI-DIA-MCQ-16.a: A luminal amoebicide such as paromomycin

GI-DIA-MCQ-17.s: A traveller develops 6 watery stools a day with fever of 38.8 °C and is unable to work. There is no blood in the stool. According to CDC guidance, what is the preferred treatment?
GI-DIA-MCQ-17.a: Azithromycin, which may be given as a single 1-g dose

MOCK-010.s: A 35-year-old flood-relief worker presents with 10 episodes of profuse, painless, watery diarrhea resembling 'rice water' accompanied by severe muscle cramps and vomiting. On examination, he is lethargic with sunken eyes and BP 80/50 mmHg. Which of the following is the primary step in management?
MOCK-010.a: Intravenous rehydration with isotonic crystalloid solution

MOCK-159.s: Hospitalized patient receiving Ceftriaxone develops profuse foul diarrhea, WBC 18k, stool PCR positive for C. difficile toxin. First-line antibiotic treatment?

GI-DIA-MCQ-18.s: A 60-year-old man has 3 months of watery diarrhoea, episodes of facial flushing and wheeze. A systolic murmur is heard at the left lower sternal border, and the liver is enlarged and nodular. Which test is most appropriate next?
GI-DIA-MCQ-18.p: Flushing + wheeze + murmur หัวใจขวา + ท้องเสีย → urine 5-HIAA

GI-DIA-MCQ-19.s: Which feature in a patient with chronic diarrhoea most strongly suggests an organic rather than a functional cause?
GI-DIA-MCQ-19.p: ตื่นมาถ่ายกลางคืน = organic

GI-DIA-MCQ-20.s: A 40-year-old woman with chronic watery diarrhoea has stool Na 30 mmol/L and K 25 mmol/L. Her diarrhoea stops during a 48-hour fast. Stool pH is 5.4. What is the most likely diagnosis?
GI-DIA-MCQ-20.p: Gap > 100 + งดอาหารหาย + pH < 6 = carbohydrate malabsorption

GI-DIA-MCQ-21.s: A 50-year-old man has profuse watery diarrhoea of about 4 L/day that continues during fasting. Laboratory tests show K 2.6 mmol/L, low gastric acid output and a stool osmotic gap of 20 mOsm/kg. Which hormone is most likely elevated?

GI-DIA-MCQ-22.s: A young woman with recurrent watery diarrhoea has stool Na 120 mmol/L and K 40 mmol/L, giving a markedly negative osmotic gap. What is the most likely explanation?
GI-DIA-MCQ-22.a: Ingestion of a sodium phosphate or sulfate laxative
GI-DIA-MCQ-22.p: Gap ติดลบ = phosphate/sulfate laxative

GI-DIA-MCQ-23.s: A 52-year-old man with long-standing heavy alcohol use has bulky, greasy, foul-smelling stools and weight loss. CT shows pancreatic calcifications. Approximately what proportion of exocrine pancreatic function must be lost before steatorrhoea appears?
GI-DIA-MCQ-23.p: Steatorrhea เมื่อเสียตับอ่อน ≥ 90%

GI-DIA-MCQ-24.s: A patient with steatorrhoea has an abnormal D-xylose absorption test. Which disorder is most likely?
GI-DIA-MCQ-24.p: D-xylose ผิดปกติ = เยื่อบุลำไส้เล็ก

MOCK-163.s: 28yo woman with chronic diarrhea, iron deficiency, anti-tTG IgA positive, duodenal biopsy showing severe villous atrophy. Definitive management?

GI-DIA-MCQ-25.s: A 32-year-old man with HIV infection and a CD4 count of 40 cells/µL has 2 months of profuse watery diarrhoea and weight loss. Modified acid-fast staining of the stool shows small round oocysts of 4–6 µm. What is the most likely organism?
GI-DIA-MCQ-25.p: AIDS + ท้องเสียน้ำ + oocyst acid-fast 4–6 μm = Cryptosporidium

GI-DIA-MCQ-26.s: A 38-year-old Thai woman has 4 months of intermittent diarrhoea, right lower quadrant pain, low-grade fever and weight loss. Colonoscopy shows a deformed, gaping ileocaecal valve with transverse ulcers. Before starting corticosteroids for presumed Crohn disease, which diagnosis must be excluded?
GI-DIA-MCQ-26.p: ileocecal valve ผิดรูป = นึกถึง TB · ตัดก่อนให้ steroid

GI-DIA-MCQ-27.s: A 26-year-old woman has had abdominal pain about 2 days a week for 8 months, relieved by defecation, with loose stools on most days of abnormal bowel movements and occasional hard stools (<25%). She has no alarm features, and examination and CBC are normal. According to the Thai IBS guideline 2022, what is the next step?
GI-DIA-MCQ-27.a: Make a positive diagnosis of IBS-D and start treatment without further investigation
GI-DIA-MCQ-27.p: Rome IV + ไม่มี alarm = วินิจฉัย IBS ได้เลย

GI-DIA-MCQ-28.s: A 55-year-old man presents with 4 months of intermittent abdominal pain and loose stools relieved by defecation. Which finding makes colonoscopy necessary before diagnosing IBS?
GI-DIA-MCQ-28.p: อาการเริ่มหลังอายุ 50 = alarm → colonoscopy

GI-DIA-MCQ-29.s: A woman with IBS-D has pain and loose stools despite loperamide. Which agent is a recommended second-line option for her diarrhoea according to the Thai guideline?
GI-DIA-MCQ-29.p: IBS-D second line: rifaximin, 5-HT3 antagonist, bile acid sequestrant, eluxadoline

GI-DIA-MCQ-30.s: A 68-year-old woman has 3 months of watery, non-bloody diarrhoea, including at night. She takes omeprazole, sertraline and naproxen. Colonoscopy appears normal. What should be done during the colonoscopy?
GI-DIA-MCQ-30.a: Take random biopsies from the colon to look for microscopic colitis
GI-DIA-MCQ-30.p: ท้องเสียน้ำ + PPI/SSRI/NSAID + กล้องปกติ → random biopsy (microscopic colitis)

GI-DIA-MCQ-31.s: How does racecadotril differ from loperamide in treating diarrhoea?
GI-DIA-MCQ-31.a: Racecadotril reduces intestinal secretion by inhibiting enkephalinase without slowing transit

GI-LFT-MCQ-01.s: A patient on a new antibiotic has ALT 150 U/L (ULN 40) and ALP 600 U/L (ULN 120). What is the R ratio and pattern of liver injury?

GI-LFT7-MCQ-01.s: A 55-year-old obese man has ALT 128 U/L (ULN 40) and ALP 68 U/L (ULN 120) at a routine check-up. What is the R ratio and the pattern of injury?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-01.p: R = (ALT/ULN) ÷ (ALP/ULN) · ต้องหาร ULN ทั้งคู่

GI-LFT-MCQ-02.s: A 52-year-old man has AST 210 U/L, ALT 85 U/L, GGT 420 U/L and MCV 104 fL. Which is the most likely cause?
GI-LFT-MCQ-02.p: AST/ALT > 2 + GGT สูง + MCV โต = เหล้า

GI-LFT-MCQ-03.s: After a marathon, a 25-year-old man has AST 480 U/L and ALT 95 U/L with normal bilirubin and ALP. What is the most useful next test?
GI-LFT-MCQ-03.p: AST >>> ALT → CK ก่อน

GI-LFT7-MCQ-02.s: A 48-year-old woman with dermatomyositis has severe proximal weakness. CK is 12,000 U/L, AST 310 U/L and ALT 160 U/L; ALP, GGT and bilirubin are normal. What is the most likely source of the raised aminotransferases?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-02.p: AST > ALT + CK สูง + GGT ปกติ = กล้ามเนื้อ

GI-LFT-MCQ-04.s: A 68-year-old man had cardiogenic shock 2 days ago, now resolved. AST is 4,200 U/L, ALT 2,900 U/L and LDH 3,800 U/L, with bilirubin 1.6 mg/dL. What is the most likely diagnosis?
GI-LFT-MCQ-04.p: หลังช็อก + LDH สูงมาก (ALT/LDH < 1.5) = ischemic hepatitis

GI-LFT-MCQ-05.s: A 23-year-old woman took a handful of paracetamol tablets about 24 hours ago (exact time unknown). AST is 1,800 U/L. What is the most appropriate immediate treatment?
GI-LFT-MCQ-05.p: Paracetamol ไม่รู้เวลา หรือ AST สูงแล้ว → NAC ทันที

GI-LFT7-MCQ-03.s: A 65-year-old diabetic woman with pneumonia had a blood pressure of 80/40 mmHg yesterday. Today AST is 3,900 U/L, ALT 3,500 U/L and LDH 4,800 U/L; bilirubin 0.7 mg/dL and ALP 140 U/L. What is the most appropriate management of the liver abnormality?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-03.a: Restore perfusion and treat the septic shock; the enzymes should fall rapidly
GI-LFT7-MCQ-03.p: ช็อก + ALT เป็นพัน + ALT/LDH < 1.5 → แก้ shock

GI-LFT7-MCQ-04.s: Which region of the hepatic acinus is most vulnerable to hypotension, paracetamol overdose, alcohol and halothane?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-04.a: Zone 3 — the pericentral hepatocytes around the central vein
GI-LFT7-MCQ-04.p: Zone 3 = ขาดเลือด paracetamol เหล้า halothane

GI-LFT7-MCQ-05.s: A 30-year-old man is found on the floor after a prolonged generalised seizure. AST is 4,200 U/L, ALT 900 U/L, bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL and INR 1.0. His urine is dark and dipstick-positive for blood, with few red cells on microscopy. Which test is most useful next?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-05.p: AST >> ALT + INR ปกติ + myoglobinuria → CK

GI-LFT-MCQ-06.s: A 17-year-old girl presents with acute liver failure. Bilirubin 22 mg/dL, ALP 40 U/L, AST 280 U/L, ALT 95 U/L, Hb 8.5 g/dL with a negative Coombs test. Which diagnosis must be considered first?
GI-LFT-MCQ-06.p: ตับวายวัยรุ่น + ALP ต่ำ + hemolysis Coombs ลบ = Wilson

GI-LFT-MCQ-07.s: A 34-year-old woman with Hashimoto thyroiditis has ALT 320 U/L, raised IgG and positive ANA and anti-smooth muscle antibody. Viral markers are negative. What is the most likely diagnosis?
GI-LFT-MCQ-07.p: ANA + ASMA + IgG สูง = AIH type 1 · anti-LKM = type 2

GI-LFT7-MCQ-06.s: A 35-year-old woman has 1 year of fatigue and amenorrhoea. She has palmar erythema and spider naevi. TB 7 mg/dL, DB 4 mg/dL, AST 600 U/L, ALT 575 U/L, albumin 3.3 g/dL, globulin 6.0 g/dL. Viral markers are negative and she does not drink alcohol. Which tests best support the most likely diagnosis?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-06.a: Antinuclear and anti-smooth muscle antibodies with serum IgG
GI-LFT7-MCQ-06.p: Globulin สูงมาก + transaminase moderate ในหญิงสาว = AIH → ANA ASMA IgG

GI-LFT7-MCQ-07.s: A 55-year-old man with BMI 31, hypertension and dyslipidaemia has AST 76 U/L, ALT 128 U/L and ALP 68 U/L; albumin, globulin and bilirubin are normal. He drinks one beer a week. HBsAg and anti-HCV are negative. What is the most likely diagnosis?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-07.p: ALT > AST เล็กน้อย + metabolic syndrome = MASLD

GI-LFT7-MCQ-08.s: A 17-year-old girl presents with acute liver failure: AST 520 U/L, ALT 210 U/L, ALP 38 U/L, total bilirubin 22.5 mg/dL, Hb 6.8 g/dL with a negative direct Coombs test. Which pair of ratios supports acute Wilsonian liver failure?

GI-LFT7-MCQ-09.s: A 17-year-old with fulminant Wilson disease has haemolytic anaemia with a negative direct Coombs test. What is the mechanism of the haemolysis?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-09.a: Free (non-ceruloplasmin-bound) copper released from necrotic hepatocytes oxidatively damages red-cell membranes
GI-LFT7-MCQ-09.p: Wilson: ทองแดงอิสระ → hemolysis Coombs ลบ

GI-LFT-MCQ-08.s: A 52-year-old woman has 1 year of pruritus and fatigue. ALP 420 U/L, GGT 380 U/L, AST/ALT normal, bilirubin 1.0 mg/dL. Ultrasound shows a normal biliary tree. Which test is most useful for diagnosis?
GI-LFT-MCQ-08.p: หญิง คัน ALP สูง ท่อไม่ขยาย → AMA → PBC

GI-LFT-MCQ-09.s: A 66-year-old man has progressive painless jaundice, pale stools, pruritus and weight loss. A non-tender gallbladder is palpable. What is the most likely cause?
GI-LFT-MCQ-09.a: Carcinoma of the pancreatic head (periampullary cancer)
GI-LFT-MCQ-09.p: เหลือง ไม่ปวด + Courvoisier = มะเร็งรอบ ampulla

MOCK-035.s: A 58-year-old male presents with painless jaundice, dark urine, pale stools, and a non- tender, distended gallbladder (Courvoisier sign). Which malignancy is most strongly suggested?

GI-LFT7-MCQ-10.s: A 57-year-old man has fever 39 °C, jaundice and right upper quadrant pain for 2 days. TB 5 mg/dL, DB 3 mg/dL, AST 55 U/L, ALT 60 U/L, ALP 380 U/L. Ultrasound shows a dilated common bile duct. Besides intravenous antibiotics, what is the most appropriate next step?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-10.p: Charcot's triad + CBD ขยาย → ยาปฏิชีวนะ + ERCP

GI-LFT-MCQ-10.s: A 70-year-old man has bone pain and ALP 650 U/L. GGT, AST, ALT and bilirubin are normal. Which is the most likely source of the ALP?
GI-LFT-MCQ-10.p: ALP สูง GGT ปกติ = กระดูก

GI-LFT-MCQ-11.s: A 40-year-old man taking phenytoin for epilepsy has GGT 210 U/L with normal ALP, AST, ALT and bilirubin. He drinks rarely. What is the most likely explanation?
GI-LFT-MCQ-11.p: GGT สูงอย่างเดียว = เหล้า/ยากระตุ้นเอนไซม์

MOCK-150.s: 60yo woman with isolated ALP elevation (600 U/L) with normal AST, ALT, Bilirubin. Next test to confirm ALP origin from hepatobiliary system?

GI-LFT7-MCQ-11.s: Four days after successful ERCP clearance of a common bile duct stone, a patient is well and afebrile. Bilirubin has fallen from 6 to 2.5 mg/dL, but ALP is still 420 U/L (520 U/L before ERCP). What is the best interpretation?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-11.a: An expected slow fall — ALP has a half-life of about 5–7 days
GI-LFT7-MCQ-11.p: ALP t½ 5–7 วัน → ลงช้าหลังแก้อุดตัน

GI-LFT-MCQ-12.s: A patient with obstructive jaundice from a CBD stone has INR 2.1. After 10 mg IV vitamin K, INR falls to 1.2 within 24 hours. What does this indicate?
GI-LFT-MCQ-12.a: Vitamin K deficiency from impaired fat absorption, with preserved hepatic synthetic function
GI-LFT-MCQ-12.p: PT แก้ได้ด้วยวิตามินเค = ขาดวิตามินเค ตับยังดี

GI-LFT-MCQ-13.s: A 22-year-old man notices yellow eyes during a fasting period. Total bilirubin 3.2 mg/dL, direct 0.3 mg/dL. AST, ALT, ALP, CBC and reticulocyte count are normal. What is the most likely diagnosis?
GI-LFT-MCQ-13.p: Indirect เด่น + อดอาหาร + CBC ปกติ = Gilbert

GI-LFT7-MCQ-12.s: A 60-year-old man with known cirrhosis develops septic shock with bleeding from line sites. INR is 2.4 and platelets 60,000/µL. Which result most strongly favours DIC rather than hepatic synthetic failure alone?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-12.p: VIII ต่ำ = DIC · VIII ปกติ/สูง = ตับ

GI-LFT7-MCQ-13.s: A 70-year-old man with severe tricuspid regurgitation and right heart failure has tender hepatomegaly, a raised JVP and ascites. TB 3.8 mg/dL, DB 2.6 mg/dL, ALP 190 U/L, GGT 160 U/L, AST 70 U/L, ALT 62 U/L. Ultrasound shows dilated hepatic veins and IVC without biliary dilatation. What is the most likely cause of the jaundice?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-13.p: HF + direct bilirubin + hepatic vein โป่ง ท่อไม่ขยาย = congestive hepatopathy

GI-LFT7-MCQ-14.s: A 45-year-old man who has drunk about 120 g of alcohol daily for 15 years has 2 weeks of fever, tender hepatomegaly and jaundice. WBC 16,000/µL, TB 12 mg/dL, AST 220 U/L, ALT 90 U/L, INR 1.8. Which diagnosis best fits?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-14.p: เหล้าหนัก + ไข้ เหลือง + AST/ALT > 2 AST < 400 = alcoholic hepatitis

GI-LFT-MCQ-14.s: A 35-year-old rice farmer has 5 days of high fever, severe calf pain and conjunctival suffusion. Total bilirubin 14 mg/dL, AST 110 U/L, ALT 85 U/L, creatinine 3.1 mg/dL. Which is the most likely diagnosis?
GI-LFT-MCQ-14.p: ไข้ ปวดน่อง ตาแดง + bilirubin สูง ALT ต่ำ + AKI = leptospirosis

GI-LFT-MCQ-15.s: A 60-year-old woman has painless cholestatic jaundice. Ultrasound shows dilated intrahepatic ducts and CBD without a visible stone. She has no fever. What is the most appropriate next step?
GI-LFT-MCQ-15.a: CT abdomen (pancreatic protocol) or MRCP to define the level and cause
GI-LFT-MCQ-15.p: ท่อขยาย ไม่มี cholangitis → CT/MRCP

GI-LFT7-MCQ-17.s: A 74-year-old woman admitted with pneumonia becomes jaundiced: TB 5 mg/dL, DB 3 mg/dL, ALP 540 U/L, AST and ALT normal. She has no abdominal pain. Ultrasound shows no biliary dilatation. What is the most appropriate approach?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-17.a: Treat the infection, review hepatotoxic drugs and follow the LFT; markers or biopsy only if it persists
GI-LFT7-MCQ-17.p: Cholestasis + US ปกติ ระหว่าง sepsis → รักษาการติดเชื้อ ทบทวนยา

GI-LFT7-MCQ-15.s: A 30-year-old man had acute hepatitis 4 months ago with ALT 1,800 U/L; ALT is now 90 U/L. HBsAg is negative, anti-HBs negative and IgM anti-HBc positive. What is the interpretation?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-15.a: Recovering acute hepatitis B in the window period
GI-LFT7-MCQ-15.p: HBsAg − anti-HBs − IgM anti-HBc + = core window

GI-LFT7-MCQ-16.s: Six weeks after a needlestick injury from an HCV-positive patient, a nurse develops ALT 640 U/L. Anti-HCV is negative and HCV RNA is positive. What is the interpretation?
GI-LFT7-MCQ-16.a: Acute HCV infection — the antibody has not yet appeared

HON-WBC-MCQ-01.s: A 34-year-old woman has a CBC: WBC 2,800/µL with 30% segmented neutrophils, 5% bands, 58% lymphocytes, 6% monocytes and 1% eosinophils. Which interpretation is correct?
HON-WBC-MCQ-01.a: Moderate neutropenia (ANC about 980/µL) with a normal absolute lymphocyte count
HON-WBC-MCQ-01.p: ตัดสินด้วย absolute count — % ที่สูงอาจเป็นแค่เงาของอีกเซลล์ที่ลดลง

HON-WBC-MCQ-02.s: In a CBC report, which statement about absolute counts is correct?
HON-WBC-MCQ-02.a: Leukocytosis is defined by the slides as a WBC above 11,000/µL, and a leukemoid reaction as above 50,000/µL
HON-WBC-MCQ-02.p: ทุกเกณฑ์ในสไลด์เป็น absolute /µL

HON-WBC-MCQ-03.s: A 60-year-old man with COPD exacerbation receives IV methylprednisolone. Six hours later his WBC has risen from 8,000 to 16,500/µL with 88% mature segmented neutrophils, no bands, no toxic granulation and eosinophils 0%. He is afebrile. What is the best explanation?
HON-WBC-MCQ-03.a: Release from the marrow storage pool, demargination and reduced egress into tissues
HON-WBC-MCQ-03.p: Steroid → WBC ขึ้นเร็ว ไม่มี left shift eosinophil หาย

HON-WBC-MCQ-04.s: A healthy 22-year-old has blood drawn immediately after a 10-km race; WBC is 15,000/µL with mature neutrophils. A repeat count 3 hours later is 7,200/µL. Which mechanism explains the first result?
HON-WBC-MCQ-04.a: Shift of neutrophils from the marginal pool to the circulating pool
HON-WBC-MCQ-04.p: WBC ขึ้นในไม่กี่นาทีแล้วลงเอง = demargination

HON-WBC-MCQ-05.s: A 50-year-old man with severe Clostridioides difficile colitis has WBC 64,000/µL with many bands, metamyelocytes, toxic granulation and cytoplasmic vacuoles. Basophils are not increased and the spleen is not palpable. Which additional finding would best support the most likely diagnosis?
HON-WBC-MCQ-05.p: Leukemoid: มีสาเหตุ + toxic granule + LAP สูง

HON-WBC-MCQ-06.s: A 47-year-old woman with CML (WBC 210,000/µL, spleen palpable 14 cm below the left costal margin) reports that she feels full after a few spoonfuls of rice, and since this morning has sharp left upper quadrant pain radiating to the left shoulder tip. Which mechanism best explains both complaints?
HON-WBC-MCQ-06.a: Massive splenomegaly from extramedullary haematopoiesis compressing the stomach, with splenic infarction irritating the diaphragm
HON-WBC-MCQ-06.p: CML: ม้ามโต → อิ่มเร็ว · ปวดไหล่ซ้าย = ม้ามขาดเลือด

HON-WBC-MCQ-07.s: Which feature most reliably distinguishes chronic myeloid leukemia from a leukemoid reaction at the bedside before cytogenetics is available?
HON-WBC-MCQ-07.a: Absolute basophilia with eosinophilia and unexplained splenomegaly
HON-WBC-MCQ-07.p: Basophilia + ม้ามโตไม่ทราบสาเหตุ = นึกถึง CML

MOCK-044.s: A 52-year-old man presents with massive splenomegaly, WBC 145,000/µL with full spectrum of granulocyte maturation, t(9;22)(q34;q11) Philadelphia chromosome. Which is the most likely diagnosis?

HON-WBC-MCQ-08.s: A 72-year-old asymptomatic man has WBC 24,000/µL with 82% lymphocytes. The smear shows uniform small mature lymphocytes and numerous smudge cells. There is no lymphadenopathy or splenomegaly and the haemoglobin and platelet count are normal. What is the most appropriate next investigation?
HON-WBC-MCQ-08.p: สงสัย CLL → flow cytometry จากเลือดก่อน

HON-WBC-MCQ-09.s: A 19-year-old student has fever, exudative pharyngitis, tender posterior cervical lymphadenopathy and splenomegaly. Her smear shows many large lymphocytes with abundant blue cytoplasm that indents around adjacent red cells, varying in size and shape. What are these cells mainly?
HON-WBC-MCQ-09.p: Pleomorphic = reactive · IM atypical lymphocyte = CD8 T cell

HON-WBC-MCQ-10.s: A 58-year-old rice farmer from north-eastern Thailand has eosinophils 2,100/µL, intermittent diarrhoea and a migrating serpiginous itchy rash on the buttocks. He is about to start high-dose prednisolone for newly diagnosed immune thrombocytopenia. What should be done first?
HON-WBC-MCQ-10.a: Give ivermectin (or test for Strongyloides) before starting prednisolone
HON-WBC-MCQ-10.p: Eos สูงในคนไทยก่อนให้ steroid = นึกถึง Strongyloides

HON-WBC-MCQ-11.s: A 45-year-old woman in the ICU has septic shock that responds poorly to fluids and norepinephrine. Labs: Na 128, K 5.6 mmol/L, glucose 62 mg/dL, WBC 14,000/µL with eosinophils 9% (1,260/µL). Which explanation for the eosinophil count is most useful?
HON-WBC-MCQ-11.a: Cortisol normally suppresses eosinophils during severe stress; their persistence suggests adrenal insufficiency
HON-WBC-MCQ-11.p: ช็อก + eos ไม่ต่ำ + Na ต่ำ K สูง = adrenal insufficiency

HON-WBC-MCQ-12.s: A 28-year-old woman with Graves' disease started propylthiouracil 6 weeks ago. She presents with fever 39.2 °C and a painful sore throat. CBC: WBC 1,100/µL, ANC 150/µL, haemoglobin and platelets normal. What is the most appropriate management?
HON-WBC-MCQ-12.a: Stop propylthiouracil permanently, take cultures and start empirical broad-spectrum IV antibiotics
HON-WBC-MCQ-12.p: ยาต้านไทรอยด์ + ไข้ เจ็บคอ + ANC < 500 = หยุดยา + ยาต้านเชื้อ IV
